plugins.description: DSH 长任务（下载/编译/安装）跑完了，agent 却因为那一轮已经结束而不再说话？让它自己回来报告。DeepSeek Harness plugin that wakes the agent when a long background task finishes after its turn has ended.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-proactive · the night watchman

> A DSH plugin that lets the agent **speak up on its own** when a long job finishes
> after its turn has already ended — no more coming back to ask "is it done yet?".

[![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-63%20passing-brightgreen)](#test-suite)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)

[中文说明 →](README.zh-CN.md)

---

## What it does

You ask the agent to do something that takes hours — pull down a 40 GB model, wait for a
compile, sit through an installer. The agent starts the job, the turn ends, and it goes to
sleep. The job is still running. **Nothing tells the agent when it finishes**, so nothing
tells you either: you have to wander back and ask.

This plugin makes DSH watch the condition for you. When it is met, the plugin injects one
message into the session and wakes the agent — so the agent reports to you by itself.

```
you:      fetch that 20 GB thing and tell me when it's done
agent:    (starts the download → turn ends → asleep)
            ...hours later...
plugin:   *sees the file size stop changing* → *injects a message* → *wakes the agent*
agent:    "Done — 20.3 GB, and I verified the checksum against the published one."
```

## Why it exists

An agent is a request/response process. Once a turn is over it has no clock, no timer and no
way to learn that a `curl` it launched has exited or that a file has appeared on disk. Under
DSH the only thing that can hand it that fact is a message arriving in its inbox — which is
exactly what a session looks like when *you* type something. If nothing sends one, the agent
stays asleep until a human pokes it.

So the missing piece is not the waiting, it is the *waking*. This plugin is the thing that
wakes it.

## Mechanics

The wake-up uses the same call DSH itself uses when a subagent reports back to its parent
agent (see `dsh-subagent/lib/continuation.js`):

```js
agent.steer(createUserMessage({
    content: [{ type: 'text', text: message }],
    source: { kind: 'plugin', plugin: 'dsh-proactive' },
}))
```

`agent.steer(...)` is the door into a session that is not currently running a turn;
`createUserMessage(...)` builds the message object that door expects. This is DSH's own API
surface, not a private back channel.

`source.kind = 'plugin'` is the default, and it matters: a plugin-originated message **is not
rendered in the UI**. You do not see a fake bubble pretending to be something you typed —
you only see the agent's reply, which is the whole point. `source.kind = 'user'` is available
per-entry if you deliberately want the message rendered as a user bubble, and it is used by
the test suite to prove the difference is real.

## Trigger types

| `type` | Fires when | Required fields |
|---|---|---|
| `file-stable` | The file size is unchanged across `rounds` consecutive checks — **the standard "download finished" test** | `path`, `rounds` (default `stableRounds`, 3) |
| `file-exists` | The path exists **as a file** (a directory does not count) | `path` |
| `file-size` | The file exists and its size is ≥ `bytes` | `path`, `bytes` (default 0) |
| `process-exit` | The named process is gone — **the job it was doing is over** | `process` (e.g. `curl.exe`) |
| `port-open` | A TCP connection to `host:port` succeeds — **the service came up** | `port`, `host` (default `127.0.0.1`) |
| `time` | The clock passes `at` — an alarm | `at` (ISO date-time; bare = local, `Z` = UTC) |

Unknown types never fire; they are skipped silently rather than guessed at.

### Common fields

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Identifies the entry in `boot.log` and in the default message. Any string. |
| `message` | What the agent reads when it wakes. Write it as an instruction to the agent, not as a note to yourself. |
| `sessionId` | Optional. Wake only this session. If it is not open, the entry is skipped for that tick and stays armed — it is **never** redirected to another session. Omit to wake the most recently active one. |
| `sourceKind` | Optional. `plugin` (default, not rendered) or `user` (rendered as a user bubble). |
| `form` | Optional, with `sourceKind: 'plugin'`. Free-form tag on the source; `notice` also carries a `summary` (first 120 chars of `message`). |
| `repeatSeconds` | Optional. Re-arm instead of firing once — see below. |

### Which session gets woken

When several DSH sessions are open, exactly one is chosen:

1. **`sessionId` set** → only that session. If it does not exist the entry is skipped, logged,
   and left armed. Refusing to fire is deliberate: a reminder delivered to the wrong session
   is worse than no reminder.
2. **`sessionId` absent** → the **most recently active** session. Activity means a message
   arrived in its inbox, its status turned `running`, or the session started. Not "the last
   one registered" — that older rule woke the wrong session when two were open, and it is
   pinned by five tests (`C. session selection`).

### One-shot versus repeating

A fired entry is stamped `fired: true` and never fires again. With `repeatSeconds` the entry
is **re-armed** instead, and `firedCount` / `lastFiredAt` record the history:

- `time` → `at` moves to now + `repeatSeconds`.
- `file-size` → `bytes` is raised to the current file size + 1, so the next byte appended
  fires it again.
- Any other type → `repeatSeconds` is meaningless and the entry silently degrades to one-shot.

Entries whose files are actually a moving target (a growing log, a progress file) are what
`repeatSeconds` is for.

## Install

One command, straight from the repository:

```bash
dsh plugin add --profile web github:mili1360/dsh-proactive
```

That resolves the package over git, adds it to the profile's `dependencies`, and registers
the bundle in `dsh.profile.bundles` on its own — verified on `0.2.0-rc.2`. Then **restart
DSH**: a registered bundle is only picked up at boot.

Works the same way from a local clone, if you would rather build from source:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mili1360/dsh-proactive.git
dsh plugin add --profile web ./dsh-proactive
```

<details>
<summary>Doing it by hand instead</summary>

The plugin imports `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`, so it has to sit somewhere Node can resolve that
package from — a normal place for that is inside the profile's module tree.

```bash
# 1. put the plugin next to (or inside) your DSH profile
git clone https://github.com/mili1360/dsh-proactive.git ./dsh-proactive

# 2. register it in <profile>/package.json
#    dependencies:        "dsh-proactive": "link:<absolute path to the plugin>"
#    dsh.profile.bundles: [ "dsh-proactive" ]      <- add to the array
```

Then verify the import resolves from the plugin directory:

```bash
node -e "import('@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm').then(m => console.log('createUserMessage =', typeof m.createUserMessage))"
# createUserMessage = function
```

If that fails, link the package the way DSH exposes it — for example a `node_modules/@deepseek-ai`
junction inside the plugin directory pointing at `<profile>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai`.

**Restart DSH.** `dsh.marketplace.requiresRestart` is `true`, and a newly registered bundle is
not picked up without one. Afterwards the plugin directory contains `boot.log`, and three
lines mean it loaded:

```
apply() 被调用  enabled=true  intervalMs=15000
定时器已挂载
守夜人就绪
```

No `boot.log` means the bundle never loaded — check the profile registration again.

</details>

## Requirements / compatibility

**After installing, confirm it actually works — a profile that boots is not proof.**
A plugin can load cleanly, serve its routes and still break the host; we have seen exactly
that. So the acceptance test is: **create a new session and send it one message** (the plugin
is idle until a watch fires, so a quiet log is expected), then confirm the session exists and
the agent answered. If new sessions cannot be created at all, remove the mount line above and
restart.

Developed and tested against DSH **`0.1.0-rc.7`** — a **customised** build, not a stock
upstream release. Another version may register its services or name its events differently:
this plugin uses `ctx.on`, `ctx.effect`, `ctx.agents`, the `agent/created`,
`agent/sessi

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的生图桥插件：让没有生图/修图能力的模型接上外部生图模型。可添加多个服务商，为生图与修图各选主用与备用模型，备用接入时自动接管，全部在 Web 界面点击配置。
plugins.readme_text: # 生图桥 dsh-image-bridge [English](README.en.md) | 中文 [![stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/kkj-luna/dsh-image-bridge?style=flat)](https://github.com/kkj-luna/dsh-image-bridge) [![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4f8cff)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 里**没有作图能力的模型**接上外部生图服务。装一个插件，模型就多出 `image_generate`（生图）与 `image_edit`（改图）两个工具，图片作为持久附件出现在对话里，同时另存到会话工作区 `generated-images/`。 ![生图桥](docs/promo-banner-zh.png) 设置页： ![生图桥设置页](docs/settings-zh.png) ## 安装 装插件（包在 npm 上，一条命令）： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add kkj-luna-dsh-image-bridge ``` 重启 `dsh web`，打开 **设置 → 生图桥**。装的是预构建产物，不用克隆仓库、不用记本地路径，也不会触发源码构建授权。 **懒得敲命令？** 让 Agent 装：新建对话，把下面这句发过去，它会自己装、重启并核对结果。 ```text 帮我安装这个插件：dsh plugin --profile web add kkj-luna-dsh-image-bridge 装完重启 dsh web，并确认「设置 → 生图桥」能打开、两个工具已注册。 ``` **想跟最新提交**（npm 上还没发到那一版时）： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:kkj-luna/dsh-image-bridge ``` **改代码时**用本地目录装（会写成 `link:` 依赖，改完重启即可）： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add <本仓库绝对路径> ``` > **刚发布的版本可能装不到。** pnpm 默认有 **24 小时发布年龄门槛**（`minimumReleaseAge`，防止刚被投毒的版本立刻被装上）：新版本发布后 24 小时内，上面那条命令会**静默退回上一个版本**——你看到装成功了，但装的不是最新的。 > > 想立刻装到指定版本，点名版本号即可绕过门槛： > > ```sh > dsh plugin --profile web add kkj-luna-dsh-image-bridge@0.4.2 > ``` > > 检查实际装到的是哪一版：看设置页页头徽标的版本号，或 `dsh plugin --profile web list`。 ### 装完怎么确认 重启 `dsh web` 后，三条任选（**重启是必须的**，插件代码不会被热重载）： - 打开 **设置 → 生图桥**，能看到设置页； - `$DSH_HOME/dsh-image-bridge-startup.json` 里 `steps` 有三步（`Config schema 就绪` / `两个工具已注册` / `测试通道已挂载`）、`services.tools` 为 `true`； - 会话里模型能调用 `image_generate` 与 `image_edit` 两个工具。 ### 卸载 ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove kkj-luna-dsh-image-bridge ``` 也可以在「设置 → 插件」里删。 | 你可能想知道 | 答案 | | --- | --- | | 包名为什么带 `kkj-luna-` | 为了在 npm 上唯一——`dsh-image-bridge` 已被别人占用。设置页徽标只显示仓库名 `dsh-image-bridge` | | 为什么不直接发 npm | 已经发了。`github:` 那条只是给"想跟最新提交"的人用的备选 | | 装完要不要重启 | **要**，插件代码不会被热重载 | | 从旧版本升上来配置会丢吗 | 不会。行 id 与设置命名空间一直是 `image-bridge-v4`，包名换过两次但它只是个安装标识 | | 想改代码怎么办 | 见[完整手册](docs/manual.md)的「开发本插件」——那是开发者路径，普通使用不需要 | ## 三步开始 1. **添加服务商**：设置 → 生图桥 →「＋ 添加模型提供商」，填接口地址（如 `https://api.openai.com/v1`）与 API Key。 2. **先测试、再保存**：点「测试连接」，模型列表出来后点浮层的**「保存」**。 3. **选模型并画图**：回到页面的「模型」区块，为生图、改图各选一个模型（可各配一个备用；下拉顶部有搜索框，模型多时直接搜名字），点「保存模型设置」；然后直接对模型说「帮我画一只戴宇航头盔的柴犬」。 > **最容易踩的一步**：下拉候选来自**已经保存**的模型列表。只测试不保存就关掉浮层，模型不会进下拉——顺序是「测试连接 / 获取可用模型」→「保存」→ 下拉里才有。 ## 你会得到 - **画图不靠模型本身**——当前模型有没有作图能力都不影响：它调用插件，插件去问外部生图服务，图片回传成对话里的图片附件 - **多家服务商并排**——每家各自的接口地址与 API Key，卡片上直接看连通状态；点一次「测试连接」顺带把这家的可用模型列出来 - **模型随便搭**——生图和改图可以选不同厂商的模型，各配一个主用 + 备用；主用失败自动换备用，并告诉你换成了哪个 - **只列能画图的模型**——你的 Key 可能带几百个模型，默认只显示判定为生图的那几个，想看全部点一下开关；下拉里能直接搜模型名，不用在一长串里翻 - **尺寸可选**——八种常用预设，也可以自己填任意尺寸串 - **密钥不外泄**——API Key 存进 DSH 凭据服务（`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`，权限 `0600`），不写进配置文件，也不回传浏览器 - **升级不丢配置**——服务商、模型、尺寸存在 profile 里，更新插件不影响 ## 支持的服务商 任何 **OpenAI 兼容**接口都行：OpenAI、智谱、通义千问、SiliconFlow，以及各类中转服务。生图打 `POST {接口地址}/images/generations`；改图打 `POST {接口地址}/images/edits`（multipart 上传参考图，参考图用会话工作区里的路径）。只要两样：接口地址与 API Key。 ## 超时与换备用 生图接口是同步的，憋几十秒很正常（实测 42–61 秒）——所以**只在连不上时换备用，不因为画得慢换人**： | 行为 | 值 | | --- | --- | | 连接超时（设置项，按秒填） | 默认 **15** 秒 | | 备用的连接上限 | 固定 **30** 秒，不是设置项 | | 整次调用上限 | `timeoutMs`，默认 **180000** 毫秒 | - **连接超时只管「请求有没有发出去」**：DNS / TCP / TLS / 代理在 15 秒内没把请求发出去，就算这家连不上，改用备用模型。 - **请求一旦发出就不再计时**：服务商画多久都照等，由 `timeoutMs` 兜底。所以地址填错最多等 15 秒就换人，正常的慢生成不会被误判。 - **三种情况换备用**：连不上（连接超时或网络层直接失败）、非 2xx（含回包不是合法 JSON）、回包正常却解析不出任何可用图片。 - **两种不换**：你在界面上主动取消；图片已经产出、只是下载失败——已经计过费，不该再生成一次。 - **两家都连不上时**，错误以「**模型连接失败**」开头，并列出两次尝试各自的原因；想确认某家到底通不通，点设置页的「测试连接」。 > 老版本按「响应快慢」换备用，配置里那项叫 `fallbackAfterMs`（「主模型超时(毫秒)」，默认 90000）。**这项已整体删除**，老配置里的值会被当作未知字段丢掉，不影响运行。 ## 常见问题 先看设置页的**状态灯**和卡片上的失败原因，多数问题那里就写着答案。 | 现象 | 原因 | | --- | --- | | 「没有可用的 API Key」 | 这张卡片没填、也没存过密钥。**不是**网络错误——请求根本没发出去 | | 「密钥被拒绝（401/403）」 | 请求发出去了，服务商不认这把 Key | | 「获取可用模型」报 404 | 这家不提供 `/models`，不影响生图 | | 四个下拉是空的（禁用） | 还没保存过模型列表：测试连接 → **保存**。四处提示里说的「手动输入…」是**下拉里的一个条目**，而空状态下下拉本身是禁用的——先按上面两步把列表存上，才能选到它 | | 设置里没有「生图桥」这一页 | 查插件是否启用、客户端日志里 `client apply` 是否 fatal；**改过代码要重启 DSH**（热重载默认忽略 `node_modules`） | ## 安全与隐私 - **密钥不落配置**：API Key 存 `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`（`0600`），配置文件里只有凭据名；密钥不回传浏览器，也不进日志。 - **没有显式密钥就不发请求**：请求里既没有显式密钥、也没有合法的凭据引用时，Host **一个字节都不发**，绝不拿别家服务商的密钥顶上；地址同样不回退。 - **对方给的图片地址要过 SSRF 关卡**：服务商可以回一个 URL 让客户端去下载——那个地址是**它给的**，所以只允许 `http`/`https`，并拒绝 `localhost` / `.local` / 环回与私网网段（`127.x`、`10.x`、`172.16-31.x`、`192.168.x`、`169.254.169.254`、`fe80:` / `fc` / `fd` 等）。 - **你自己填的接口地址允许本机**：本地生图服务是正当用法，只要协议是 http/https。 - **回包与下载都有上限**：回包正文 32 MiB，下载图片 15 秒 / 20 MiB，读取可被取消。 - **删除服务商不清理密钥**：删除只是配置操作。想清掉就自己删 `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` 里的那一行。 ## 开发与验收 ```sh node .dib-verify/verify-manifest.mjs # 47 清单与跨文件一致性 node .dib-verify/verify-client.mjs # 183 客户端注册与组件渲染 node .dib-verify/verify-host.mjs # 147 Host 端到端 node .dib-verify/verify-security.mjs # 34 安全边界（SSRF 逐跳拒收、回包上限、条目封顶） node .dib-verify/verify-resolve.mjs # 8 依赖解析健壮性 node .dib-verify/verify-upgrade.mjs # 24 升级后用户配置是否保留 ``` 共 **443 条断言**，无需联网、无需真实密钥。跨进程端到端另需先起一个本地模拟接口： ```sh node .dib-verify/mock-image-api.mjs 8799 # 另开一个终端 node .dib-verify/verify-cross.mjs ``` 脚本路径全部现场推导，没有写死机器路径；缺环境时会报错并告诉你要设哪个变量（`DSH_BIN` / `DSH_PROFILE_DIR` / `DIB_PLUGIN_DIR`）。 **为什么有 `verify-upgrade`**：用户的服务商配置**不在插件里**，而在 profile 的那一行上。插件自身的测试永远发现不了「改名 / 改行 id / 改默认值把用户已保存的配置弄丢」。这一套直接调用 Harness 真实导出的 patch 合成算法，按真实层序合成后断言配置零漂移。 ## 目录 **仓库根目录就是插件包本身**（v0.3.0 起，这是一键安装的前提）： ``` package.json cordis.patch.yml 插件清单与挂载声明 index.js client.js Host 半与客户端半 locale/ icon.svg 插件卡片文案与图标 README.md docs/manual.md 本文件（仓库门面 / npm 页）与完整手册 .dib-verify/ 测试与验收套件（随仓库走，不进包） generated-images/ 生图输出（已忽略，不入库） ``` `.npmignore` 把 `.dib-verify/`、截图与本地缓存挡在包外——插件装到用户机器上时只有跑起来需要的东西。 ## 已知限制 - **改了插件代码要重启 DSH**：Node 缓存已加载模块，热重载忽略 `node_modules`（配置热更新是另一条通道，不受影响） - **导航栏图标是权宜方案**：外壳按 section id 硬编码图标，第三方插件一律是齿轮。本插件挂载后「认领自己那一行」换成自己的标记；等官方 `settings.section` 支持 `icon` 后应改回官方能力 ## 文档 | 文档 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | [插件完整手册](docs/manual.md) | 配置项、行为细节、排查、实现要点 | | [变更记录](CHANGELOG.md) | 每个版本改了什么（当前 **v0.5.0**） | | [验证报告](.dib-verify/verify-report.md) · [第二轮](.dib-verify/verify-report-2.md) | 独立验证结论（含未覆盖范围） | | [上架插件市场](docs/marketplace.md) | 想让它出现在插件市场里？条目文件与 PR 步骤 | ## 反馈 提 [issue](https://github.com/kkj-luna/dsh-image-bridge/issues) 时附上三份自诊断文件的路径，排查会快很多： | 文件 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | `$DSH_HOME/dsh-image-bridge-startup.json` | Host 每次激活覆写，含当前实际在用哪个服务商 | | `$DSH_HOME/dsh-image-bridge-client.log` | 浏览器侧日志，**不含密钥** | | `$DSH_HOME/dsh-image-bridge-degraded.json` | 只在依赖解析失败时出现 | ## 许可 [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Onto space panel for DeepSeek Harness: declarations, agents, memory and per-chat context.
plugins.readme_text:
# Onto Space Panel for DeepSeek Harness

A compact Onto space picker and a side panel for declarations, resident agents,
memory artifacts, templates and objects. Select what belongs in the current chat;
the active context remains visible above the composer.

## Features

- Connect to Onto on first use: enter your MCP endpoint and API key, verify
  access, then select a space. Reuse an existing Harness connection automatically.
- Search and select available Onto spaces.
- Open the space panel with **Обзор**.
- Read an accepted/current space declaration and attach it to the chat.
- Inspect resident agents and their charters. Selecting a valid active resident
  loads its accepted charter and constitution into the current chat.
- Search and page through accepted memory artifacts, read their contents and
  explicitly attach or disconnect them.
- Browse templates and objects, then include selected objects in the conversation.
- Keep selections and context separate for each chat and each selected realm.
- Change context through the `select_onto_space` and
  `configure_onto_chat_context` model tools when the user requests it.

The UI is currently in Russian. Names and descriptions are supplied by Onto.
An agent selection gives the current Harness conversation a resident role;
it does not launch a separate agent process or external agent broker.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with its Web UI or Desktop application.
- Your Onto MCP endpoint URL and personal API key, or an existing authenticated
  Harness MCP connection named **`onto`**.
- Harness's writable credential provider for the first-use setup form. Standard
  local profiles use `@deepseek-ai/dsh-credentials-local`.
- The connection must expose `list_available_realms`, `about_realm`,
  `list_realm_agents`, `get_realm_agent`, `search_memory_artifacts`,
  `get_memory_artifact`, `get_memory_artifact_by_path`, `search_templates`,
  `search_objects` and `get_entity` for their respective panel features.

Host integration was developed against DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2**.
Other releases are not yet verified. Harness is in developer preview and its
extension interfaces can change.

## Install a release tarball

Download the package `.tgz` from the project's release and install it into a
Web-capable profile. For example:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-onto-space-panel-1.2.1.tgz
```

Release downloads: https://github.com/hope4b/dsh-onto-space-panel/releases

You can also install the tagged GitHub source, which already contains the built
browser entry point and has no install-time build script:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:hope4b/dsh-onto-space-panel#v1.2.1
```

In Desktop, use **Plugins** to install the downloaded bundle where supported by
your version. The tarball already contains the browser bundle; no install-time
build script or extra build permission is needed.

If this plugin was previously loaded manually by an absolute-path row in
`cordis.patch.yml`, disable that old row before enabling the packaged bundle.
Do not run two copies: they register the same tools and API routes.

Restart Harness after installing or replacing the bundle. Select an Onto space
above the composer and press **Обзор** to open its panel. Use **В контекст** to
attach a declaration or memory artifact. A role or material can be removed using
the `×` next to its context label.

## Connect Onto MCP

### First-use setup (recommended)

1. Install the plugin and restart Harness.
2. Click **Onto → Подключить** above the composer.
3. Enter your MCP endpoint URL and personal API key, then press **Подключить**.
   The key field expects only the value. A pasted `X-Onto-Api-Key: value` line
   is accepted too: the plugin removes the header name before sending or storing it.
4. The plugin checks access with `list_available_realms` before saving. After
   success, select a space from the list. An empty list means the connection
   works but no accessible spaces were returned.

Obtain the endpoint and key from your Onto administrator. The form uses HTTPS
and the `X-Onto-Api-Key` header; localhost HTTP is supported for development.
It requires a direct MCP endpoint, without credentials or query parameters in
the URL. Authentication redirects are rejected.

The connection belongs to the active Harness profile. Keys are stored through
Harness's credential provider, not in plugin configuration, browser storage or
chat messages. With the standard local provider, the managed credential file is
`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`. This is local credential storage, not a claim of
OS keychain encryption. The server address and credential reference are stored
under `$DSH_HOME/storages/onto-connections/`, keyed by the profile location.
The plugin restores its own MCP connection on startup without editing profile YAML.

Open **Подключение** in the space picker, or **Подключение Onto** in the side
panel, to update a connection created by the plugin. A blank key reuses the saved
key only when the endpoint stays the same. Changing the endpoint or account key
requires choosing spaces and attaching context again; old chat context is not
automatically applied to the new connection.

If Harness already provides a server named `onto`, the plugin reuses it and
skips onboarding. Those external settings remain managed in Harness; the panel
does not overwrite or migrate that connection. A configured but unavailable
connection is shown as configured, with errors when loading spaces.

### Manual Harness configuration (fallback)

Use this when your deployment manages MCP centrally or does not provide a writable
credential provider. If the profile already has an Onto connection, do not add
a second one.

1. Obtain your Onto **MCP endpoint URL** and personal API key from your Onto
   administrator. Use the MCP endpoint, not the ordinary Onto website URL.
2. Open the active profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: normally
   `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` for Web or
   `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml` for Windows Desktop.
   A custom `DSH_HOME` changes the `.dsh` location.
3. Append the following patch, replacing the placeholder URL. If an Onto entry
   already exists, update it instead of creating a duplicate. The server name
   must be exactly `onto`.

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mcp-onto
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: onto
        transport: streamable-http
        url: https://YOUR-ONTO-MCP-HOST/mcp
        headers:
          X-Onto-Api-Key: !!js process.env.ONTO_API_KEY
```

This example uses Onto's `X-Onto-Api-Key` header. Confirm the authentication
scheme with your server administrator if your deployment differs.
A copy is available in [examples/onto-mcp.patch.yml](examples/onto-mcp.patch.yml).

4. Set `ONTO_API_KEY` in the environment of the process that starts Harness.
   For Web on Windows, start it from the same PowerShell window:

```powershell
$env:ONTO_API_KEY = 'YOUR_PERSONAL_API_KEY'
dsh --profile web
```

For Windows Desktop, fully quit Harness first, set the variable above, then
launch the executable from that same PowerShell window. For the default installer
location:

```powershell
& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\DeepSeek Harness.exe"
```

Launching via an existing desktop shortcut does not inherit a variable set only
in this PowerShell window. The variable must be available on every launch.
Enter your real key locally; do not commit it or share terminal history containing it.

5. Open the space selector above the composer. Your accessible spaces should
   appear. You can also ask the model to call `mcp__onto__list_available_realms`.

If connection fails, check the endpoint and network access first. A `401` or
`403` response usually indicates authentication or access rights. If the tools
work in chat but the panel cannot find them, check that `serverName` is `onto`.
Missing agent or memory tools affect those sections separately; an empty list
can also mean your account has no access to those resources.

The transport and environment-variable syntax follow the official
[Harness MCP client configuration](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepse

plugins.description: Inline video and audio for DeepSeek Harness chats: the player appears under the reply, with compact cards, Range streaming and auto-play. · DSH 对话里直接播放视频和音频。
plugins.readme_text: ![hero](assets/hero.png) 让 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的对话流里直接播放本地视频 / 音频：模型录屏、转码、配音生成的文件，回合结束时播放器自动出现在回复正下方——Claude 桌面端 / Codex 同款位置，不用点任何东西，也不用模型专门调工具。说一句「播一下 ~/Movies/a.mp4」也行。 ![demo](assets/demo.gif) ## 安装 ```sh dsh plugin add https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-video-preview/releases/latest/download/dsh-video-preview.tgz ``` 装完**重启 DSH**（客户端代码在 DSH 启动时打包，不重启看不到播放器）。DSH「插件」页里显示为「视频播放」。 开发时可以直接链到本地目录：`dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/path/to/dsh-video-preview`，改了代码同样要重启。 ## 它解决什么 DSH 的消息渲染块只有 text / image / file / table，**没有 video**，工具调用块又默认折叠。这个插件用纯官方插件 API 补上内联播放（零 `@deepseek-ai/*` 依赖，和官方 `present` 工具同款机制）。 一次 `play_video` 调用后，用户能看到： 1. **回复下方的播放器**（主显示位）——小卡片，一个一行： - 视频只露画面（200 高、按原比例），角上标时长；鼠标移上去静音预览、浮出文件名 / 大小 / 下载，点一下从头带声音播 - 音频是一条细条：圆形播放键、文件名、大小、时长、可拖的进度条 - 超过 3 个先折叠成「还有 N 个媒体文件」；同一时间只有一个在出声 - 配色、圆角、字体用 DSH 自己的设计变量，深浅色主题跟着走 2. **交付文件芯片**——点「在侧边栏预览」打开大屏播放器（DSH 原生把 mp4 列为「不可预览」，这里接管） 3. **工具块里的小播放器**（兜底）——展开工具调用块后可见 模型用自带 `present` 工具交付的媒体文件，也会自动出现播放器。 ## 自动播放（不用调工具） 模型这一轮里生成的视频 / 音频（录屏、ffmpeg / avconvert 转码、`say` 配音……），回合收尾时自动挂上播放器： - **怎么找**：从这一轮的命令参数、命令输出、回复正文里挖出媒体文件路径（带空格、中文、`~`、相对路径、shell 转义都认） - **挂哪些**：只挂这一轮里新写出来的文件（刚下载、解压出来的也算），以前就有的不挂；回复正文提到的优先，没提才用命令里的，中间文件不刷屏；一轮最多 8 个 - **不重复**：已经用 `play_video` / `present` 播过的不再挂 - **中途停掉**：来不及在收尾时挂，会在回合结束后补上（重新打开会话可见） ## 用法 对话里直接说「播一下 /Users/me/Movies/a.mp4」，模型会调 `play_video`。参数： | 参数 | 必填 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | `path` | 是 | 本地文件路径（支持 `~`；相对路径按会话的工作目录算） | | `title` | 否 | 播放器标题，默认文件名 | | `autoplay` | 否 | 自动播放（浏览器通常会拦） | | `loop` | 否 | 循环播放 | ## 能播什么 DSH 的播放器是 Chromium 内核，能播什么由它决定： | | 格式 | | --- | --- | | 能播 | 视频 mp4 / m4v / mov / webm / ogv，音频 mp3 / wav / ogg / m4a / aac / flac / opus | | 看编码 | mkv / 3gp：要看文件里的编码，播不了会在播放器下面说明并给出转码命令 | | 播不了 | avi / flv / wmv / wma / ts / mpg / rmvb 等 —— `play_video` 会直接说明，并给出转码命令 | 转码（需要 [ffmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/)，macOS 上 `brew install ffmpeg`）： ```sh ffmpeg -i in.avi -c:v libx264 -c:a aac -movflags +faststart out.mp4 # 视频 ffmpeg -i in.wma -c:a aac out.m4a # 音频 ``` 播放出错时，播放器下面会告诉你是哪种情况：文件被移走了、没有权限、插件没加载（要重启 DSH），还是编码不支持（附转码命令）。 ## 安全 DSH 的本地网页服务本身不做鉴权，浏览器里任何网页都摸得到 `127.0.0.1`，所以两条播放路由自己把门： - **只给媒体文件**：按扩展名判断，软链接按它指向的真实文件算；别的文件一律 403。 - **防 DNS 重绑定和跨站**：Host 必须是本机名或 DSH 自己的地址；跨站请求、Origin 不是 DSH 自己的都拒。 - **签名地址**（`/dsh-video-preview/media`）：token = HMAC(密钥, 文件绝对路径)，密钥存在 `~/.dsh/cache/dsh-video-preview.secret`（0600），同一台机器上跨重启、跨宿主都有效。 - **侧边栏 / 回复下方的地址**（`/dsh-video-preview/preview`，没有 token）：交给 DSH 自己的 `connection` 服务验登录 cookie；老版本 DSH 没有这个服务时只收本机连接。 v0.3.0 之前的版本只看 cookie 名字，网页能伪造 cookie 读到任意文件，请升级。 ## 架构 ``` 服务端 play_video 工具 ──校验文件──▶ 返回带签名的 URL │ └─append deliverables/presented 事件（官方 present 工具同款通道） 自动 session/event 收集这一轮的路径 → agent/turn-stopping 时挑出新文件 → 同一条通道 路由 /dsh-video-preview/media 签名 token · HTTP Range 流式（大文件不进内存） /dsh-video-preview/preview DSH 登录态 · 供侧边栏 / 回复下方的播放器 客户端 turnTail 槽 / documentPreviews 渲染器 / toolview 槽 ``` - `lib/index.js` —— 服务端：工具 + deliverables 事件 + 两条流式路由（读盘出错只断当前请求，不会带崩 DSH） - `lib/auto-present.js` —— 自动播放：挖路径、挑新文件、回合收尾前呈现（回合结束后才 append 的话，界面要重开会话才刷出来） - `lib/client.js` —— 客户端：回复下方播放器 / 侧边栏预览 / 工具块兜底 / 出错诊断（`exports.inject` 是客户端**短服务名**，写包名会一直 pending） - `locale/*.json`、`icon.svg` —— DSH 插件页的卡片标题、说明和图标 - `cordis.patch.yml` —— bundle patch（insert 行的 `name` 必须是完整包名，客户端按它解析 bundle） ## 测试 ```sh node test/test-routes.mjs # 把门、Range、HEAD、读盘出错、工具的格式提示 node test/test-client.mjs # 三个挂载点、视频卡 / 音频条、折叠、出错诊断 node test/test-auto.mjs # 自动播放：新 / 老文件、正文优先、各种路径写法、不重复、重放不动手 ``` ## 已验证 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 桌面端端到端实测：回复下方播放器（mp4 / HEVC 的 mov / m4a，中文文件名）、侧边栏预览和播放、avi 的转码提示、文件被移走后的出错提示；伪造登录 cookie 的请求被拒；模型用 say / avconvert 生成的 m4a、mp4（含带空格的中文文件名）没调 `play_video`，回合结束时播放器实时出现且能播；视频卡悬停预览 / 点击播放 / 下载、音频条播放、超过 3 个时折叠展开、深浅两种主题下的配色。 参考实现：[@goodandready/dsh-image-gen](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@goodandready/dsh-image-gen)（客户端插件套路）与官方 `dsh-tool-present`（deliverables 通道）。

plugins.description: 开源许可合规检查：扫描依赖树，找出 GPL/AGPL 传染、许可未知等风险 —— 发布前、开源前、被审计时跑一遍。
plugins.readme_text: # @deepwhale-cn/dsh-license-guard [![dshfind 收录](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/feely0208/dsh-license-guard?lang=zh)](https://dshfind.com/zh/plugins/feely0208/dsh-license-guard) [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-license-guard) **开源许可与许可证合规**：发版前、开源前、被审计时跑一遍 —— 把 GPL/AGPL 传染、许可未知、缺 LICENSE 这几类风险找出来。 **关键词**：开源许可 · 开源协议 · 许可证合规 · 许可风险 · GPL 传染 · AGPL · 开源合规 · 许可证 **Keywords**: open source license · license compliance · GPL · AGPL · copyleft · license risk **开源许可合规检查** —— 扫依赖树，找出 GPL/AGPL 传染、许可未知等风险。 发布前、开源前、被审计时跑一遍。退出码可挂 CI。 ## 不装它会怎样 你的产物里混进了一个 **GPL 依赖**，你没发现，打包发出去了。 半年后客户审计问：「你用了 GPL 代码，为什么没开源？」—— **GPL 的义务从「分发」那一刻就触发了**，而分发在半年前。 这个检查跑一次几秒钟。 ## 它查什么 | 级别 | 内容 | |---|---| | 🔴 高 | GPL / AGPL —— 强传染 | | 🟡 中 | 许可未知（没写许可证 ≠ 随便用）· 项目缺 LICENSE | | 🟢 低 | LGPL / MPL / EPL · package.json 缺 license 字段 | ## 安装 ```bash # DSH 插件（推荐） dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-license-guard # 或纯 CLI（不依赖 DSH） npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-license-guard ``` ## 用法 ```bash dsh-license-guard # 扫当前目录 dsh-license-guard --demo # 用内置样本看效果 dsh-license-guard --html r.html # 输出 HTML 报告 ``` ![dsh-license-guard 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-license-guard/report.png) ![dsh-license-guard 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-license-guard/demo.png) ![dsh-license-guard 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-license-guard/rules.png) ## 覆盖范围 **5 条规则**，覆盖依赖树的许可风险 + 项目基础文件。 **不覆盖**：专利条款、商标、出口管制、SSPL/BUSL 等非 SPDX 自定义协议。 依赖声明的许可证值可能不准（维护者写错），本工具**不校验其真实性**。 ## 为什么和其他工具不同 它**不只看依赖**，也看**你自己**：项目缺 LICENSE、package.json 缺 license 字段 —— plugins.description: Codex-style Create Workspace dialog for DeepSeek Harness: type a name and the folder is created for you, or pick a folder with a native chooser that remembers where you were.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workspace-create-dialog

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

A **Create Workspace** dialog for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): type a name and go, or pick a folder with a chooser that finally remembers where you were.

![The Create Workspace dialog: a name field, a workspace folder row with a Choose folder button, and a New workspace location row with a Change button](docs/create-workspace.png)

## What it does

Clicking **Add workspace…** in DSH today opens the OS folder dialog immediately. This plugin replaces that with a small dialog that asks two independent questions: what is the workspace called, and where does it live. Answer the first only and it creates the folder for you; answer the second and the folder you picked *is* the workspace.

| You do | You get |
| --- | --- |
| Type a name, press **Create** | A new folder with that name is created under **New workspace location**, registered as a workspace, and a session opens in it |
| Click **Choose folder…** | The native Windows folder dialog, starting **where you left off**, not at some default |
| Choose a folder, leave the name empty | The name fills itself in from the folder's own name |
| Choose a folder, having typed a name | Your name wins — the workspace is registered, then renamed to it |
| Click **Change…** on New workspace location | Pick where name-only workspaces go from now on; the choice is saved and survives restarts |
| Cancel / Esc / click the backdrop | Nothing happens — no folder, no registration |

### The effect, before and after

| | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Creating `my-project` | Create the folder in Explorer first, then hunt for it in the picker | Type `my-project`. Done |
| The folder picker's starting point | The OS default, every single time | The directory you last chose |
| Where new workspaces land | Wherever you navigate to | A location you set once, visible in the dialog, changeable any time |
| Naming a workspace after its folder | Retype the folder name | Auto-filled |

## Install

### From the DSH UI (simplest)

Sidebar → **Plugins** → **Add plugin**, paste this address, click **Install**, then **Enable now**:

```text
https://github.com/LanFeng97/dsh-workspace-create-dialog
```

That box takes a package name, a Git address, a tarball or a local absolute path. A repository URL works because this package ships a `dsh.bundle` patch — DSH checks exactly that before it installs. Restart DeepSeek Harness if the plugin does not come up.

Two things worth knowing: it downloads straight from GitHub, so GitHub has to be reachable (the China-mirror option only covers registry packages, not repository downloads); and DSH does not auto-update third-party plugins yet — upgrading means uninstall + install again.

> Already installed with `tools/install.mjs` below? Run `node tools/install.mjs --uninstall` first, so the profile does not end up with two loader rows for the same id.

### One-line prompt for your agent

If you would rather not click through it:

```text
Install the DSH plugin at https://github.com/LanFeng97/dsh-workspace-create-dialog into my DSH and tell me when to restart.
```

### From the plugin market (once listed)

Search for **dsh-workspace-create-dialog** in [dshmarket](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) and install it in one click. The listing is [pending a PR](contrib/awesome-dsh-plugin/) to [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) (their CI requires the repository to be at least one day old); until it lands, use the routes above and below.

### Manual install from this repository

```sh
git clone https://github.com/LanFeng97/dsh-workspace-create-dialog
cd dsh-workspace-create-dialog
node tools/install.mjs
```

That copies the package into your DSH profile's `node_modules` and appends one loader line to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. It resolves your DSH home the same way the harness does — explicit config, then `$DSH_HOME`, then `~/.dsh`.

**Then restart DeepSeek Harness** (the host half is a Node module, so a config reload alone will not import it). After that, changing `lib/client.js` only needs a page refresh; changing `lib/index.js` still needs a restart.

`node tools/install.mjs --dry-run` prints what it would do without writing anything; `--uninstall` removes the package and its loader row again.

Publishing to npm is **not** required: the market installs from GitHub exactly the same way, and listing is unaffected either way.

## How it works

### It uses the official extension point, not a patch

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` declares a `single` slot where the "pick a directory" step is handed to whichever plugin fills it:

```text
sidebar.workspaces.directoryFlow              ← the sidebar's "Add workspace…"
conversation.hero.workspace.directoryFlow     ← the empty-state entry
```

The owner hands the occupant the whole interaction contract:

```ts
interface DirectoryFlowOwnerProps {
  open: boolean                     // a pick is requested
  busy: boolean                     // the owner is adopting the picked path
  onPicked: (path: string) => void  // report the directory; the owner registers it and opens a session
  onCancel: () => void
  onError: (message: string) => void
}
```

This plugin registers its own occupant into both slots at **priority -100**. A `single` slot renders the lowest-priority entry, the shipped native driver sits at `0`, so this dialog wins (two entries at the *same* priority throw, which is the official protection against ambiguity). Removing the loader line from your profile patch restores the stock behaviour exactly.

### Why the folder dialog is built here instead of reused

The desktop app opens its folder dialog from the Electron main process without a starting directory:

```js
// D:\App\DSH\resources\app.asar → lib/main.js
dialog.showOpenDialog(window, { properties: ['openDirectory', 'createDirectory'] })
```

There is no `defaultPath`, which is exactly why the chooser always starts in the same place. A plugin cannot reach that call: the DSH host is a *child process* of Electron. So `lib/pick-folder.js` opens its own `IFileDialog` — a small C# COM interop compiled and run by the **Windows PowerShell 5.1 that ships with Windows**:

- **no dependencies**: no koffi, no PowerShell 7, no native module to publish;
- compilation happens **in memory** (~120 ms per call), so there is no DLL cache to corrupt or lock;
- the one line that matters is `IFileDialog::SetFolder` — the remembered directory as the starting point;
- the dialog runs in a child process, so a native fault cannot take the host down.

The C# method declaration order must match the COM vtable (`Show=3`, `SetOptions=9`, `SetFolder=12`, `SetTitle=17`, `GetResult=20`). Getting it wrong does not error — it just silently does the wrong thing — so a self-test asserts the order.

## Where name-only workspaces are created

The **New workspace location** is resolved in this order (`lib/base-dir.js`, a pure function):

1. **What you set in the dialog** — highest priority; once you change it, it is yours;
2. **`config.baseDir`** from your profile patch — the value used at install time;
3. **The root of your default workspace** — the parent of the workspace whose directory is named `default-workspace` (a name the harness fixes, independent of UI language). New workspaces land next to it. This is the default for a fresh install;
4. **Fallback** — `<Documents>/deepseek-harness`, or `<home>/deepseek-harness` when there is no Documents folder.

The resolved value is written to the state file, so "what it was on first run" is decided once and only you change it afterwards. `config.baseDir` is a seed, not an order.

## HTTP routes

All four are loopback-guarded (loopback socket + loopback `Host` + same-origin marker; `x-forwarded-for` is never trusted) — they create directories and open windows on the host machine, so nothing off-machine may reach them.

| Route | Method | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/api/dsh-workspace-create/config` | GET | Current location + last directory |
| `/api/dsh-workspace-create/base-dir` | POST | `{"

plugins.description: 密码门禁：打开 DSH 时先显示密码界面，解锁后才能使用；支持手动锁定与自动锁定，密码以 scrypt 单向哈希存储。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lock

给 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）网页版加一道**密码门禁**：打开页面先显示锁定界面，输入密码解锁后才能使用。

## 功能

- **全屏遮罩**：未解锁时覆盖整个界面，阻止直接操作会话
- **手动锁定**：随时一键锁定（侧边栏按钮 + 快捷键）
- **自动锁定**：可配置空闲时长后自动锁定
- **密码安全**：仅存 scrypt 单向哈希，**永不保存明文**
- **界面中英双语**：跟随 DSH 的界面语言设置实时切换（见下方「界面文案（运行时 locale）」）

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:felixpu/dsh-lock
```

安装后重启宿主进程。

## 使用

| 操作 | 方式 |
|---|---|
| 解锁 | 在锁定界面输入密码 |
| 立即锁定 | 侧边栏底部「锁定」按钮 |
| 立即锁定（快捷键） | macOS / Windows：`Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + L`；Linux：`Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + .` |
| 自动锁定时长 | 设置 → 插件 → dsh-lock |

> Linux 用 `Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + .` 而非 `Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + L`：DSH 平台的 Linux 键位白名单
> 不接受「修饰键 + 字母」，为各平台分别声明才不会被校验拒绝。

## 配置

本包不导出 `Config` schema，密码与自动锁定设置由插件自身持久化，通过「设置 → 插件 → dsh-lock」面板管理。

## 安全说明

- 密码以 **scrypt**（N=2^15, r=8, p=1）加盐哈希存储，比对使用常量时间比较
- 解锁后签发的是短期令牌，而非保存密码本身
- 存储位置在插件私有目录下，卸载插件不会把密码留在会话或配置里

> ⚠️ 这是**界面门禁**，不是磁盘加密。它防的是「别人走到你电脑前直接操作 DSH」，
> 不能防止能读取你用户目录下文件的攻击者。

## 宿主贡献

- `inject: ['webServer']`，注册解锁/锁定相关的同源路由
- 无客户端以外的外部依赖
- **不产出面向用户的自然语言**：所有路由响应只回机器可读的 `error` code
  （如 `invalid-password` / `too-many-attempts` / `locked`），由客户端字典翻译。
  宿主无从知道 UI 语言，写死中/英文都会在另一种语言下露馅。
  唯一保留自然语言的地方是宿主**日志**（`ctx.logger.info`），那是给开发者看的。

## 界面文案（运行时 locale）

界面文案走**平台官方 locale 服务**，中英双语：

```js
// client/client.js
inject: ['slots', 'shortcuts', 'locale'],
apply(ctx) {
  ctx.effect(() => ctx.locale.register(NS, { zh, en }), NS + ': dictionaries');
  const t = ctx.locale.bind(NS);
  ctx.slots.register({ name: 'shell.overlay', id: '…', locale: NS }, Veil); // ← 渲染器据此注入 t
}
```

组件从 `props.t` 拿翻译函数，**不需要**自己 `inject: () => ({ t })` ——
槽注册选项里给了 `locale: NS`，渲染器（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer` 的
`standardKit()`）会把绑定好的 `t` 注入 props；缺 locale 插件时它会抛出明确的
`SlotAssemblyError`，而不是静默渲染出 key 名。

约定：

- 一条消息 = 一个完整句子，变量用 `{name}` 占位（如 `'autoLock.minutes': '{n} 分钟'` /
  `'{n} minutes'`）。**不拆片段拼接**，否则中英语序无法重排。
- 键名小写点分层级：`lock.title`、`field.password`、`button.unlock`、
  `error.wrongPassword`、`autoLock.minutes`。
- `retry` / `loading` / `unknown` 等平台 `common` 命名空间已有的通用词**不重复定义**，
  查表未命中会自动回落到 common。
- **zh 与 en 的键必须完全一致**：运行时不校验，漏键只会显示 key 名。故 `apply` 里
  做了一次键一致性自查，不一致时 `console.warn` 点名缺的键。
- 需要本地化的字符串**不能**只存在于源码字面量里 —— 静态审计
  （去掉注释后 grep 中文字符）应只剩注释与宿主日志。

## 展示元数据（locale）

`locale/en.json` 与 `locale/zh.json` 提供**插件展示元数据**（`meta.title` / `meta.description`），
Plugin Manager 与设置页**无需激活插件**即可读取，用于显示本地化的插件名与说明。
这与运行时 UI 文案（客户端 `ctx.locale.register`，见上一节）是**两套互不相关**的东西：
前者是 JSON 资源、由宿主按 Node 模块解析器读取；后者是客户端代码里的字典对象。

```json
{ "meta": { "title": "…", "description": "…" } }
```

⚠️ 两个容易漏的点（漏任一个都会**静默失效**，不报错）：

1. **必须在 `package.json` 的 `exports` 里导出 `./locale/*.json`** —— 宿主经 Node 模块解析器
   读取该资源，未导出的子路径会得到 `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED`，被当作「没有 locale」跳过。
2. **`files` 需包含 `locale`** —— 否则 `pnpm pack` / `npm publish` 的产物里不会带上它。

`icon.svg` 走顶层 `icon` 字段（相对路径），**不需要** `exports`。

## 客户端挂载点

| 槽位 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| 全屏遮罩 | 未解锁时的锁定界面 |
| `sidebar.footer.action` | 「立即锁定」按钮 |
| `plugins.bundle.config` | 自动锁定设置面板 |

客户端 bundle 仅 `require` 平台种子表内的模块（本包只用到 `react`）。
槽位 / 快捷键 / 语言三个服务通过 `package.json` 的 `dsh.client.inject` 声明，
在插件对象 `inject: ['slots', 'shortcuts', 'locale']` 里注入 —— 服务不走 `require`。

快捷键的 `label` 用**函数**（thunk）而非字符串，语言切换后快捷键面板那一行会跟着变；
`aliases` 是快捷键面板的**搜索别名**、平台没有本地化机制，故只放英文
（官方各包一律如此），写死中文会让英文界面下露出中文。

## 许可证

MIT © felixpu

## 仓库

<https://github.com/felixpu/dsh-lock>

plugins.description: GitMate — a smart Git panel for DeepSeek Harness: diffs, generated commit messages, a commit graph with rewind, and .gitignore generation, plus ten agent tools.
plugins.readme_text:
# GitMate

**A Git panel in the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) sidebar — plus the same operations as fifteen agent tools.**

Runs anywhere the Harness does: macOS, Linux, and Windows (PowerShell).

Only two things genuinely differ across platforms, and both live on the Host side: **how arguments are quoted** (PowerShell doubles a single quote, a POSIX shell closes-escapes-reopens; chosen by `process.platform`) and **how the environment is passed** (through the shell request's `env` field rather than a POSIX `VAR=value` prefix, which is not a command on Windows). Nothing else is platform-aware: paths go through `node:path`, nothing outside `lib/` is written, and no file needing an executable bit is created. When the sandbox will not start, the advice **names the cause for the platform you are on** (bubblewrap/Landlock on Linux, `sandbox-exec` on macOS, `%TEMP%` on Windows).

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Review changes, read diffs, stage, commit with a generated message, merge, stash, sync, and rewind history without leaving the panel. Every operation is also a tool the agent can call, so asking in chat works too.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:alanhaskey/dsh-gitmate
```

Restart DSH once, refresh the page, then open **GitMate** from the sidebar's **+** menu.

> The internal ids (Loader row `dsh-git`, tab key) differ from the package name on purpose: the row id is the key of a config row you may already have, and renaming it would orphan your saved settings.

## Reviewing and committing

- **Four groups** — conflicts, staged, changes, untracked. Each row shows the kind in words, the path, and that file's `+N −M`. Row actions stage, unstage, and discard, with a second click for anything destructive.
- **Diffs like an editor** — two line-number gutters, `+`/`−` markers, tinted rows, and only the changed span of a replaced line marked. Click a file to expand it in place; click again to collapse. Widen the context from 3 lines to 24 when a hunk needs more of the file.
- **One row of list actions**, shown only when they would do something, with the counts in the labels.
- **Amend** — fold the staged changes into the previous commit; leaving the message box empty keeps the existing message.
- **A draggable splitter** between the list and the commit card resizes the message box.
- **A panel that is working says so** — every operation shows a turning indicator and names itself ("Committing…", "Reviewing the staged changes…") instead of only greying its buttons out. It sits with the messages at the foot of the list, above the splitter, so it never covers the commit box.

## AI features

| Feature | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Commit message** | Generated from the staged diff. If you have already typed something, the button becomes *Refine draft*: the model keeps your intent and fills in the rest instead of replacing it. |
| **Review before commit** | Reads the staged changes and reports only what would bite — a wrong result, a missed edge case, an unhandled error, a committed secret, debug output left in, a behaviour change with no test. Click a finding to open that file's diff. |
| **Split this commit** | Divides the staged changes into commits that each stand on their own, with a message for each. The plan is a draft you can edit: rewrite any message, merge a group into the one above, remove one, ask for a new plan, commit one group at a time, or commit them all in order. Each commit leaves the other files staged. |
| **Explain a change** | Two to five bullets on what a file's change does, so you can review without reading every line. |
| **`.gitignore`** | Infers the rules from the project's manifests and layout. One button creates it; one adds what is missing **and tidies the whole file** — exact duplicates, rules an earlier broader rule already covers (`node_modules/.cache/` after `node_modules/`), and runs of blank lines. It groups entries under headings only when that cannot change the meaning: with a `!` rule (git decides by the last match, so order is semantic) or with your own comments, the order is kept and the panel says so. |

Buttons that call a model are marked **AI**. Every generation uses the session's default model — there is no second model to configure.

## Branches, history, remotes

- **Branch selector** — switch, create, delete, and merge any branch into the checked-out one. A conflicted merge is reported with the files that need a decision, and can be aborted.
- **Commit graph** — every branch and remote-tracking branch, not just this one. Strokes are computed on the Host and shipped with the data, so "the rows join up" is an assertion rather than something to eyeball. Two things make it hold:

- **The straight runs are elements pinned to the row's bottom**, not coordinates inside a fixed-height box. A row's height is not fixed — expanding a commit makes it much taller — and a fixed box left a gap between every pair of rows, which is what made the tree look like it was floating.
- **When several lanes wait for the same commit, all but the claimed one are released.** Otherwise they keep waiting for a commit already emitted and drag a line to the bottom with no commit on it — the other half of the floating look.

A branch opening here starts **below** the node and one converging here arrives **above** it, each joined to the node by a curve; one hue carries three weights — the commit's own line, the branch curves, and the lanes merely passing through. Expand a commit for its full message, the files it touched, and what you can do to it: rewind, revert, cherry-pick, rebase, or tag. Click a changed file to see its diff inside that commit.
- **Remotes** — push, pull, fetch, and a **Sync** that fetches, fast-forwards, then pushes. It refuses to merge a diverged branch rather than inventing a merge commit.
- **Stash** — set work aside and take it back later (pop, apply, drop).

## Setup

Without a repository the **history button is disabled** — there is no history to show — while **settings stays reachable**, because that is where someone looks when the panel is not doing what they expect. If the repository disappears while the panel is open (the folder changed, `.git` was removed), the view falls back to the change list rather than leaving the button lit on a view that cannot render.



One click initialises a repository and writes the local commit identity; two buttons handle `.gitignore`. Nothing is chosen from a list of ecosystems — the plugin reads the project and decides.

## Configuration

Settings live in this plugin's own row in `cordis.patch.yml`, so they survive upgrades and stay visible on the Plugins page. Everything below is a button or a checkbox; there is nothing to type unless you want custom instructions.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `messageLanguage` | `auto` | Language of generated text: `auto` (follow the repository), `en`, `zh`. When unset or `auto`, the panel's own messages read as Chinese. |
| `messageStyle` | `conventional` | `conventional` (`feat: …`) or `plain`. |
| `messageTemplate` | — | Extra instructions, appended last so they override the defaults. |
| `signoff` | `false` | Add a `Signed-off-by` trailer. |
| `defaultBranch` | `main` | Branch created by *Initialise*. |
| `maxPromptBytes` | `24000` | Diff text handed to the model per change set. |
| `maxDiffBytes` | `80000` | Patch text a tool returns before truncating. |
| `commandTimeoutMs` | `60000` | Per git command; network commands get four times this. |

## Safety

- **Nothing destructive happens on a single click.** Discarding, deleting a branch, dropping a stash, rebasing, and rewinding all ask first, and say what will be lost.
- **Rewinding and reverting are separate**, because they are: rewinding moves the branch and rewrites history, reverting adds an inverse commit and is safe for anything already pushed. The panel warns before a rewind that would rewrite published history.
- **"Undo this commit" and "rewind to here" are separate too.** On the newest commit the button undoes that commit and leaves its changes staged, unstaged, or deleted as you choose; on an older

plugins.description: DSH plugin: give the agent a mouth through the ai-ball floating orb (speak, mood, panel, listen).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ai-ball

> 给 agent 一张嘴：让它通过 [ai-ball](https://github.com/Hyfwdnmd666/ai-ball) 那颗悬浮球说话、做表情、听你打字。

ai-ball 是一个 Windows 悬浮球 —— 它把自己追加到 `monologue.log` 的文字逐字"说"出来、
按 `status.json` 里的 mood 变色、把你打进输入框的话追加到 `input.log`。
**球本身是哑的，它只认文件。**

所以这个插件很薄：它不去操作球的窗口，也不 spawn Python，**它只写球已经在看的那些文件**。
这也是为什么任何进程都能当球的"大脑"。

## 你需要什么

1. **ai-ball 本体**（一个 Python 3.10+ 的目录，里面有 `ball.py`）
2. 把它跑起来（双击 `start.bat`，或 `python ball.py`）

插件本身不包含球，也不会替你安装它。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-ai-ball
```

或者从市场里装。

## 配置

挂在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里：

```yaml
- id: dsh-ai-ball
  name: dsh-ai-ball
  config:
    ballDir: C:\tools\ai-ball        # 必填：放着 ball.py 的那个目录
    startCommand: C:\tools\ai-ball\start.bat   # 可选：ball_launch 用
    cps: 50                          # 可选：球的打字速度，用来估算 wait
    heartbeatMs: 3000                # 可选：心跳间隔，必须小于球那边的 stale_s
    files:                           # 可选：和球自己的 config.json 对齐
      monologue: monologue.log
      input: input.log
      status: status.json
```

也可以走环境变量 `AIBALL_DIR` / `AIBALL_START`。

**`ballDir` 故意没有默认值。** 猜别人把球解压到哪儿了，正是插件往错目录里写文件的方式 ——
所以它宁可报一个说清楚哪里不对的错。

## 六个工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `ball_say` | 说话。追加到 `monologue.log`，球逐字念出来。`clear=true` 先清屏 |
| `ball_mood` | 改球的脸：`idle` / `thinking` / `nervous` / `smug` / `broken` |
| `ball_panel` | 显示 / 收起独白面板 |
| `ball_listen` | 读你在球里打的字（`input.log`），只返回新的 |
| `ball_status` | 报告接线情况：文件大小、最后说了什么、心跳多旧、有没有在心跳 |
| `ball_launch` | 按配置的 `startCommand` 把球拉起来 |

## 两个会让你浪费一下午的坑

### 1. 心跳不是可选项 —— 插件会自己接管它

球把**过期的心跳**读成"大脑死了"并渲染成灰色，而那会**盖掉 mood**。

所以 `ball_mood` 不只是写一次 mood：它同时启动一个心跳，**在插件加载期间一直刷**。
这有两个后果：

- 第一次调 `ball_mood` 之后，球就再也不会因为你没在做事而变灰了（这是对的：
  插件活着 = harness 活着）
- 插件被卸载/重载时心跳会停（挂在 cordis 的 dispose 上，不会泄漏定时器）

一个只写一次 `mood`、不管心跳的实现，看起来像成功了，然后 20 秒后静默失效。

### 2. 如果 `brain.py` 在跑，它每三秒会把你的 mood 踩回 `idle`

`brain.py` 每隔几秒重写整个 `status.json`（心跳是它的）。
两个写者抢同一个文件，后写的赢。

想自己拥有球的脸，在 `brain.json` 里设：

```json
{ "write_mood": false }
```

那样它只刷心跳，文件里现有的 `mood` 原样保留 —— 两个写者就能共存了。

### 3. `ball_panel` 为什么带一个序号

`status.json` 里的 `panel` **不是"当前该是什么状态"，是一条命令**，`panel_seq` 是它的序号。
球只在**序号变化**时动一次。

不这么做的话，插件每几秒重写一次文件，就等于和你抢面板开关：
你收起面板，它下一拍又打开。

带序号之后：

- 你手动开关面板**一直算数**（插件没改变主意，序号没变）
- 插件改变主意时把序号加一，球再执行一次
- **每次调 `ball_panel` 都是新请求**（序号加一），所以"你关掉了，我要它再显示"
  是有效的，不会变成空操作

（球那边没有 `panel_seq` 的 `panel` 一律不执行 —— 没有序号就无法区分"你刚关掉"和
"它一直这么说"，照做就是抢开关。）

## `ball_listen` 为什么不会切坏中文

读游标按**字节**记，而且只推进到**最后一个换行**。

写入方可能被撞见写到一半：游标如果按字符算、或者用替换字符解码尾部，
那半个 UTF-8 序列会变成 U+FFFD **并且永久留在游标后面** —— 内容就再也读不出来了。
停在最后一个换行，残缺的尾巴下次会重新读一遍，这是简单正确的做法。

（同一个 bug、同一个修法，ai-ball 的 Python 侧也有一份。）

## 它不做的事

- **不判断球在不在跑。** `ball_status` 报的是文件状态，不是窗口状态 —— 严格来说，一个没在跑的球
  和一个在跑但没人写的球，看起来是一样的。
- **不会只启动一颗球。** `ball_launch` 是只写的，重复调用会得到两颗球。
- **不渲染 Markdown。** 球是嘴，不是文档。`**强调**` 会原样显示出来。
- **不会替你记住要开面板。** `ball_say` 不会自动显示面板 —— 面板收着的时候它照样写成功，
  只是没人看得见。要保证被看到，先 `ball_panel(true)`。

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: 智小航的渠道保护
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-zhixiaohang-guard

一个宿主插件，承担两件事：

- **A. 智小航专属节流**：只对 `provider = zhixiaohang`（兜底按主机 `token.nuaa.edu.cn`）做 10 次/分钟滑动窗口排队；其它 provider（如 `deepseek-account`）**零延迟直通**。
- **B. 校外乱码入路屏蔽**：没连校园网/VPN 时网关返回的整页 HTML（含巨型 base64）在**落盘之前**被换成一句 <200 字符短提示；原文一个字节都不进会话记录、模型上下文与日志。

纯 JS、零依赖、单文件 ESM（`index.mjs`），不需要 python、不需要构建。

---

## 可观测性（v1.1.0：怎么确认插件真的激活了）

宿主**主进程日志不落盘**（`%APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\logs` 只有崩溃日志），
`dsh --profile desktop --dump-config` 也会被 `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application` 拒绝——
所以从外面**看不到**任何加载记录。为此插件自带信号：

1. **状态文件**：挂载时写 `<DSH_HOME>/zhixiaohang-guard/status.json`
   （默认 `C:\Users\<你的用户名>\.dsh\zhixiaohang-guard\status.json`），含 `mountedAt` / `pid` /
   `module`（实际加载的文件路径）/ `listeners`（两个钩子是否注册）/ `selfTest`（自检结果）/
   `stats` / `lastEvents`。
2. **只读状态页**：<http://127.0.0.1:19387/zhixiaohang-guard>（JSON 在 `/zhixiaohang-guard/api/status`）。

重启后判断"到底装上了没有"，只看两条：

- 状态文件存在，且 `selfTest.ok === true`、`listeners['llm/stream'] === true`、`listeners['agent/request-error'] === true`；
- `module` 指向 `C:/Users/<你的用户名>/.dsh/plugins/zhixiaohang-guard/index.mjs`（而不是工作区里的那份）。

`selfTest` 是插件在**自己进程内**拿一段"校外乱码"样本跑一遍真实净化路径：`detectedOffCampus: true`、
`noticeChars: 97`、`noticeLeakFree: true` —— 说明净化链路在该进程内确实工作，而不只是"文件被读进去了"。

计数器（`stats` / `lastEvents`）在命中时刷新：`paced`（节流排队次数）、`sanitized`（乱码屏蔽次数）、
`claimed`（认领次数）、`emptyStreams` / `emptyStreamRetries`、`retryAfterEnriched`。

---

## 为什么挂在 `llm/stream`（实测依据，不是猜的）

宿主 0.2.0-rc.2 的请求路径（源码位置均已核对）：

```
agent loop step()
  └─ preparedCall.stream(request)                    dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:1072
       └─ LlmRuntime.streamWithRegistration()
            └─ ctx.waterfall(this, 'llm/stream', …)  dsh-llm/lib/index.js:2371   ← 本插件在这里
                 └─ adapterStream() → openai SDK → 网关
  └─ live.push(chunk)  →  assistant/attempt 落盘      dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:1119-1123
  └─ dispatch.waterfall('agent/request-error', …)     dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:1124  ← 已经太晚
```

关键事实：

1. `llm/stream` 是**官方公开**的 waterfall，签名 `(options, next) => AsyncIterable<StreamChunk>`，官方 invariant 自己就这么注册（带 `{ global: true, prepend: true }`）。
2. 失败**先落盘再进** `agent/request-error`：`finish` 分片被 `assistant-stream` 原样记入紧凑流（`dsh-llm/lib/types/assistant-stream.js:105`）。所以只改 `request-error` 里的消息**拦不住落盘**——必须在 `llm/stream` 处就改。
3. 跨 fiber 监听服务事件必须 `global: true`，否则被 context filter 丢掉（`cordis/src/events.ts:116,173`）。

### 校外乱码的两条真实形态

| 网关响应 | 走到哪里 | 表现 |
|---|---|---|
| 非 2xx + HTML | openai SDK 异常消息里**装着整页 HTML** | `code = SERVER`（5xx）或 `AUTH`（401/403）；pi-ai 的 4000 字符上限**不生效**（它只对"body 未被 SDK 折进 message"的错误生效，见 `pi-ai/dist/utils/error-body.js:23`） |
| 200 + HTML | SSE 解析不出任何事件 | pi-ai 抛 `Stream ended without finish_reason`（34 字节）→ `code = TRANSPORT`；**不带乱码**，但用户只看到看不懂的英文 |

本机 4 个会话日志全量扫描（2026-10-10）实证：

| 失败 | 次数 | 消息长度 | 是否携乱码 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SERVER` | 50 | 最长 **316,850 字节** | 是（PNG 魔数 + base64 + HTML + "仅限校内访问"） |
| `TRANSPORT` `Stream ended without finish_reason` | 60 | 34 字节 | 否 |
| `RATE_LIMIT` `429 upstream_capacity_exhausted` | 264 | 197 字节 | 否（含 `retry_after_seconds`） |

---

## 行为

### 节流（A）
- 滑动窗口（默认 `rpm: 10, windowMs: 60000`）：窗口内满额时**排队等待**到有名额再发，不报错。
- 等待可取消：`signal` 中止时不再发起请求，改为产出协议里规范的 `aborted` finish。
- 队列打满（默认 512）时直接放行——宁可少节流，也不卡死会话。
- 非目标 provider 完全不进这个分支，不建定时器，延迟恒为 0。

### 屏蔽（B）
- 改写终止 `finish.reason.failure`：`message` → 短提示，`code` → `ZHIXIAOHANG_OFF_CAMPUS`，其余字段（如 `status`）保留。
- 提示 = 默认文案 +（能从原文清理出"仅限校内访问"整句时）附上该句，总长截到 `maxNoticeChars`。
- 同时在 `agent/request-error` 用 `{ global: true, prepend: true }` **抢先认领**该失败且不调用 `next()`：
  判定为"需要用户操作、不可重试"，避免 `dsh-llm-error-retry` 按 429 规则做 60s×N 空转。
- 防御性兜底：若乱码以 `text-delta` / `reasoning-delta` 正文形式出现（实测未出现），也会被换成短提示。

### 空白流（真机 60 次的那种）
- 默认先**自动重发 1 次**（仅当这一轮还没吐出任何内容时；已有正文则不重发，避免重复输出）。
- 重发成功 → 用户完全看不到错误；仍失败 → 换成中性短提示，保留 `TRANSPORT` code。
- 与已装的 `dsh-llm-finish-reason-tolerance` **互补不冲突**：那个插件只把"已吐内容"的空白流提升为成功，一个内容都没吐时它明确放行错误——正是本插件处理的部分。

### 空流其实是"网关上游容量不足"的另一副面孔（v1.2.0，真机复现）

2026-10-10 直接对网关做流式复现（`tools/probe-stream.mjs`，4 次全中）：

```
#1 429 {"message":"All upstream providers are cooling down. Please retry after 44 seconds.",
        "type":"upstream_capacity_exhausted","retry_after_seconds":44,"code":"circuit.upstream_capacity_exhausted"}
#2 429 retry_after_seconds: 43      #3 429 :42      #4 429 :42
```

同一时刻 `GET /v1/models`（带 key）返回 200 + 23,877 字节模型表 —— **链路与鉴权都正常**，是网关自己的上游在冷却。
也就是说：**校外的 200+HTML 与上游容量的 200+空流是两种不同的东西**，旧文案把后者说成"没连 VPN"是误导，v1.2.0 已改。

因此 v1.2.0 增加 `emptyStreamAsRateLimit`（默认开）：只要本插件**最近**在 429 失败消息里解析到过 `retry_after_seconds`（窗口 `capacityHintTtlMs`，默认 180s），
就把空流改写成

```
code: RATE_LIMIT, providerRetryAfterMs: <服务端提示>, message: "429: 网关上游容量不足（由空白流识别，服务端提示约 42s）…"
```

于是这次失败会**流回 `dsh-llm-error-retry`**（本插件只在"校外乱码"时认领失败，RATE_LIMIT 一律放行），按冷却自动重试，而不是丢一句死胡同提示让人干等。
没有任何容量证据时（例如纯粹的流被掐断），才走"重发 1 次 → 中性提示"的老路。

### 429 的 `retry_after_seconds` 修复
网关把 `retry_after_seconds` 写在消息 JSON 里，宿主却没填进 `failure.providerRetryAfterMs`。本插件（`honorRetryAfterSeconds: true`，默认开）从消息里解析并补上该字段，让重试插件尊重服务端提示（封顶 1 小时）。

---

## 配置

写在 `cordis.patch.yml` 那一行的 `config` 里，全部有默认值：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: zhixiaohang-guard
      name: 'file:///C:/Users/<你的用户名>/.dsh/plugins/zhixiaohang-guard/index.mjs'
      config:
        pace: true
        rpm: 10
        windowMs: 60000
        providers: [zhixiaohang]
        hosts: [token.nuaa.edu.cn]
        sanitize: true
        notice: '⚠️ 智小航：当前不在校园网/VPN，校内系统拒绝访问。请连接校园 VPN 后重试。服务热线 (025)84890123'
        reminderKeys: [仅限校内访问, 校内访问, 综合服务门户, 校园网]
        weakReminderKeys: [VPN, vpn, 校外]
        weakKeysRequireCorroboration: true
        maxNoticeChars: 200
        offCampusCode: ZHIXIAOHANG_OFF_CAMPUS
        maxWaiters: 512
        emptyStreamRetries: 1
        emptyStreamBackoffMs: 1500
        emptyStreamNotice: '⚠️ 智小航：网关流式响应被中断（未返回结束原因），已自动重试仍未恢复。若持续如此请稍后重试；若在校外请先连接校园 VPN。'
        emptyStreamAsRateLimit: true
        capacityHintTtlMs: 180000
        honorRetryAfterSeconds: true
        precheck: false
        precheckTtlMs: 60000
        forceIpv4: true
        forceIpv4Hosts: [token.nuaa.edu.cn]
        forceIpv4Mode: auto
        forceIpv4Probe: true
```

### 强制 IPv4（v1.3.0）

需求是"调用智小航时让 DSH 强制走 IPv4"。踩点结论与实测：

- 请求通道：pi-ai 的 `profileOptions()` **不注入自定义 fetch**，openai SDK 用的是 Node 内置 `fetch`
  → 而宿主自带的 `dsh-http-proxy` 正是靠"替换 undici 全局派发器"来接管它（`dsh-http-proxy/lib/index.js:403-450`），
  因为 Node 内置 fetch 读的是同一个 `Symbol.for('undici.globalDispatcher.1')`。
- 因此本插件用**同一套路**：包一层派发器，**只**把 `forceIpv4Hosts` 里的主机换成 `connect.family = 4` 的连接池，
  其余主机原样 `dispatch` 给原派发器 —— 代理链路、其它 provider 全不受影响（`dsh-http-proxy` 用自己的 Agent 时也照旧）。
- 有代理时（`HTTPS_PROXY` 等且未命中 `NO_PROXY`）改走 `ProxyAgent`，并让到代理的连接也走 IPv4，保留代理。
- `undici` 从 profile 的 `node_modules` 解析（插件目录里没有 node_modules）；解析或安装失败时按 `forceIpv4Mode: auto`
  退回 `dns.setDefaultResultOrder('ipv4first')` + `net.setDefaultAutoSelectFamily(false)`（这一步是进程级、影响面更大，日志会写明）。

**实测（`node tools/test-ipv4.mjs`，同端口同时监听 127.0.0.1 与 ::1）：**

| 观测 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 安装前 `http://localhost` | 落在 **IPv6**（本机确实优先 IPv6） |
| 安装后同一请求 | 落在 **IPv4** ✅ |
| 未列入名单的主机 / `[::1]` 直连 | 不受影响（IPv6 仍可用）✅ |
| 卸载后 | 恢复原派发器 ✅ |
| `token.nuaa.edu.cn` 的 A / AAAA | `10.0.241.133` / `2001:da8:1006:1001::101`（**有 AAAA**） |
| `token.nuaa.edu.cn` 的 getaddrinfo（fetch 真正用的那条） | **只返回 IPv4** |

⚠️ **诚实的结论**：机制已验证有效，但在当前网络状态下 `getaddrinfo` 对智小航只返回 IPv4，
所以对"今天的空流问题"它是**无害的空操作**（不是解药）；当某天解析器同时给出 AAAA 时它才会真正起作用。
空流的根因仍是网关上游容量（见上一节），这条只是把 IPv6 这条潜在不稳定路径提前堵上。
状态页里会记录 `ipv4.mode / previousDispatcher / dnsRecords / connectProbe`，可直接核对当时是否真的需要它。

几个需要解释的**偏离字面需求**的设计判断：

- `weakReminderKeys`（`VPN`/`vpn`/`校外`）默认必须与页面特征（HTML/base64/data URI）**同时**出现才算命中（`weakKeysRequireCorroboration: true`）。否则模型正常回答里提到"VPN"就会被整段替换掉。要退回"任一关键词命中即判定"的字面规则，把这一项设为 `false`。
- `precheck` 默认关（按你的要求）；打开后，识别到校外会在 TTL 内直接快速失败，不再白跑请求。
- 空白流默认重发 1 次。若你更希望"校外就不重发"，设 `emptyStreamRetries: 0`（仍会换成中文短提示）。

---

## 验证（可复跑）

```powershell
$node = 'C:\Users\<你的用户名>\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe'
$py   = 'C:\Users\<你的用户名>\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe'

# 1) 假时钟节流单测：第 11 次必须等待、取消可中断、配置回落
& $node tools\test-pacer.mjs

# 2) 入路实测：本地假网关用真实校外 HTML，真 openai SDK 取真实失败

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness agent preset: Codex and Claude Code as delegation subagents, each at a read-only and full-access tier. Use either — or both in parallel — in one task.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-preset-codex-claude

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Magica-Chen/dsh-preset-codex-claude.svg)](https://github.com/Magica-Chen/dsh-preset-codex-claude/blob/main/LICENSE)
[![verify: passing](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/Magica-Chen/dsh-preset-codex-claude/verify.yml?branch=main&label=verify)](https://github.com/Magica-Chen/dsh-preset-codex-claude/actions/workflows/verify.yml)
![DeepSeek Harness agent preset](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-agent%20preset-blue.svg)
![Node.js 18+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-18%2B-339933.svg)
![Codex subagent](https://img.shields.io/badge/Codex-subagent-000000.svg)
![Claude Code subagent](https://img.shields.io/badge/Claude%20Code-subagent-D97757.svg)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) **agent preset** that offers
**Codex** and **Claude Code** as delegation subagents, each at a read-only and a full-access tier —
so one session can use either worker, or dispatch both at once on the same task.

```text
subagent_codex               Codex        full access
subagent_codex_readonly      Codex        read-oriented
subagent_claude_code         Claude Code  full access
subagent_claude_readonly     Claude Code  hard read-only
```

It uses the **official** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-claude-code`
providers — no reimplementation. Codex runs over its own `app-server` protocol; Claude Code runs over
the official Agent SDK.

## What this gives you

DeepSeek Harness normally hands one model the whole task. This preset adds two *external* workers you
can delegate to from inside a session:

- **Pick the worker per task.** Codex and Claude Code have different strengths and different failure
  modes. You are no longer choosing one for the whole conversation.
- **Pick the permission tier per task.** Each vendor is registered twice — a read-only tier for
  analysis and a full-access tier for changes that need to write files and run tests.
- **Run both at once.** The delegation tools accept `run_in_background`, so you can dispatch Codex and
  Claude Code on independent parts of the same problem, then reconcile their answers.

It is a thin, declarative layer: four provider registrations and four tools, all using the official
providers. No forks, no wrappers, no reimplementation of either agent.

```text
                    ┌─────────────────────────────┐
   your session ───▶│ subagent_codex              │  Codex        full access
   (any model)      │ subagent_codex_readonly     │  Codex        read-oriented
                    │ subagent_claude_code        │  Claude Code  full access
                    │ subagent_claude_readonly    │  Claude Code  hard read-only
                    └─────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## ⚠️ Read this first: the install is two steps

This preset's provider rows are resolved by the DSH loader against the **dsh installation directory**,
*not* your profile. A profile-installed bundle cannot reach them. That is why this is not a
one-command install, and why the preset alone will show **“Failed to load”** if the providers are
missing.

**Step 1 — install the provider packages into the dsh installation.**
Re-run this after every DSH upgrade, because an upgrade will drop them:

```bash
DSH_INSTALL="$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$(command -v dsh)")")")"
npm install --no-save --prefix "$DSH_INSTALL" \
  @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex@0.2.0-rc.2 \
  @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-claude-code@0.2.0-rc.2
```

Version matching is not cosmetic. If a provider resolves to a different version than the host, it
registers into its **own** copy of the `ctx.subagents` service instead of the host singleton, and
delegation fails silently. `doctor` checks this.

**Step 2 — install this preset into your profile:**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Magica-Chen/dsh-preset-codex-claude
```

Then verify. This package is not on npm, so run the preflight from the installed copy:

```bash
node "$HOME/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-preset-codex-claude/bin/doctor.mjs"
```

Restart dsh and create a **new** session — the mode appears in the preset picker.

> No git? You can also clone the repo and point `dsh plugin add` at the local directory:
> `dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-preset-codex-claude`

## Requirements

- Node ≥ 18
- A DSH **web** profile (`dsh web`)
- At least one product CLI on `PATH`, authenticated:
  - `codex` — `codex login` (or `OPENAI_API_KEY`)
  - `claude` — `claude login` (or `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`)

You do not need both. Tiers whose CLI is absent simply cannot run.

## Use

Pick **“Codex + Claude Code”** in the mode selector of a new session, then delegate:

```text
subagent_codex task="Run the test suite and fix the two failures in parser.js"
subagent_claude_code task="Review the diff on this branch for security issues"
```

Every subagent starts **fresh without your conversation**, so its prompt must be self-contained.

Both products accept `run_in_background`, so a session can dispatch both independently and reconcile
the results. Pairing is *offered*, not mandated — the persona says so explicitly.

### Permission tiers — what they actually mean

| Tool | Native mode | Writes files | Runs commands |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subagent_claude_code` | `bypassPermissions` | ✅ | ✅ |
| `subagent_claude_readonly` | `dontAsk` | ❌ | ❌ (Bash denied) |
| `subagent_codex` | `dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox` | ✅ | ✅ |
| `subagent_codex_readonly` | `never` | inherits your `~/.codex` config | inherits |

Two of these are counter-intuitive, and both are consequences of running unattended:

- **Claude's read-only tier is a hard block.** Every non-bypass mode installs
  `canUseTool: () => deny`, and with no human attached anything needing approval is refused — including
  **Bash**. So a Claude subagent cannot run tests or builds unless it is in `bypassPermissions`.
  `acceptEdits` is not a middle ground: it auto-accepts file writes and still denies Bash.
- **Codex's read-only tier is advisory, not enforced.** The `never` mode sends no `sandbox` field, so
  Codex inherits whatever your own Codex config says. Only Claude's tier is a guarantee.

## Caveats

- **An existing session keeps the preset it started with.** You must create a new session after
  installing; restarting dsh alone does not retro-fit open conversations.
- **A broken preset is cached for the life of the process.** If it failed to load, reloading the page
  will not help — restart dsh.
- **Delegation is one-shot.** These providers expose no continuable mode, so you cannot `send_message`
  to a Codex/Claude child afterwards (unlike in-harness `subagent` / `subagent_fork`).
- **The full-access tiers are genuinely unrestricted**: `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox`
  and `--bypassPermissions`. That is what makes them useful unattended, and it means they can modify
  anything the process can reach. Prefer the read-only tiers when you only need analysis.
- These providers declare `NO_START_CAPABILITIES`, so per-child `toolFilter` and `persona` are **not**
  available. Permission level is fixed per provider registration, which is why this preset registers
  each vendor twice rather than exposing one provider with a switch.

## How it works

The preset declares four host-plane provider registrations plus four delegation tools. Providers
register on the process-wide `ctx.subagents` singleton, so their names must stay unique across the
whole process — hence the distinct `codex-readonly` / `claude-readonly` names.

`cordis.patch.yml` is **generated**. `generate-patch.py` holds the canonical row list and the persona,
and is the single source of truth; it writes the patch atomically so the installed copy is never
partially written. To change the mode, edit the generator and run:

```bash
npm run build      # python3 generate-patch.py
```

### The preflight

`bin/doctor.mjs` exists to replace an otherwise opaque failure. It verifies the installation anchor
resolves, that both providers resolve **from the installation** at the host's exact version, that the
CLIs are present

plugins.description: DSH File Converter: local file conversion across 20 tool chains and 1000+ format pairs — convert files, query the format matrix, and check converter availability via model tools.  DSH 文件格式转换插件：跨 20 个转换器、覆盖 1000+ 格式对，以模型工具提供本地文件转换、格式矩阵查询与转换器可用性检测
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-converter

[**English**](README.md) | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A **file conversion plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness)**. It provides a conversion engine
that covers **20 tool chains / 1000+ format pairs**
(images / audio-video / documents / e-books / 3D / spreadsheets ...) and runs entirely through
external CLIs (`ffmpeg`, `pandoc`, `libreoffice`, `imagemagick`, `vips`, `calibre`, ...) or pure JS (`vcf`),
exposed to the model as tools.

DSH framework docs: <https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/develop/basic/>

## 1. Tools

| Tool                | Purpose                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `convert_file`      | Convert a local file: `{ inputPath, to, from?, outputPath?, converter? }`. Output defaults to the input directory (same name, new extension). Unsupported pairs return the list of available targets; missing converter returns the install command |
| `list_conversions`  | Query the format matrix: pass `from` to get that format's convertible targets (grouped by converter); omit it for a full category overview             |
| `check_converters`  | Detect which converter CLIs are available on this machine (with version numbers)                                                                        |

## 2. Installation

### From npm / GitHub

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-converter                        # install from npm
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ai-tool-labs/dsh-converter    # or from GitHub
# Desktop: open the "Plugins" panel in the sidebar → click "Add Plugin" → type "dsh-converter" → Install
# Restart harness after installing to take effect (Desktop: restart the App; Web: restart dsh web)
```

### From source (developer)

```bash
# 1) Build
pnpm install && pnpm --filter dsh-converter build

# 2) Install into a profile (example: web profile)
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-plugins/packages/dsh-converter
```

### Enable in the profile

Append the following to `<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (the shipped `cordis.patch.yml` shows all
options, commented out):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: file-converter
      name: dsh-converter
      config:
        enableTools: true
        enableSkill: true
        maxFileSizeMb: 500      # per-file size limit (default 500MB, matches the Web version)
        timeoutMs: 300000       # external CLI timeout (default 5 minutes)
```

## 3. Converter dependencies

`check_converters` tells you which converters are missing; install commands per platform:

| Converter   | Purpose                 | macOS                             | Ubuntu                       | Windows                  |
| ----------- | ----------------------- | --------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| ffmpeg      | Audio / video / GIF     | `brew install ffmpeg`             | `apt install ffmpeg`         | `choco install ffmpeg`   |
| pandoc      | Universal doc conversion| `brew install pandoc`             | `apt install pandoc`         | `choco install pandoc`   |
| libreoffice | Office / PDF            | `brew install --cask libreoffice` | `apt install libreoffice`    | `choco install libreoffice` |
| imagemagick | Images                  | `brew install imagemagick`        | `apt install imagemagick`    | `choco install imagemagick` |
| vips        | Images (high-perf)      | `brew install vips`               | `apt install libvips-tools`  | `choco install vips`     |
| calibre     | E-books                 | `brew install --cask calibre`     | `apt install calibre`        | `choco install calibre`  |
| inkscape    | Vector graphics         | `brew install --cask inkscape`    | `apt install inkscape`       | `choco install inkscape` |
| xelatex     | LaTeX → PDF             | `brew install --cask mactex`      | `apt install texlive-xetex`  | install MiKTeX           |
| vcf         | Contacts vcf → csv      | ✅ pure JS, no install            | ✅                            | ✅                       |

See `src/engine/installCommands.ts` for the full list (all 20 tool chains, per-platform commands).

## 4. Architecture

```
src/index.ts          —— entry: Config / inject / apply
src/tools.ts          —— convert_file / list_conversions / check_converters
src/skills.ts         —— file-conversion skill (teaches the model how to use it)
src/engine/           —— ported conversion engine (logic identical to the original project)
  ├── registry.ts           —— format-matrix pure data + query functions (no Node deps)
  ├── fileTypeCategories.ts —— extension → category (pure data)
  ├── normalizeFiletype.ts  —— format alias normalization (jfif→jpeg, md→markdown, ...)
  ├── main.ts               —— mainConverter: auto-select converter + path/Buffer I/O
  └── <converter>.ts        —— 20 converters (ffmpeg/pandoc/vips/vcf/...)
```

### Key differences from the Web version

1. **File I/O**: input and output are local paths (the Web version uses HTTP upload + OSS storage);
2. **Timeout & cancellation**: injected through the engine's `execFileOverride` extension point —
   external CLI timeouts (`timeoutMs` config) auto-kill, and cancellation of the tool call
   (`exec.signal`) terminates the child process immediately without leaving zombies;
3. **Self-healing errors**: unsupported pairs return `availableTargets`, missing converters return
   install commands — the model can self-correct instead of failing repeatedly;
4. **Diagnosable**: `check_converters` exposes CLI availability to the model.

### Engine notes

- The engine is written in TypeScript with **zero third-party dependencies** (Node built-ins only):
  - imports use relative paths;
  - `main.ts` is the main converter and exposes an `execFileOverride` extension point (used for timeout / cancellation);
  - `detectOS()` is implemented for a Node environment (rather than browser UA detection).
- Because the engine has no runtime dependencies, it is self-contained and easy to maintain.

## 5. Development

```bash
pnpm --filter dsh-converter typecheck   # type check
pnpm --filter dsh-converter build       # tsc → build/
pnpm --filter dsh-converter smoke       # smoke test:
                                                   #   vcf→csv (pure JS) real conversion,
                                                   #   unsupported-format error hints,
                                                   #   format-matrix query, unload cleanup
```
