powershell -

plugins.description: Colored session tags for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar - tag a session from its row, see it at a glance, and filter history by tag.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sidebar-tags

[![ci](https://github.com/ysefu/dsh-sidebar-tags/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ysefu/dsh-sidebar-tags/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

**Colored session tags for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.** Tag any session from
its own row, see the tag at a glance, and filter your whole history by tag from
a dedicated sidebar panel.

[中文说明](README.zh.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · MIT

---

## Why

A long-running Harness install turns into hundreds of sessions across several
workspaces. The sidebar can show them, search them and archive them, but there
is no way to say *"this one is a client deliverable"* or *"come back to this on
Friday"* — and no way to get those sessions back as a set.

This plugin adds exactly that layer, and nothing else:

| | |
|---|---|
| **Tags on the row** | A colored dot (plus `+n`) at the start of the session row |
| **Tag from the row** | An entry in the row's "…" menu and a hover button, both a one-click picker |
| **Tag on hover** | The hover card lists the session's tags and its note |
| **Tag panel** | A sidebar panel: per-tag counts, one-click filtering, full-text search over titles and notes, jump to session, create/rename/recolor/delete tags, export/import a backup |

It is a pure client-side plugin: no host routes, no files outside the browser, no
model-facing content, no changes to any shipped Harness file. Data lives in
`localStorage` and can be exported as JSON at any time.

## Install

```bash
# from npm (once published)
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-sidebar-tags

# from a checkout of this repository
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-sidebar-tags
```

Then restart that profile (or reload the Web GUI). The plugin appears in the
sidebar as **Session tags**.

Uninstall:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-sidebar-tags
```

## Use

1. Hover a session row and click the tag button, or open the row's **…** menu and
   use **Tag this session…**.
2. Pick one or more tags. The row gets a colored dot immediately.
3. Open **Session tags** in the sidebar to see counts per tag, filter the list,
   search titles and notes, and manage the tag set itself.
4. Tags are stored per browser profile. Use **Export a backup** in the panel to
   keep a copy, and **Import a backup** to bring it to another browser.

Six tags ship with the plugin (To do / Doing / Important / Reference /
Archivable / Idea); all of them can be renamed, recolored or deleted, and new
ones can be created in the panel.

## Compatibility

| Harness | Status |
|---|---|
| `0.2.0-rc.2` | tested (see "How this was verified") |
| `0.2.0-rc.1` | expected compatible (same slot contract) |
| older lines | the plugin stays dormant and logs nothing; the seats it needs did not exist |

The plugin contributes only to seats the shell declares
(`sidebar.panellist`, the keyed `main`, `sidebar.session.row.leading`,
`sidebar.session.row.hover`, `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item`,
`sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action`) and every registration goes through
`ctx.slots.inject`. A shell without a seat never runs the callback, so a future
Harness that renames a seat degrades to "this one feature is missing" instead of
breaking the boot.

### Known limits

- **The row dot is a resting-state marker.** The host renders
  `sidebar.session.row.leading` only while a row's primary state is idle; a row
  that is running, waiting for approval or carrying an unread completion shows
  the host's own status dot there instead. The tags are still visible in the
  hover card, the row menu and the panel.
- **`localStorage` is per browser profile.** Clearing site data clears tags;
  private windows start empty. Export a backup if that matters.
- **Sessions deleted outside the Harness** may leave a record behind; the panel
  prunes records for sessions the host no longer lists the next time it opens.
- The panel lists the sessions the current page knows about, plus remembered
  titles for tagged sessions that are no longer loaded.

## How this was verified

Everything below is runnable from a checkout with plain Node (no bundler, no
network):

```bash
node scripts/build.mjs                 # bundle + manifest guard (34 invariants)
node scripts/test.mjs                  # 34 unit tests, in one process
node --test "tests/**/*.test.mjs"      # the same tests through Node's own runner
```

`scripts/verify-browser.mjs <gui-url>` drives a headless Chromium over the
DevTools protocol against a live instance and asserts that the stylesheet is
injected, the panel row exists, selecting it mounts the panel, and the panel
renders — useful in CI with a browser available. `lab/index.html` (served by
`node tools/serve.mjs`) renders the same bundle in a stand-in shell so the UI can
be inspected without installing anything.

State that has actually been observed, not just intended:

- the loader mounts the plugin from a profile `link:` install, and the host
  serves `dsh-sidebar-tags/client.js` in the profile's boot graph;
- `scripts/build.mjs` and the unit suite pass on Node 24;
- the four row/panel components, the store and the projections are covered by
  the unit tests at the level of registration contract and pure functions.

Not yet observed: a click-through of the rendered panel inside a real Harness
window. The environment this plugin was written in had no browser that could
start (sandbox) — that check is the first thing to run on a normal desktop, and
`scripts/verify-browser.mjs` automates it.

## How it works

```
sidebar.panellist ──► panel row (icon)          ┐
main (key = sidebar-tags) ──► the panel page    │  registered with ctx.slots.inject,
sidebar.session.row.leading ──► the row dot     │  so load order never matters and a
sidebar.session.row.hover ──► tags + note       │  shell without the seat stays quiet
sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item ──► picker │
sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action ──► picker┘

localStorage ──► TagsDb ──► snapshot store ──► components (React.useSyncExternalStore)
                                 ▲
                    pure functions: validate, migrate, toggle, prune, filter
```

Panel data comes from the Harness' own Cordis stores (`sessions.list`,
`uiSession.sessionStatus`, `workspaces.list`) read through `getSnapshot()` and
`subscribe()` — the same observables the shipped sidebar reads, so no extra
polling, RPC or duplicate cache exists.

### Why no build step

`lib/client.js` is hand-written CommonJS wrapped in the one call the Harness
loader expects:

```js
window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: 'dsh-sidebar-tags', factory: (require) => { … } })
```

The only module it requires is `react`, which every shell provides. That means
the published artifact is the source: a checkout is installable and reviewable
as-is, `git diff` shows behaviour, and there is no toolchain to trust or keep
current. `scripts/build.mjs` replaces a bundler with a structural check —
wrapper shape, bundle id versus package name, patch row versus package name,
region index versus file body, and syntax. The trade-off is no TypeScript and no
tree-shaking, which a plugin of this size does not miss; if that changes, the
module boundaries are already laid out as `@region` sections for a move to
`tsdown`.

## Repository layout

```
lib/index.js            host half (inert: the plugin is browser-only)
lib/client.js           browser half — the shipped bundle
cordis.patch.yml        the bundle patch layer that mounts the plugin
scripts/build.mjs       bundle and manifest guard
scripts/test.mjs        in-process test entry
scripts/verify-browser.mjs  headless-Chromium smoke check
scripts/sandbox-install.mjs install into a throwaway profile
scripts/publish-github.mjs  create + push the repository over the REST API (no git needed)
tests/                  34 unit tests + the fake-shell harness
lab/index.html          stand-in shell that renders the bundle in a browser
tools/serve.mjs         throwaway static server for the lab
```

## Contributing

Issues and PRs are welcome. Please run `node scripts/build.mjs && node
scripts/test.mjs` bef

plugins.description: 极简匹配DSH官方风格的计费卡片. 会话与轮次费用估算插件，支持多价格源、模型独立币种和 DeepSeek 峰谷计费。
plugins.readme_text:
# @guojinpeng/dsh-cost-meter

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

This plugin shows estimated session and turn costs in DSH.
Use DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or later.
Tests use DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.

![Session and turn cost overview](docs/images/overview.png)

## Install

1. Install the npm package:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add -w @guojinpeng/dsh-cost-meter
```

2. Restart DSH.
3. Open **Plugins**.
4. Select **@guojinpeng/dsh-cost-meter** to change prices.

Replace `web` with your profile name.
If you used the old unscoped package, disable it before you install this package.

Install published versions from npm. npm provides the built package.
GitHub contains the source code and release notes.

## Features

- Shows session and completed-turn cost estimates. The session chip sits in the composer, and the turn chip follows the official turn usage pill, with the clock last. Both use the price tag icon.
- Adds a **Cost statistics** entry to the sidebar **Plugins** area. Select it to open the cost overview page.
- Shows a short initialization message when model prices are not ready.
- Groups the details by peak price, off-peak price and fixed price. Hides price rows that cost zero and shows no peak or off-peak token counts.
- The session panel groups the four prices by peak, off-peak and fixed price, then lists each model's group sums. The turn panel lists the four prices of every group for each model.
- Each price has an info button: hover it to see the calculation formula for that price. The popover closes when the pointer leaves.
- Groups used models by provider. The list comes from DSH session history and models declared in the configuration.
- Supports separate prices for each full `provider/model` name.
- Selects models.dev, openrouter.ai or api.deepinfra.com as the price source.
- Initializes new model prices from the selected source's local cache. Uses zero if there is no matching price.
- Downloads model prices only when you select **Sync prices**. The source controls, the Sync prices button and the sync report stay above the model rates table.
- Syncs only configured models. The sync result is staged in the draft and written to the configuration when you select **Save**.
- Matches source prices by model ID. models.dev prefers manufacturer prices; OpenRouter and DeepInfra supply their own platform prices. Keeps existing prices if matching is unclear.
- Keeps existing prices when the source cannot supply a supported rate.
- Supports USD or CNY for each model. Converts all four rates when you change its currency.
- Shows separate USD and CNY totals when a session or turn uses both currencies.
- Keeps edits in a page draft. The **Save** button at the end of the page writes the configuration. Leaving the page discards unsaved edits. A failed save shows the error and keeps the draft.
- Shows two flat sections, **Model rates** and **General**, with all content visible. **General** contains the exchange rate, the session/turn visibility controls, the **Show cost statistics in the sidebar** switch (on by default) and the **Refresh cost statistics on a timer** switch (on by default). Turn the sidebar switch off to remove the sidebar entry; the overview page keeps its data. The timer switch has an interval list of 1, 3, 5, 10, 15, 30 or 60 minutes, with 5 minutes as the default. While it is on, the plugin loads the five preset ranges in parallel at that interval, so the overview page opens from the cache.
- Shows the cost overview page for today, 7, 30, 90 days, all history or a custom start and end date. It shows four summary figures, a stacked daily cost or token trend, the cost and token mix, cost by model, the top sessions and the current rate, totals and generation time. The trend uses daily bars; above 20 bars it merges neighbouring dates, and only the all-history range above 60 days with data switches to months. The model table lists every priced model. Amounts use the configured currency and `cnyPerUsd` rate.
- Caps the cost trend at 20 bars. Above 20 days it merges neighbouring dates and shows the merged span. The **Plugin settings** button opens the plugin page. Preset ranges cache their result for 15 minutes; **Refresh** or a price change recomputes it. The toolbar shows the cache state and the statistics time. Custom date ranges are not cached.
- Follows the DSH light or dark theme and the DSH Chinese or English language.
- Expands **More rates** on each model row to show its cache-write price and the automatic off-peak switch. The switch reveals that model's peak rule selector, and the info icon shows the windows of the selected rule.
- Adds a model by entering `provider/model` next to the **Model rates** title and selecting **Add model**. Declared models are saved with the configuration; models that history has not discovered can be removed.
- Marks invalid rates and exchange rates with a red border and a message, and disables **Save** and **Sync prices**.
- Reuses the DSH host controls (settings form, value field, switch, button and tag), so sizes, borders and colors match the host settings pages.
- Applies half the peak rate in each off-peak window. Each model selects one peak rule:
- **DeepSeek peak rule** (default): peak on Beijing weekday 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00; off-peak on weekends, Chinese public holidays and all other windows.
- **Alibaba Cloud peak rule**: off-peak 22:00–08:00 Beijing time; peak at all other times.
- **Zhipu GLM peak rule**: peak on Beijing Monday to Friday 14:00–18:00; off-peak at all other times, including the whole weekend.
- Uses holiday-cn annual calendars, cached under `data/holidays/`. Fetches a missing year in the background.
- Stores configuration at `~/.dsh/guojinpeng/dsh-cost-meter/config.json`. Uses `DSH_HOME` when set.
- Copies the old `~/.dsh/dsh-cost-meter/config.json` on first start if the new file does not exist. Keeps the old file.
- Uses isolated plugin, client, API, projection, style and configuration identifiers.

These screenshots use example model prices. They do not show a billing statement.

Existing model prices without a currency remain USD. Existing entries without an off-peak setting keep fixed rates until you switch it on. The switch is off by default for every new entry. Confirmed original-vendor DeepSeek off-peak rates from models.dev are multiplied by two to store peak rates. Every model applies its own selected rule; the default is the DeepSeek peak rule.

The configuration file stays at the same path. No configuration migration is required. Historical usage is replayed to restore dates and seven Beijing clock windows under projection state version 4. Requests that cross a price boundary are estimated from the recorded usage settlement time. Only the DeepSeek peak rule reads the holiday calendar; the Alibaba Cloud and GLM rules never need it. If a holiday calendar is unavailable, uncertain weekday windows use the peak rate until the calendar is loaded.

`priceSource` selects the cache for new models. Existing configuration without this field uses models.dev. Each model's `source` records its last price import; edits to rates on the configuration page set it to `manual`. Changing the selected source does not change existing rates or fetch prices. Cost calculation uses only the saved rates.

Caches are separate: `data/models.dev.json`, `data/openrouter.ai.json` and `data/api.deepinfra.com.json`. OpenRouter and DeepInfra prices are not multiplied by two. DeepSeek entries with automatic off-peak pricing keep their rates when the source cannot confirm an official peak rate. Sync reports show skipped models and cache-write rates that were kept because the cache duration is unclear. Conditional prices and non-token charges are outside this fixed-rate estimate.

Session cost details:

![Session cost card](docs/images/session-cost-en.png)

Turn cost details:

![Turn cost card](docs/images/turn-cost-en.png)

Model price settings:

![Model price settings on desktop](docs/images/model-prices-desktop.png)

## Develop From Source

Install Node.js, pnpm 9 and Git. Install DSH globally before you run the tests:

```powershell
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2
git

plugins.description: 为报告类文档提供代码语法高亮的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件。注册一个 highlight_code 工具， 把代码片段渲染成带真实语法配色的产物，落到 Markdown / HTML、Word、PowerPoint、PDF 与 LaTeX 里。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-code-highlight [English](README.en.md) | **中文** [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE) [![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20-brightgreen.svg)](package.json) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4B6BFB.svg)](#安装) [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/dshplugin/dsh-plugin-hub) 为**报告类文档**提供代码语法高亮的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件。注册一个 `highlight_code` 工具， 把代码片段渲染成带真实语法配色的产物，落到 Markdown / HTML、Word、PowerPoint、PDF 与 LaTeX 里。

## 特性 - **68 种语言** —— 按语言名、别名或文件扩展名解析；没有给定语言时按内容自动识别，识别不出就老实按纯文本处理。 - **10 种输出** —— `html`、`html-file`、`svg`、`svg-png`、`png`、`latex`、`latex-minted`、`markdown`、`ansi`、`text`。 - **7 套主题** —— `paper-light`（文档向）、`github-dark`、`github-light`、`one-dark`、`monokai`、`solarized-light`、`solarized-dark`，另有 `auto`。 - **矢量与位图共用一套几何** —— SVG 与 PNG 由同一个布局模型产出，物理尺寸与逐格位置一致。 - **面向文档的排版参数** —— `width_in`、`dpi`、`font_size_pt`、`line_height`、`show_title`，直接产出能贴进 Word 一页宽的图。 - **直接落盘** —— 给出 `output_file` 就写文件并返回路径，不再把长文回传给模型。 - **不需要浏览器，也不需要 Office** —— PNG 由内置的 Pillow 栅格化器绘制，中文与 ASCII 在固定步进网格上对齐。 - **零运行时 npm 依赖** —— 分词器与渲染器全部自带，离线可用。 ## 安装 ### 从 GitHub 安装（CLI） ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:scientificmaniac/dsh-code-highlight ``` - `--profile` 换成你的 profile 名：DSH Desktop 用 `desktop`，Web 版通常是 `web`。 - Desktop 版请**先完全退出应用**再执行——`dsh plugin` 要独占 profile 的写锁。 - `dsh plugin --profile

` 把参数原样交给 pnpm，所以要固定版本可以直接写 `dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:scientificmaniac/dsh-code-highlight#v1.0.0`。 ### 在 DSH 会话里安装 让 Agent 调用 `plugin_manager`： ``` action: install_bundle target: <本仓库的绝对路径> ``` 两种方式都用包内 `cordis.patch.yml` 插入插件条目；安装后 `highlight_code` 对该 profile 的所有会话可用。 修改源码后需要重启 DSH 才会加载新模块。 ### 供其他项目直接引用 ```bash git clone https://github.com/scientificmaniac/dsh-code-highlight.git cd dsh-code-highlight npm test ``` `index.js` 导出 DSH 插件的 `apply` / `inject` / `name`；若只想用渲染能力，可直接引用 `src/` 下的模块： ```js import { resolveLanguage } from 'dsh-code-highlight/src/languages.js'; import { tokenizeLines } from 'dsh-code-highlight/src/tokenize.js'; import { resolveTheme } from 'dsh-code-highlight/src/themes.js'; import { renderHtml } from 'dsh-code-highlight/src/render.js'; ``` ## 用法 | 参数 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | `code`（必填） | 要高亮的源码；允许整段被 Markdown 围栏包住。 | | `language` | 语言 id、别名或扩展名，如 `python`、`py`、`ts`、`c++`、`bash`、`sql`、`latex`。省略则自动识别。 | | `format` | 输出格式，默认 `html`。 | | `theme` | 主题 id 或 `auto`。报告排版推荐 `paper-light`。 | | `dark` | 仅 `theme: "auto"` 时生效的明暗偏好，默认深色。 | | `title` | 代码块标签，通常是文件名或片段用途。 | | `show_title` | 是否显示 `title`，默认 `true`；设 `false` 可彻底去掉文件名。 | | `document_title` | 仅 `html-file` 用的文档标题，默认不输出，因此文件名不会变成文档标题。 | | `line_numbers` | 是否显示行号列，默认 `true`。 | | `start_line` | 首行行号，默认 `1`，用于片段摘录。 | | `highlight_lines` | 需要强调的行，如 `"3,7-9"`。 | | `font_size` | 代码字号（CSS 像素），默认 `13`。 | | `font_size_pt` | 代码字号（磅），优先于 `font_size`；1 pt = 4/3 px。 | | `line_height` | 行距倍数，默认 `1.5`；低于 1.3 时中文可能贴近下一行。 | | `tab_size` | 制表符展开宽度，默认 `4`。 | | `canvas` | 目标画布尺寸，如 `"960x540"`。设置后 `svg` 输出为整页尺寸、代码块居中缩放，可直接交给 `univer_compile_svg`。 | | `width_in` | 物理宽度（英寸），如 `6.3`。PNG 像素宽 = `width_in × dpi`，SVG 得到等价的 `width="…in"`。 | | `dpi` | 位图分辨率，默认 `300`；该值写入 PNG，Word 据此换算实际尺寸。 | | `output_file` | 写入此路径并返回路径；相对路径基于会话工作区。`png` 与 `svg-png` 必填。 | | `overwrite` | 允许覆盖已存在文件，默认 `false`。 | | `mono_font` | 栅格化 ASCII 用的字体文件，如 `consola.ttf`。 | | `cjk_font` | 栅格化中日韩等宽字符用的字体文件，如 `msyh.ttc`、`simsun.ttc`。 | ### 格式与落点 | `format` | 产物 | 典型落点 | | --- | --- | --- | | `html` | 全内联样式的 HTML 片段 | Markdown 报告、HTML 报告、邮件、可粘贴的富文本 | | `html-file` | 完整独立 HTML 文档 | 浏览器打开、打印成 PDF | | `svg` | 矢量代码图（可加 `width_in` 定宽） | Word / PPT / PDF 插图；也可交给 `univer_compile_svg` | | `svg-png` | 同版式的 `.svg` + `.png` 一对文件 | 文档需要矢量图与位图兜底时 | | `png` | Pillow 栅格化的位图，含 DPI 元数据 | 无 SVG 支持的编辑器、PDF 排版、快速预览 | | `latex` | `listings` 环境 | `.tex` 报告（pdfLaTeX / XeLaTeX 通用，无需 shell-escape） | | `latex-minted` | `minted` 环境 | 需要 `-shell-escape` 的 `.tex` | | `markdown` | 围栏代码块 | 交给下游 Markdown 渲染器自行着色 | | `ansi` | 24 位色终端文本 | 终端、日志 | | `text` | 原样代码 | 纯文本 | ### 各报告格式的落地流程 - **Markdown / HTML** —— `format: html`，把返回片段写进报告。 - **Word（.docx）** —— `format: svg-png` + `width_in: 6.3`，插入定宽矢量图，或使用同尺寸 PNG。 - **PDF** —— `format: png` 直接排版，或 `format: latex` 由 LaTeX 排版、`html-file` 打印。 - **LaTeX / PDF 论文** —— `format: latex`（`listings`）或 `format: latex-minted`。 - **PowerPoint** —— `format: svg` + `canvas: "960x540"`，再用 `univer_compile_svg` 编译到幻灯片页。 ## 栅格化：为什么中文能对齐 SVG 与 PNG 共用**固定步进网格**：一个 ASCII 单元格固定为 `0.6 × 字号`，CJK 与 emoji 占两个单元格。 排版因此只由几何决定，不依赖浏览器或 Pillow 各自的字体度量。 PNG 绘制时按字符选字体：ASCII 走等宽字体（默认 Consolas），宽字符走 CJK 字体（默认微软雅黑）， 两者落在同一网格起点上——这就是「Consolas 画 ASCII + 中文字体画中文」而不让缩进走样的做法。 字体可用 `mono_font` / `cjk_font` 覆盖。 栅格化依赖 **Python 3 + Pillow**。脚本以 `stdio: ignore` 启动、诊断经临时文件回传， 因此在禁止捕获管道的受限环境里同样可用。解释器按 `python`、`py`、`python3` 依次尝试， 也可用环境变量 `DSH_CODE_HIGHLIGHT_PYTHON` 指定。 ## 架构 ```mermaid flowchart TD invoke(["highlight_code 调用
code · language · format · output_file"]) entry["index.js
参数解析 · 格式分派 · 落盘"] detect["src/detect.js
特征打分"] langs["src/languages.js
68 种语言的词法定义"] tokenize["src/tokenize.js
通用分词器 + 专用扫描模式"] themes["src/themes.js
7 套主题"] render["src/render.js
渲染器 + blockGeometry 共用几何"] raster["py/rasterize.py
Pillow 栅格化器"] invoke --> entry entry -->|"language 省略时"| detect detect --> langs entry --> langs langs --> tokenize tokenize -->|"每行 token"| render themes --> render entry --> render render --> f1["html · html-file"] render --> f2["svg"] render --> f3["latex · latex-minted"] render --> f4["ansi · markdown · text"] render -->|"宽高与缩放"| raster f1 --> d1["Markdown / HTML 报告"] f2 --> d2["Word / PPT / PDF 插图"] f3 --> d3["LaTeX 论文"] raster --> d4["记录 DPI 的位图"] ``` SVG 与 PNG 是同一份几何的两个出口：`render.js` 算出逻辑宽高与缩放系数， 交给 `rasterize.py` 画位图，两者因此物理尺寸一致。 ## 项目结构 ```mermaid flowchart TB repo["dsh-code-highlight/"] repo --> index["index.js
插件入口"] repo --> src["src/"] repo --> py["py/rasterize.py
Pillow 栅格化器"] repo --> tests["tests/"] repo --> scripts["scripts/
示例生成脚本"] repo --> examples["examples/
示例产物"] repo --> manifest["package.json · cordis.patch.yml
locale/ · icon.svg"] repo --> docs["README.md · README.en.md
CONTRIBUTING.md · CHANGELOG.md · LICENSE"] src --> languages["languages.js
68 种语言"] src --> detect["detect.js
语言识别"] src --> tokenize["tokenize.js
分词器"] src --> themes["themes.js
7 套主题"] src --> render["render.js
渲染器 + 共用几何"] tests --> encoding["encoding.mjs
编码守卫"] tests --> smoke["smoke.mjs
112 项断言"] tests --> raster["rasterize.mjs
19 项断言"] ``` ## 开发 ```bash npm test # 编码守卫 + 冒烟测试（无需 Python） npm run test:raster # PNG 链路测试（需要 Python 3 + Pillow） node scripts/make-doc-figure.mjs # 生成配对的 SVG + PNG 文档插图 ``` `npm test` 覆盖分词往返不变式（68 种语言 × 压力样本，输出拼回必须等于输入）、 渲染矩阵（语言 × 主题 × 格式）、语言自动识别、画布与英寸排版、`show_title` 去重与 CJK 双格宽度。 详细报告写入 `smoke-report.txt`。 ## 语言一览 通用编程语言：JavaScript、TypeScript、Python、Java、Kotlin、Scala、Groovy、C、C++、C#、Go、Rust、Swift、 Ruby、PHP、Perl、Lua、R、MATLAB、Julia、Dart、Elixir、Erlang、Haskell、Clojure、Lisp、F#、Visual Basic、 Pascal、Fortran、Assembly、COBOL、Solidity、Verilog、GLSL、GDScript、Apex、Zig、Nim、OCaml、PowerShell、 Shell、Fish、Batch、Vim Script、AWK。 配置与数据：JSON、YAML、TOML、INI / properties / dotenv、XML、HTML、CSS / SCSS / LESS、Markdown、 Dockerfile、Makefile / CMake、Nginx、HTTP、Protocol Buffers、GraphQL、Terraform / HCL、Nix、Mermaid、 CSV / TSV、Diff / Patch、LaTeX、纯文本。 ## 已知限制 - 一次处理一个代码片段；不做整篇报告的批量扫描。 - `width_in` 只把图缩到栏宽以内，不会把短片段放大到正好一页宽。 - HTML 中内嵌的 `

plugins.description: DSH 右侧边栏的移动设备面板：把 mobilecli 封装成实时画面 + 直接操作，一套 API 同时覆盖 iOS 与 Android，并把 mobilecli 自带的 skill 一并注册给模型。A mobile device panel for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar — wraps mobilecli as a live screen with direct interaction, one API for iOS and Android, plus the bundled mobilecli skill registered for the model.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sidebar-mobile **把手机装进 DSH 的右侧边栏 —— 实时画面 + 直接点击，一套 API 同时覆盖 iOS 与 Android** [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.0--rc.2%20实测-4c6ef5)](#) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/npm%20test-43%20passed-2ea043)](#自测) [![runtime deps](https://img.shields.io/badge/运行时依赖-0-8a8f99)](#它怎么做)
--- `mobilecli` 是一条覆盖 iOS 与 Android 的设备控制 CLI，但它的 `screencapture` 只能写到 stdout、没有面板。本插件把它封进 DSH 的右侧边栏，并把能力同时开放给人和模型。 - 📺 **实时画面**：Android 走 AVC/H.264（实测 **104fps**），iOS 模拟器走 MJPEG（实测 **131fps**） - 👆 **直接在画面上操作**：点击即点击、拖拽即滑动，等比例换算回设备坐标 - 🧰 **11 个模型工具**：读 UI 树、按标识点元素、读日志、等文本出现、**把面板打开给你看** - 📱 **一套 API 两端通用**：真机、模拟器、模拟机走同一条路径，没有平台分支 - 🎓 **自带 mobilecli 的 skill**：把上游 playbook 打包注册给模型，不用自己往 `.agents/` 抄 - 🔐 **浏览器从不接触设备端口**：只经 DSH 自己的 web 源，签名令牌 + loopback 围栏 - 📦 **零运行时依赖**：`react` 用宿主那份；客户端源码是 JSX，但**产物已提交**，安装方无需工具链（见[开发与自测](#开发与自测)） **目录**：[它解决什么问题](#它解决什么问题) · [安装](#安装) · [配置](#配置) · [使用](#使用) · [安全模型](#安全模型) · [已知边界](#已知边界) · [更多文档](#更多文档) · [License](#license) ## 它解决什么问题 DSH 社区已有一个 Android 插件和一个 iOS 插件，但各自踩了一个性能坑： | 方案 | 取帧方式 | 实测帧率 | |---|---|---| | `dsh-android` | `adb exec-out screencap` 循环（PNG） | **~1.8fps** | | `dsh-ios` | serve-sim MJPEG | 与下同量级 | | **本插件（Android）** | mobilecli AVC / H.264（MediaCodec 硬编） | **104fps** | | **本插件（iOS 模拟器）** | mobilecli MJPEG | **131fps** | 瓶颈不在 adb，而在**每帧搬一张完整 PNG**：1080p PNG 每帧几百 KB，H.264 每帧几 KB，差两个数量级。mobilecli 在设备端用 MediaCodec 编码，只把压缩后的码流传回来。 ### ⚠️ Flutter 应用读元素会读不到，这是预期的 Flutter 把整个 UI 画进一块不透明的原生 view，**无障碍树只能看到应用主动投影出去的那部分**。实测一个真实的 Flutter 应用（debug 构建）： ``` mobilecli dump ui --format json → 69 个节点，全部是 android.* 其中 32 个是 systemui 状态栏（时间/网速/wifi/电池），与你的应用无关 应用窗口下全是匿名 View / ImageView —— 只有 rect，没有 text、没有 identifier ``` 更深一层：Flutter 的**语义树默认根本不生成**（框架出于性能考虑，只在检测到读屏类辅助技术时才生成）。所以这不是 mobilecli 的缺陷，是 Flutter 的渲染模型决定的 —— 关掉读屏时 `ext.flutter.debugDumpSemanticsTreeInTraversalOrder` 会明确回你： > Semantics not generated … the framework only generates semantics when asked to do so by the platform. 要读**真正的 widget 树**必须走 Dart VM Service，或在 Flutter 工程里跑 `integration_test` / Patrol。两条路线的完整实测（协议细节、踩坑、阻塞项）见 **[docs/FLUTTER-TREE-RESEARCH.md](docs/FLUTTER-TREE-RESEARCH.md)**。 本插件**不提供**这个能力 —— 早先的 `mobile_flutter_tree` 只是个空承诺（它与 `mobile_ui_tree` 调同一个函数，却声称直连 VM Service），已删除。 ## 安装 ### 前置：mobilecli ```bash npm install -g mobilecli@latest mobilecli devices # 确认能看到设备 ``` ### 前置：adb（Android 必需） **Android 设备必须装 adb** —— mobilecli 不自己实现 adb 协议，它调用外部 `adb`。 而 **adb 缺失时 mobilecli 不报错**： ```json {"status":"ok","data":{"devices":[]}} // exit code 0，完全看不出问题 ``` 真相只在 daemon 日志里：`Failed running 'adb devices', is ANDROID_HOME set correctly?`。 所以手机明明插着、驱动也正常，设备列表却是空的 —— 大概率就是缺 adb。 ```bash # 1) 下载 platform-tools # https://developer.android.com/tools/releases/platform-tools # 2) 让 adb 可被找到：加进 PATH，或设 ANDROID_HOME 指向 platform-tools 的**上一级** # 3) 重启 DSH，然后让 daemon 重新读取环境 mobilecli daemon stop ``` > ⚠️ **两个都会踩的坑** > > **① 环境变量是"启动时快照"。** 装完 adb 后**必须重启 DSH** —— 已运行的进程 > 看不到新写的 PATH / ANDROID_HOME。插件会区分这两种情况：确认 adb 装了但当前 > 进程看不到时，提示的是"重启 DSH"而不是"去装 adb"。 > > **② daemon 也会缓存环境。** mobilecli 的 daemon 是常驻进程，继承**启动那一刻** > 的环境。所以即使 DSH 的环境对了，旧的 daemon 仍会报"没有设备" —— 必须 > `mobilecli daemon stop`（或等它空闲 30 分钟自动退出）。 面板在"一台设备都没有"时会显示一条可照做的诊断（含 adb 路径与下一条动作）， 而不是只显示"未发现设备"。 iOS 真机还需要在设备上装 agent（**本插件不会自动装**）： ```bash mobilecli agent status --device mobilecli agent install --device # 真机需要 provisioning profile ``` iOS 模拟器同样需要装一次 agent，否则取流会报 `agent is not installed`。 ### 装插件 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @j62268781-alt/dsh-sidebar-mobile@latest dsh web ``` 或作为已有 profile 包的依赖： ```bash pnpm add @j62268781-alt/dsh-sidebar-mobile ``` 装完刷新页面，右侧边栏的「开始」页出现「移动设备」入口，点它打开面板。 也可以直接按快捷键（胶囊右侧会显示对应徽标）： | 环境 | 键位 | |---|---| | 桌面应用 | `⌘⇧M`（Windows/Linux 为 `Ctrl+Shift+M`）| | 浏览器 | `⌘⌥M`（Windows 为 `Ctrl+Alt+M`）| > 桌面端**没有**用 `⌘M`：macOS 把 `⌘M` 绑给了系统「最小化」，原生菜单会先吃掉这个键。 > 键位可在 **设置 → 快捷键** 里改；与 DSH 自带的 8 条绑定均无冲突（已按宿主自身的 > 绑定规则校验过保留键与重叠）。 > **它是「开始」页的第 5 个胶囊（官方 3 个 + `dsh-context` 1 个）**。DSH 的「开始」页有条硬规则： > 胶囊超过 4 个，就关掉**所有**胶囊的副标题（`MAX_DESCRIBED_ENTRIES = 4`，不是只关第 5 个）。 > 所以装上本插件后，「工作区文件 / 上下文 / 新建终端 / 浏览器」的副标题会一起消失—— > 这是上游的取舍，插件侧无法只为自己豁免。要恢复副标题，只能把入口挪到会话标题栏 > （`conversation.session.header.utilities`），而不是改本插件的 `description`。 > **桌面版**：`desktop` profile 由桌面应用独占，宿主 CLI 的 `dsh plugin --profile desktop` 会被拒绝。桌面端请走 **设置 → 插件市场**。 ## 配置 全部配置在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，挂在 `dsh-sidebar-mobile` 这一行下： | 键 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `enabled` | `true` | 总开关。关掉后插件仍加载，但不挂路由、不注册工具与技能 | | `binaryPath` | `null` | mobilecli 路径。`null` 走四级自动解析（见下） | | `homeDir` | `null` | `MOBILECLI_HOME`。`null` 用 mobilecli 默认的 `~/.mobilecli` | | `routePrefix` | `/_dsh/dsh-sidebar-mobile` | 路由前缀 | | `registerSkills` | `true` | 是否把 mobilecli 的 skill 注册给模型 | | `stream.idleStopSeconds` | `300` | 无消费者后多久停流 | | `stream.restartDelayMs` | `5000` | 流崩溃后的重启延迟 | | `stream.defaultScale` | `1.0` | 缩放。`0.5` 在 iOS 上实测 104fps/6.6Mbps（全分辨率 131fps/20.6Mbps） | | `useDaemonRpc` | `true` | 交互指令优先走 mobilecli daemon 的 unix socket（实测 `io tap` 7.3ms，CLI 是 104.2ms）。排查时设 `false` 强制走 CLI | | `trustedAuthorities` | `[]` | 经反向代理访问时显式列出对外 authority | `binaryPath` 为 `null` 时的**四级解析**顺序： 1. `MOBILECLI_PATH` 环境变量 2. `PATH` 上的 `mobilecli`（`npm -g` 装的 shim） 3. 本包 `node_modules` 里的平台包（`@mobilenext/mobilecli--`） 4. 全落空 → 工具仍注册，调用时给出安装提示（而不是插件加载失败） ## 使用 ### 面板 右侧边栏 →「移动设备」： - **设备下拉**：按类型**分组**（真机 / 模拟器），每项形如 `一加 12 · 真机`；离线再加「（离线）」。类型来自 mobilecli 的 `type` 字段（`real` / `simulator` / `emulator`），认不出的值原样显示而不猜 —— 实测同时插着真机和模拟器时，只显示名字**完全分不出哪个是模拟器** - **点一个离线模拟器会先把它启动起来**（冷启动可达数分钟，期间显示启动提示，别以为卡死了）。离线**真机**只选中、不启动 —— 真机不归 adb 启动。启动失败不影响选中，但会如实报错，不会让你对着黑屏猜 - **⌂ / ◁ / ⟳**：主屏幕 / 返回（仅 Android）/ 旋转 - **⟲**：重新申请令牌并重连（画面卡住时用） - **▢ / ▣ / ▤**：切换外观（边框 / 真机 / 无框） - **在画面上点击** → 点设备的对应位置；**拖拽** → 滑动 - **模型也能替你打开这个面板**（`mobile_open_panel`）。⚠️ 它**不是给模型读界面用的** —— 面板在浏览器里、不在模型上下文里。用途是需要你**亲眼看**屏幕时把它推到你面前 状态栏显示 `实时/未串流`、平台、以及实际拿到的流格式（`H.264` 或 `MJPEG`）。 ### 模型工具 只注册 **11 个**「工具能做得比 CLI 更好」的工具： | 工具 | 用途 | |---|---| | `mobile_devices` | 列出所有设备（**先跑这个**拿到 device id） | | `mobile_boot` | 启动设备并开始串流（画面出现在面板） | | `mobile_ui_tree` | **读界面首选**：类型、文本、identifier、坐标 | | `mobile_screenshot` | 截图（给人或多模态模型看，不是读界面的首选） | | `mobile_tap_element` | **按标识/文本点元素**（比坐标稳，可带 `expect_text` 一并验证） | | `mobile_list_apps` | 列已安装应用（启动前先列，别猜包名） | | `mobile_find_text` / `mobile_tap_text` | OCR 找文字 / 点文字（树读不到时的兜底） | | `mobile_wait_for` | 等文本出现或消失 | | `mobile_logs` | 读设备日志（logcat / unified log） | | `mobile_open_panel` | **把侧边栏的移动设备面板打开给用户看**（跨进程，需要客户端在跑） | #### 为什么不给 tap / swipe / 输入 / 按键 / 启动应用注册工具 这 5 个曾是工具，但只是 `mobilecli` 的薄包装（一次 `runJson` 加一句 `return`）， 没有任何加工 —— 而 agent 本来就有 shell，直接跑等价命令即可： ```bash mobilecli io tap --device 540,1200 mobilecli io swipe --device --duration 250 540,1800,540,700 mobilecli io text --device "hello" mobilecli io button --device BACK mobilecli apps launch --device com.example.app ``` 这 5 个的 schema 每次请求都要发 —— **删掉它们实测省 453 tokens/轮** （16 个 = 1487 → 11 个 = 1034）。 > 此后又删了 `mobile_flutter_tree`（与 `mobile_ui_tree` 重复）， > 并加了 `mobile_open_panel`。**当前是 11 个 = 964 tokens/轮** —— > 数的个数一样，但不是同一批工具，别把这个差值和上面的 453 混起来。 ⚠️ 关键细节没跟着删，都在 skill 的「Driving the device from the shell」一节： 坐标是**物理像素**、`io swipe` **必须传 `--duration`**（否则默认 1000ms 慢动作）、 输入前必须**先聚焦**、`io button` 的键名、启动前先列应用。 被删的名字留在 `REMOVED_TOOL_NAMES` 里，便于分辨「插件删了它」和「名字打错了」。 工具描述里写明了"先用哪个、什么时候升级到下一个"，因为三种观察方式的代价差一个数量级： ``` mobile_ui_tree ~100–300ms 结构化，首选 mobile_screenshot ~200–400ms 给人看 mobile_find_text ~1s OCR，兜底 ``` ### 自带 skill mobilecli 仓库里的 playbook（`SKILL.md` + `reference.md`）被原样打包并注册，模型可以直接读到命令的完整用法、平台差异、以及一批踩坑记录。**不需要你往 `.agents/` 里抄一份。** ## 安全模型 **浏览器从不接触 mobilecli 的端口**（它监听 localhost 且没有鉴权）。所有字节只经 DSH 自己的 web 源： ``` → 围栏校验 → Host 转发到 mobilecli → 回传 ``` 两道闸门，**顺序不可颠倒**： 1. **传输层围栏（先）**：对端必须是 loopback（TCP 层事实，客户端伪造不了）；`Host` 头必须是 loopback 或显式配置的 `trustedAuthorities`。`Host` 与 `Origin` 是客户端可控数据，这里只用它们**否决**，从不用来授权。 2. **capability（后）**：HMAC-SHA256 签名，10 分钟过期。`deviceId` 参与签名，所以给 A 设备签的令牌拿到 B 上

plugins.description: DeepSeek opening animation for DeepSeek Harness: whale line-draw splash rendered as DSH Desktop launch screen, plus an opt-in full-screen client overlay.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-deepseek-splash DeepSeek 开屏动画 —— **点开软件的第一眼** 就是这段鲸鱼片头。

> DeepSeek opening animation for DeepSeek Harness — the whale line-draw / signal-dots / fill / > wordmark intro, rendered as DSH Desktop's own launch screen, with the same animation available > as an opt-in full-screen client overlay (a plain DSH client plugin). 默认只放桌面版的启动画面那一次；进界面那次浮层是静音的（紧接着又放一遍读起来像卡带）， 需要时一行配置就能让它回来。 同一套动画有两个落点，共用一份视觉源码（`src/splash.css` + `assets/whale.svg`）： | 落点 | 载体 | 出现时机 | | --- | --- | --- | | **启动画面** | DSH Desktop 自己的 `resources/splash.html`（由 `tools/build_splash.py --apply` 写入） | 双击图标、窗口刚出现就播；播完鲸鱼保持点亮，三颗信号点持续脉动当作加载指示，直到应用切到界面 | | **界面开屏**（默认静音） | 本插件的 `shell.overlay` 浮层（客户端半边） | 需要显式 opt in；开启后界面加载完成时整窗播放一次，约 2.8 秒 | 动画本身四拍： 1. **描边**：蓝色高光沿着鲸鱼轮廓逐段画出（`pathLength=1` + `stroke-dashoffset`）， 屏幕与尾鳍同时被"勾"出来； 2. **点灯**：鲸鱼头顶的三颗信号点依次亮起并回弹，随后进入呼吸式脉动； 3. **成形**：填充自左向右涌入，白光扫过一遍，描边淡出，鲸鱼轻轻落定； 4. **落款**：`DeepSeek` 字标上浮、`深 度 求 索` 副标淡入； 5. **散场**（仅界面开屏）：整幕淡出并卸载，把界面交还给应用。 深浅两套主题都跟随外壳（``：桌面版按 `?theme=` 传进来， GUI 里读外壳自己的主题），并尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`（此时只保留一次极简淡入）。 ## 交互 界面开屏（浮层，**默认静音**）： 启动画面已经在打开软件时放过同一段动画，紧接着进界面又放一遍，读起来是卡带而不是欢迎。 所以浮层默认什么都不渲染；确实想在 GUI 里也看到它时（在普通浏览器里打开界面、或者就是想看第二遍）， 在页面里 opt in 一次即可： ```js window.__DSS_SPLASH__ = { overlay: true }; // 或 { disabled: false } ``` 开启之后： - **随时跳过**：点击 / 触摸任意位置，或按任意键，立刻结束动画。 - **自动收场**：无论动画是否被打断，CSS 都会在约 2.9 秒后把浮层淡出， 即使脚本异常也不会挡住界面。 - **只在首屏播放**：同一标签页内的后续路由切换不会再放。 - **可见即播**：窗口一旦可见就拉开帷幕，**不要求窗口拿到焦点**——桌面版 抬窗口时是"不抢焦点"的，等一次没人点的点击就等于永远不放。 启动画面（桌面版 splash）： - **不可跳过**：它背后还没有可以交还的界面，所以点击 / 按键都不会把它关掉。 - **一直亮着**：鲸鱼成形后停在终态，三颗点继续脉动，直到应用把窗口切到界面。 - **启动进度**：桌面版会把每一步写进 `#progress`（写一次就淡入一行）， 标题与副标题沿用官方文案并跟随系统语言切中文。 ## 桌面启动画面的安装与还原 ``` python tools/build_splash.py --apply # 渲染并写入 DSH Desktop 的 resources/splash.html python tools/build_splash.py --status # 看目标文件现在装的是哪一版 python tools/build_splash.py --restore # 还原官方页面 ``` - 首次 `--apply` 会把官方页面原样备份成 `splash.html.dsh-deepseek-splash.bak` （之后不会覆盖这份原版备份）。 - **应用更新会覆盖 splash.html**：更新后重跑一次 `--apply` 即可， 用 `--status` 可以确认（`ours: True/False`）。 - 目标路径默认是 `D:\deepseek\Data\DSH Desktop\resources\splash.html`， 换机器或换安装目录时用 `--target <路径>` 指定。 - 页面完全自包含（内联样式 + 内联 SVG，无外部图片、无联网）。 ## 预览 | 描边自绘 | 界面浮层（暗色） | 启动画面（亮色） | | --- | --- | --- | | ![描边自绘](docs/draw.png) | ![界面浮层](docs/overlay-dark.png) | ![启动画面亮色](docs/launch-light.png) | - `docs/preview.gif` —— 整段动画的逐帧预览（20 帧）。 - `assets/preview.html` —— 免安装预览页，直接用浏览器打开即可； 地址栏加 `#t=1300` 可以停在动画的第 1300 毫秒。 - `dist/splash.html` —— 启动画面的渲染产物，也能直接用浏览器打开 （加 `?theme=light` 看浅色）。 ## 配置与诊断 页面里（控制台或 `window.__DSS_SPLASH__`）可以覆盖任意参数： ```js window.__DSS_SPLASH__ = { overlay: true, // 界面开屏那次也放（默认静音，只在桌面启动画面放） disabled: true, // 本次加载不放动画 holdMs: 2760, // 定格时长 title: "DeepSeek", // 主字标 subtitle: "深度求索", // 副标（给空串则隐藏） hint: "点击任意位置跳过" }; ``` 动画状态写在 `` 上：`waiting`（窗口还没可见，帷幕待命）、 `playing`（幕布放下）、`done`（已收场）、`skipped`（本次加载没有播放）。 样式表本身是 `

plugins.description: Compact file actions for DeepSeek Harness chat turns | DSH 对话文件操作
plugins.readme_text:
# 对话文件操作 · DSH Chat File Actions

一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件：在已完成的回复下按需显示「本轮资源」，集中操作本轮明确引用的本地文件、网页链接和已编辑文件。不覆盖右键菜单，也不修改 DSH 本体。

> **0.4.1** 面向 DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2**：修复设置表单因 DSH 不再提供 `state.mode` 而无法保存的问题。自动化测试通过；系统应用与文件管理器操作发生在 **DSH Host 所在电脑**，侧栏查看发生在 DSH 页面。Windows 桌面尚未实测。

## 效果预览

**紧凑的文件列表**：按文件类型显示名称，可直接定位或展开更多操作。

![本轮文件列表：PDF、PPTX 与 JPG 文件的紧凑布局](assets/compact-list.png)

**按需显示复制操作**：展开「更多」后，可复制路径、文件名或 Markdown 链接。

![文件的复制操作：路径、文件名和 Markdown 链接](assets/copy-actions.png)

**在插件管理页调整设置**：选择文件名的打开方式，勾选并排列「更多操作」中的复制按钮。

![插件管理页：文件名打开方式与复制按钮的显示和顺序](assets/settings-page.png)

这些截图展示已发布 0.3.0 的布局；0.4.x 的网页链接沿用同样的紧凑单行样式，仅增加链接图标与淡色真实域名。前两张截图只保留插件弹层，已裁去对话和费用信息；设置页截图演示将「复制文件名」排在首位。

## 使用

本轮提问或回复含明确的本地 Markdown 文件链接（包括图片）、`@path`、`@"path with spaces"`、Markdown `http(s)` 网页链接，或本轮有成功的结构化 `edit`／`write` 文件结果时，回复操作栏才显示回形针图标和候选数。它们在同一紧凑列表中显示，不另分两套界面。点击图标后：

- **点击本地文件名**：默认请求系统应用打开；也可在插件管理页设为「在 DSH 侧栏打开」。成功编辑的文件以淡色「已编辑」标注。
- **点击文件夹图标**：请求 Host 的文件管理器定位已验证的本地文件。
- **文件的「更多」**：复制绝对路径、文件名或 Markdown 链接；可在插件管理页调整这三项的显示与顺序。侧栏模式下始终提供「用系统应用打开」备选。
- **点击网页链接名**：在浏览器打开；同一行显示实际目标域名，而非只相信链接标题。「更多」可复制网址或 Markdown 链接；网页链接没有本地文件定位操作，文件打开方式配置也不影响它。

进入插件管理器的「对话文件操作」配置页，选择**本地文件名**的打开方式，勾选并用上下按钮排列**本地文件**的复制操作，然后保存。默认设置与 0.2.1 一致；如果三个文件复制项都隐藏，系统打开模式的文件行不显示「更多」按钮；网页链接行仍可复制网址或 Markdown 链接。设置保存在 DSH Host 的 Profile 配置中；若 DSH 判定当前连接不是 loopback，设置页不可持久保存，也不会退而使用浏览器本地存储。

**语言跟随 DSH 全局设置**：切换「中文／English」后，插件管理器中的名称、简介、设置摘要和表单，以及已经展开的本轮资源弹窗、菜单、读屏标签和操作反馈都会切换；无须给插件另设语言，也不会改变已保存的打开方式和复制顺序。

列表默认只显示文件名；同名文件会补充父目录，悬停可查看完整路径。标题固定，文件列表独立滚动。界面使用 DSH 日夜主题色、线性图标和文件类型图标，支持键盘操作。

## 安装

从 [v0.4.1 Release](https://github.com/nico-zhuang/dsh-chat-file-actions/releases/tag/v0.4.1) 下载 `dsh-chat-file-actions-0.4.1.tgz`；[v0.4.0 Release](https://github.com/nico-zhuang/dsh-chat-file-actions/releases/tag/v0.4.0) 和 [v0.3.0 Release](https://github.com/nico-zhuang/dsh-chat-file-actions/releases/tag/v0.3.0) 继续保留。

1. 在 DSH 插件管理器中安装下载的本地包并启用 **对话文件操作**。
2. 若提示 `restart-required`，保存其他任务后**手动重启 DSH**；只刷新页面可能不够。

从源码构建：

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
npm test
npm pack --ignore-scripts
```

本仓库未发布到 npm registry。`package.json` 保留 `private: true`，以防误发布；GitHub Release 中的 `.tgz` 才是对应版本的安装包。禁用或移除插件会撤销操作栏插槽和样式，不会修改会话文件。

## 实现与边界

- 通过正式插槽 `conversation.chat.assistant-actions`，只收集当前 `messageId` 所属单轮、单会话的候选；没有候选就不显示按钮。文字仅解析明确的本地 Markdown 文件链接、`@文件`引用和 Markdown `http(s)` 链接；不猜测普通裸网址、代码块、HTML 注释或工具输出中的裸文件名。暂不支持参考式链接及全部复杂 Markdown 语法，带括号的常见 URL 与嵌套方括号标题受有界扫描支持；文件与网页目标会按 Markdown 规则解释常见实体和转义，无法确定的实体会跳过，以免指向错误目标。
- 同轮成功完成的 DSH `edit`／`write` 卡从 Chat snapshot 的结构化 `tool-result` 和 diff／创建元数据取路径，不解析卡片 DOM 或工具结果散文；失败、隐藏、越过本轮回复、缺少必要元数据的结果均忽略。**此 Chat 投影结构已在 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 核对；该版本实际 `edit`／`write` 产出的差异元数据尚未做实机逐项验收。未来 DSH 版本也可能改变。** shell 等其他方式修改的文件不会自动枚举。
- 本地文件展开时以所属 `sessionId` 调用 DSH 的 `workspaceFiles.stat`，由 Host 确定会话工作目录及回退目录。工具卡路径也由 Host 重新验证；验证失败时禁用文件操作。文件可能位于工作区外；Host 也可能拒绝最终符号链接。网页链接只接受规范化的 `http(s)` 绝对地址，拒绝带用户名密码、原始空白／反斜杠、非网页协议；显示真实域名，只有用户点击才由浏览器打开，不走文件 Host API，也不主动抓取网页。
- 每轮最多显示前 **200** 个资源，优先给成功编辑／创建的文件预留额度；**每次展开**最多并发 **6** 个本地文件验证请求。关闭弹层会发出取消信号并忽略过期结果；若旧请求不响应取消，连续展开期间在途请求可能超过 6 个。
- 系统打开和定位调用 DSH 的 `session.openWorkspacePath`，插件不运行 shell 命令；原生命令被受理也不保证窗口实际出现。侧栏模式调用 DSH 原生 `sidebarRight.openResource`，使用已验证文件的会话地址，并核对当前显示的 `sessionId`；侧栏不可用时不自动改为系统打开。文档预览由 DSH 决定：图片、PDF 可在页面查看，Office 需要 Host 转换，均受格式、文件大小与服务可用性限制。只有点击复制按钮才会写入剪贴板。
- 本地文件打开方式和有序复制项由 DSH 的 Host Config／配置表单保存；配置还未读取或不可用时禁用文件名主按钮，保留显式系统打开入口。网页链接不受文件打开方式影响：主动作是带 `noopener noreferrer` 的浏览器链接，次要动作复制网址或 Markdown 链接。侧栏不依赖 `dsh-better-sidebar`，也不注册新的预览器。
- 中英文 UI 由 DSH Client 的 `locale` 服务读取 `zh`／`en` 全局选择并订阅切换；插件管理器的名称和简介则由包内 `locale/zh.json`、`locale/en.json` 元数据提供。Host Config 仍只保存与语言无关的动作 ID，不增加独立语言偏好。DSH 其他语言若回退到英文，插件文案也跟随服务的回退链。
- Windows Markdown 路径建议使用 `/`、将反斜杠编码为 `%5C`，或使用插件生成的「复制链接」。原始 `C:\work\.env` 等反斜杠紧贴 Markdown 标点的写法有歧义，插件会跳过，以免指向另一个文件；`@"C:\work\.env"` 引用不经 Markdown 转义。暂不支持 UNC 和 `file:` 形式的 Markdown 文件链接。
- 自动测试模拟 React 和 Remote，不能代替各操作系统、各 DSH 版本的实机验收。报告兼容问题时，请在 GitHub Issues 提供 DSH 版本和复现步骤，不要公开私人路径、令牌或完整会话记录。

## 开发

浏览器入口 `lib/client.js` 使用 DSH `locale`、`configForms` 和现有文件 Remote；Host 入口 `lib/index.js` 仅声明由 DSH 设置服务管理的 Config schema，不增加命令权限或自建路由。插件管理器的翻译元数据位于 `locale/zh.json` 和 `locale/en.json`，清单位于 `package.json`、`cordis.patch.yml`。测试覆盖语言服务订阅、管理器与弹窗热切换及配置不变性、单轮隔离、带括号外链与真实域名、安全协议过滤、结构化编辑／新建卡、会话路径验证、复制、限流、配置保存与排序、侧栏会话匹配及不可用时的显式备选。

本项目是独立社区插件，与 DeepSeek Harness 官方无隶属关系。许可证见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。

---

## English

**DSH Chat File Actions 0.4.1** adds a paperclip beneath completed replies for explicit local-file references, Markdown `http(s)` links, and successful same-turn `edit`/`write` file cards. All entries share the same compact single-line list. A local file opens with the Host's default app (the unchanged default) or, if configured, in DSH's native right sidebar; Reveal and the configurable copy actions remain file-only. A web link opens in the browser and offers Copy URL / Copy Markdown under the same **More** style, with its true destination host shown beside the label.

The plugin follows DSH's global Chinese/English setting: the plugin-manager title, description, settings summary and form, plus the open resource popup, menus, accessibility labels and feedback switch live. File-action preferences remain unchanged; there is no separate plugin language preference.

The compact list follows DSH's theme and scrolls independently. Up to 200 combined resources are shown, reserving room for applied edit/write files. Local paths—including those taken from tool-card metadata—are verified through the owning session's `workspaceFiles.stat`, with at most six concurrent checks **per opening**; cancellation is best-effort. Web links do not call Host file APIs and never load automatically. Sidebar opens require the addressed Session to be on screen and an available DSH preview; they never silently launch a Host app on failure. Profile settings are Host-owned and writable only from pages DSH treats as loopback. The Chat tool-card projection has been checked against DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, but edit/write producer metadata has not been verified end-to-end on that runtime; future versions may change it.

Version 0.4.1 targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and removes an obsolete `state.mode` gate that disabled writable settings. Download the archive from the [v0.4.1 Release](https://github.com/nico-zhuang/dsh-chat-file-actions/releases/tag/v0.4.1) and install it through the DSH plugin manager; restart manually only if DSH reports `restart-required`. The [v0.4.0 Release](https://github.com/nico-zhuang/dsh-chat-file-actions/releases/tag/v0.4.0) and [v0.3.0 Release](https://github.com/nico-zhuang/dsh-chat-file-actions/releases/tag/v0.3.0) remain available. Windows desktop operation remains unverified. Independent community plugin, not an official DeepSeek product.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: unified Skills + MCP manager with hot-reload enable/disable and Git-based skill install/update.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-mcp-tool

[![Listed on DSH Plugin Hub](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/artorias-zj/dsh-skill-mcp-tool)
[![version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/artorias-zj/dsh-skill-mcp-tool?label=version&color=2ea44f)](https://github.com/artorias-zj/dsh-skill-mcp-tool/releases)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/artorias-zj/dsh-skill-mcp-tool?color=2ea44f)](LICENSE)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.15%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-2ea44f)](package.json)

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that puts **Skills and MCP servers under one roof**, reachable from both the settings menu and a main-interface sidebar entry — with **hot-reload enable/disable toggles** and **Git-based skill install/update**.

## Features

**Two entry points, one panel**

- Settings menu → "技能与 MCP" / "Skills & MCP" page.
- Main interface → a sidebar icon row that opens the same panel in the centre column.

Both render the identical component, so the four tabs (Skills / MCP / Remote sources / Backup) behave the same wherever you open them.

**The plugin updates itself from the panel**

A **version card** sits above the tab strip, styled exactly like the proxy card next to it: it shows the running version, checks the upstream repository on demand, and offers a one-click update when a newer tag — or newer commits on the default branch — exist.

- **Check** compares the installed version and the commit recorded in `pnpm-lock.yaml` against `git ls-remote` of the repository declared in `package.json`, using the same proxy as skill installs. It reports a version bump, a newer commit without a tag, "up to date", or "local-dir install, not checked".
- **Update** runs `pnpm add <the spec your profile already records>` in a **detached child process** — it does not uninstall the plugin. If it fails, the running version keeps working; on success you restart DSH to load the new code.
- It never occupies the request: the panel polls a status file, so a 30-second install does not hang the page, and the outcome survives a closed panel.

> **Why not hot-swap?** The host half is ESM cached by URL and the client bundle is cached by the browser, so an in-place replacement cannot take effect without a restart anyway. The panel says so instead of claiming success.

**Layout: the two entry points are handled separately**

The host's layout contract differs between the centre panel and the settings page, so the shell has two modes selected by `data-surface`:

- **Centre panel (opened from the sidebar icon)**: the host supplies neither padding nor a scroll container, so the plugin provides both — centred content with breathing room (up to 48px per side, shrinking responsively on narrow windows) plus its own scrolling.
- **Settings page**: the host already renders the section inside its content column (padding and scrolling included), so the plugin adds nothing on top — no doubled inset, no nested scrollbars.

**Scrolling: long skill lists stay reachable, with no visible scrollbar**

In the centre panel only the list scrolls while **the title and tabs stay pinned to the top**, so the refresh button and tab strip remain reachable even at the bottom of a long list, with breathing room after the last row.

**No visible scrollbar at all**: the wheel, trackpad, touch, and keyboard (arrow keys / PageUp / PageDown) all keep working — only the bar is no longer drawn. The horizontal insets therefore *always* equal the inner padding: symmetric left and right regardless of content length or whether scrolling is needed, with no sideways jump when a scrollbar would have appeared or disappeared. The same rules cover modals, so long forms still scroll.

`scrollbar-gutter: stable` is deliberately *not* used: it reserves scrollbar width even when the content fits (measured: `stable` 15px, `stable both-edges` 30px), leaving an empty band on a page that has nothing to scroll. All three hiding mechanisms are declared — `scrollbar-width`, `-ms-overflow-style`, and `::-webkit-scrollbar` — so no browser falls back to a native bar that would skew the insets.

**Ordering: alphabetical, always**

List order is **predictable**, so you never have to hunt through entries:

- **Skills**: grouped by source, with a fixed group order of **project → user → plugin → other** (it does not shift as skills come and go, so group headings stay put); **alphabetical by name within each group**.
- **MCP servers**: managed and external rows are each sorted alphabetically by server name.
- **Remote sources**: sorted alphabetically by repository label.
- Sorting is **case-insensitive**: `Chrome_DevTools_MCP` sorts before `REA`, instead of all uppercase names clumping at the top. Only when two names are identical in lowercase does the raw string break the tie, keeping the order stable.
- Managed rows are written to `cordis.patch.yml` in that same order, so the file and the UI never disagree.
- Ordering is applied at the single choke point every write path goes through, so add/edit/enable/disable/delete can't bypass it.

**Skills**

- Lists every skill from all four standard roots, in official rank order: project `.dsh/skills` (100) → project `.agents/skills` (200) → user `~/.dsh/skills` (400) → user `~/.agents/skills` (500).
- Handles both layouts: directory bundles (`<name>/SKILL.md`) and flat files (`<name>.md`), plus nested/categorised trees.
- **Enable/disable is a lossless rename**: `SKILL.md` ⇄ `SKILL.md.disabled` (or `<name>.md` ⇄ `<name>.md.disabled`). The official provider only recognises the exact filenames, so the skill leaves the catalog while its files and `references/`, `scripts/`, `assets/` stay fully intact. The provider's watcher picks the change up on the next catalog refresh — **no restart**.
- Malformed skills stay listed but flagged **格式不合规 / Invalid format**, so you can fix or delete them rather than being unable to see them.
- Plugin-registered skills (no file on disk) are listed read-only.
- Create, edit, and delete skills through the built-in editor; frontmatter is validated before anything touches disk.
- **Install / update from Git**: shallow-clone a repository (or a subdirectory of one), discover every valid skill inside, and copy it to the chosen root. Records the source so you can re-pull later; `git ls-remote` tells you whether an update exists.
- **Junk directories are filtered out on write**: `.git`, `.hg`, `.svn`, `node_modules`, `__pycache__`, `.venv` and friends never land in the skill directory. When the repository root *is* the skill bundle (a `SKILL.md` at the top level), the clone's `.git` would otherwise be copied wholesale — worth several MB of commit history and remote URLs. The UI lists exactly what was skipped.
- **Type `/` in a session to pick a skill**: this plugin registers the skills it manages into DSH's skill registry, so the `/` menu matches and invokes them directly. A skill marked `disable-model-invocation: true` appears *only* there (the model never sees it), and a skill shown as disabled in the UI never appears in `/`. Changes take effect immediately — no restart.

  > Why this plugin supplies its own provider: the host-level `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` row is deliberately disabled by the web app (its comment reads “presets own local discovery”), leaving each agent preset to mount its own. On some presets that provider does not actually take effect — skills on disk then appear neither in `/` nor to the model. This plugin does not depend on the preset being correct; it registers the roots it manages itself.

**Proxy: a Git proxy field above the tabs**

On many networks a direct `git clone` of a repository times out, which makes installing and updating skills impossible. A **proxy bar sits above the four tabs** — it is a prerequisite shared by every Git operation in every tab (install, update, check for updates), not a setting belonging to one of them.

- **Command-scoped, never global.** The address is injected as `git -c http.proxy=… -c https.proxy=… <subcommand>`. **Your global git config is never rewritten** — try `git config --global --get http.proxy` before and after; it is untouc

plugins.description: A shared Chromium browser workspace for DeepSeekHarness, designed for multi-agent automation, human takeover, and collaborative debugging.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-agent-team-browser **English** | [中文](README_zh.md) > **Status: architecture / pre-release.** This repository is being designed and implemented. The banner is conceptual artwork, not a screenshot of a released plugin. Features described as *planned* below are **not claims of working functionality**. Installation instructions, a tested compatibility range, and a release tag will be published **after** implementation and acceptance testing. Do not install a similarly named community package assuming it is this project. ## Summary **dsh-agent-team-browser** is a planned native **shared browser workspace for DeepSeekHarness (DSH)**. It is designed to integrate with DSH's official right sidebar and support **individual agents, Agent Teams, and human operators**—without requiring an external browser window to take foreground focus. One persistent browser workspace can contain multiple tabs. Authorized agents can work in different tabs concurrently, share an intentionally selected login context, and hand the **same tab** to another agent or a human through explicit control leases. The sidebar works like a monitor: switching the viewed tab does not switch, pause, or recreate the agents' background browser tasks. **Design principle:** **The team lead decides *who should do what*; the plugin enforces *who may do what, when, and on which browser resource*.** ## Project introduction > One browser workspace. Multiple agents. Human control when it matters. This project continues the `dsh-agent-team-*` naming family started by [bloodarea/dsh-agent-team-presets](https://github.com/bloodarea/dsh-agent-team-presets). The name emphasizes Agent Team collaboration, **not** an Agent Team-only dependency: it must also work for a single agent and for a person using the sidebar directly. The design deliberately separates three things that are often coupled together: | Layer | Responsibility | Lifetime | | --- | --- | --- | | **DSH Agent Session** | Who invokes a tool, including lead and teammates | Owned by DSH | | **Browser Workspace** | Browser contexts, tabs, permissions, retained state | Owned by this plugin | | **Sidebar Viewer** | Which tab a user is watching or controlling | Owned by the DSH UI | Closing the sidebar **must not** close a browser tab. Opening a teammate's distinct DSH Session **must not** create another browser just because its Session ID changed. When a team finishes, workspace retention and access revocation follow the workspace's explicit policy rather than the lifespan of the team chat. ## Why this plugin? Conventional browser MCPs, wrappers, and desktop automators often optimize for one agent controlling one visible browser. This project addresses six gaps: 1. **Host focus disruption.** Browser automation should not hijack the operating system's foreground mouse, keyboard, or active window. 2. **No coherent multi-agent ownership.** Multiple agents need one authorized workspace, not accidental duplication or concurrent navigation of the same tab. 3. **Sidebar-size-dependent viewport.** A narrow sidebar must not silently turn a `1920 × 1080` desktop test into a mobile layout. 4. **Weak human-in-the-loop control.** A person must be able to watch, take over one tab, resolve a difficult interaction, then return control to an agent. 5. **Insufficient developer visibility.** Network requests, responses, console messages, and cookies need inspectable, permission-aware tooling. 6. **Wrong lifecycle boundary.** Browser tabs should not disappear because a teammate's DSH Session was disposed or a sidebar pane was hidden. **Design principle:** the official DSH sidebar owns presentation; this plugin owns browser resources, identity-aware access, and concurrency safety. Browser execution remains independent from the presentation surface. ## Planned capabilities The following describes the **target specification**, not a completed feature list. | Capability | Intended behavior | | --- | --- | | **Native sidebar workspace** | Register a new Browser Workspace tab in the official DSH right sidebar, without replacing the built-in browser. | | **Silent browser runtime** | Headless Chromium + Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP); automation does not manipulate the host OS pointer or foreground window. | | **Multi-agent access** | Different DSH Sessions can bind to one authorized Browser Workspace by trusted Team/member identity. | | **Shared login state** | Tabs inside the same authorized `BrowserContext` share applicable cookies and same-origin storage. | | **Tab-level collaboration** | Separate tabs execute concurrently; one tab's multi-step writes require an exclusive lease. | | **Human takeover** | Observe the same page as an agent, request control, and return it without spawning a second page. | | **Independent viewport** | Per-tab CSS viewport, DPR, touch/mobile emulation; sidebar width only changes rendering scale. | | **Developer tools** | Inspect Fetch/XHR, response status/body (opt-in), Console, runtime errors, and governed cookie access. | | **Persistent workspaces** | Hide panes and switch agent chats without losing tabs; restore recoverable state after restart. | | **Solo mode** | Run without an Agent Team or `dsh-agent-team-presets` installed. | ### The sidebar is a viewer, not the browser process Think of the sidebar as a television and Chromium tabs as independent channels. Selecting another channel changes only the **viewed tab**. All other tabs continue running in the background; their pages, viewport sizes, and active agents remain unchanged. A human can take control of the channel being watched when permitted. ### Shared state does not mean shared page state Multiple tabs in one `BrowserContext` normally share cookies and, for the same origin, `localStorage` / IndexedDB. Each tab has its **own** DOM, URL, scroll state, and usually `sessionStorage`. Sites may impose additional authentication constraints; shared cookies do **not** guarantee universal single sign-on. Separate workspaces/teams are isolated by default unless sharing is explicitly authorized. ### Viewport is independent of sidebar dimensions For example, set the real page to `1920 × 1080` and display it inside a `420px` sidebar. The browser still reports approximately `window.innerWidth === 1920` CSS pixels (subject to page/environment specifics). The sidebar only fits or pans the rendered image. A human click is mapped back into browser coordinates before CDP receives it. Planned presets include `390 × 844`, `768 × 1024`, `1280 × 720`, and `1920 × 1080`; custom viewport sizes and DPR are separate controls. A resize of the DSH sidebar must **never** implicitly invoke a CDP viewport change. ## Use this package ### Availability and installation **There is no verified public install command or released version yet.** The proposed repository identity is `bloodarea/dsh-agent-team-browser`; availability of GitHub releases, npm packages, and plugin compatibility will be confirmed when a tested build exists. When the first release is published, this section will document: 1. Supported DSH release/commit or compatibility range and required Chromium runtime. 2. The exact **pinned release** installation command and which DSH profile to select. 3. Required Host/Client plugin configuration, startup procedure, and uninstall/migration steps. 4. How to verify the loaded plugin identity, version, sidebar entry, and browser runtime health. **Do not copy installation commands from `dsh-agent-team-presets`**: it is a distinct plugin with a separate release cycle. ### Intended workflow: a single agent 1. Open the planned **Browser Workspace** entry in the official right sidebar. 2. Create or select a workspace and open a browser tab. 3. Choose a viewport preset or enter a custom viewport.
