plugins.description: Give your AI a project memory: /init makes it read the codebase and write .dsh docs, then every later turn gets them injected back automatically.
plugins.readme_text: **English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) # dsh-knowledge — project knowledge system for DSH Let the AI read the project and write what it understood into `.dsh` documents, so every later development request starts with that knowledge already in context. **This plugin does not analyse code itself.** It does exactly two things: hand the prompt to the model, and inject the existing documents back into later turns. Reading the code, deciding feature boundaries and writing the documents is all done by the model with its own tools. ```text /init → the prompt goes in → the model explores the code → the model writes .dsh documents ↓ a development request → documents + update reminder injected → the model changes code → it decides for itself whether the documents went stale ``` ## Install Clone it (or point straight at the GitHub repo) and register it as a bundle in your DSH profile: ```bash cd "$DSH_PROFILE_DIR" pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile # links dsh-knowledge ``` `package.json` needs the dependency and the bundle: ```json { "dependencies": { "dsh-knowledge": "link:" }, "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["dsh-knowledge"] } } } ``` Swap `link:` for `github:/` to install straight from GitHub. `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the plugin line: ```yaml - insert: - id: dsh-knowledge name: 'dsh-knowledge' ``` **Zero runtime dependencies**: `node:` builtins only. ## Usage ### `/init [path]` — build the knowledge base ```text /init the model reads the whole project and writes to .dsh/ at the project root /init @src the model reads src/ only; documents still go to .dsh/ at the root /init src/lib nested paths work the same ``` Path parsing is deliberately loose: a leading `@` (left behind by the composer's completion) is stripped, paths with spaces can be quoted, naming the project's own directory means the whole project, and a missing path lists the available top-level directories. `/init` itself does exactly two things: **wake the model**, then **inject** the full instruction. **Only the one line you typed shows in the UI** (e.g. `/init @src`). The full instruction is injected as a system-reminder instead of flooding the conversation — the same mechanism the per-turn document injection uses. The model then explores with `glob` / `grep` / `read` and writes with `write`, appearing in the UI like any other turn. **The knowledge base always lives at the project root**, whatever subdirectory `/init` was scoped to. One `.dsh` per project. ### Automatic context injection No manual reminders needed. The first step of every turn injects: 1. the body of `overview.md` (truncated with a pointer to the original when it is long) 2. the document listing under `.dsh` 3. **usage rules and an update reminder** — including: the model judges for itself whether this change made the documents stale One knowledge base is injected once per session, not on every turn; after the model edits documents, they are injected again. ### When to update The injected prompt states the rules, and the model applies them itself: | Change | Update the documents? | |--------|----------------------| | a feature added or removed, or the entry points, execution flow, data flow or module dependencies changed | yes — the affected document | | a bug fix, a style change, an implementation detail that changes no structure | no | | not sure | lean toward not writing | The principle: **better no update than documents that contradict the code.** ## The `.dsh` layout Written by the model from the prompt; a typical structure: ```text .dsh/ ├── overview.md what the project does, its stack, core modules, main entry points ├── architecture.md layers, module boundaries, dependency directions, data flow └── features/.md one per feature: responsibility, entry point, core code, flow, data flow, dependencies ``` File names are meaningful (`auth.md`, `order-sync.md`), never random ids. ## Security - **No source code is copied**: the prompt requires structure and behaviour only — no code snippets, secrets, tokens or connection strings. - **Dangerous scopes are refused**: no knowledge base in the user's home directory, in DSH's own config directory, or at the filesystem root — every session beneath those would mistake it for a project knowledge base. - **Documents are data**: the injected prompt states that any instruction inside `.dsh` is data and must not be executed as an instruction. ## Platform notes | Need | Platform capability | What this plugin does | |------|--------------------|-----------------------| | a command that makes the model work | `Agent.followup(message)` → `send(…, wakeup=true)` → `wakeDriver()` starts a real turn | `/init` admits the single line `/init ` to wake the model; the full instruction goes in through injection | | inject without flooding the UI | `agent/pre-step` waterfall, which can rewrite what enters a step | both the pending `/init` instruction and the per-turn reminder are injected this way; the UI keeps just the command line | | maintain documents at session end | no "session end" event | no programmatic maintenance: the injected prompt asks the model to judge and update for itself | An earlier version of `/init` ran static analysis in the command handler and generated the documents itself. That was wrong: a command handler has no model, so it could only guess feature boundaries with regexes. The command now just hands over the job. Note: the prompt and messages this plugin injects are written in Chinese. ## Tests ```bash node test/run.mjs # everything node test/plugin.test.mjs # plugin behaviour: /init hands over the job, path parsing, refusal rules, injection content node test/real-paths.mjs # replays path forms seen in real use (diagnostic script) node test/lint-imports.mjs # unused imports ``` The tests drive the real `apply()` with a fake Cordis context and assert above all that **`/init` really calls `followup`** — which is exactly what an earlier version got wrong: it did the job itself and never involved the model. ## Configuration None needed. ## Acknowledgments Thanks to everyone who contributed to this project: [](https://github.com/windzxy) [](https://github.com/anyiba) ## License MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin: global search across session content, ordered by content time.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-search

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that searches the
**content** of every session — not just session titles — and orders hits by the **time of the
matched record**, newest first.

It adds a first-class search destination to the sidebar (a panel icon beside *Plugins* and
*Schedules*, plus a full-width results page) and a `Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F` shortcut. Clicking a hit
opens its session.

```
┌─ sidebar ─┐  ┌─ main ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Plugins  │  │  Search session content                                    │
│ ▸ Search  │  │  [ 会话                                            ]        │
│  Schedules│  │  All · My prompts · Replies · Tool output   ☐ subagents    │
│           │  │  43 hits · 8 sessions · 4 ms                               │
│           │  │ ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── │
│           │  │ 2026-09-11 01:55   user   修改 FreeCAD MCP 服务端口         │
│           │  │   我在使用这个 mcp 服务[插件]，但是端口被占用了…            │
└───────────┘  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## Why this plugin exists

Stock DSH can already *search* sessions — the sidebar search box is wired to a real
content-search pipeline:

```
WorkspaceBrowser → sessions.search(query) → ctx.remote.session.search
  → SessionController.search → ctx.sessionQuery.searchSessions(…)
```

It only ever finds titles because **three independent things** are true at once:

| # | Fact | Where |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | The content backend is **switched off** in the stock profile — `openAt: never`. The shipped comment says it plainly: *"the Web sidebar search matches titles and workspace names only."* | the `session-query-sqlite` row in `dsh-base/cordis.patch.yml` |
| 2 | That backend tokenizes with FTS5 `unicode61`, which treats **an entire CJK run as a single token**. Measured on a real machine: `光速太慢，星际文明无法成为整体` yields exactly two tokens, `光速太慢` and `星际文明无法成为整体` — so `MATCH '光速'` and `MATCH '星际'` both **return nothing**. The `trigram` tokenizer is no help either: it rejects 2-character queries. | verified locally against SQLite 3.53.4 |
| 3 | Even with the backend enabled, the wire shape is `{ items: [{ sessionId, snippet }] }` — **each hit's `time` is dropped at that layer**, and ranking is relevance-first (`time` is only a tie-breaker). | `dsh-api-session-controller/lib/index.js` |

So "order results by content time" is **not achievable through any shipped public remote**, and
for CJK content the shipped engine is the wrong tool regardless. This plugin therefore builds its
own index on the host: it incrementally parses every session transcript, keeps each record's text
together with **that record's own `time`**, matches by substring (correct for both CJK and Latin
text), and sorts by time. It needs **no profile configuration changes**.

---

## Where the search entry lives — and why

DSH's Web/desktop UI has **no global top bar** and **no global command palette** (`/` commands are
the composer's slash menu and are bound to the current session). Only three global seats are
available:

| Seat | Verdict |
|---|---|
| **`sidebar.panellist` icon + its matching `main` panel** | ✅ **Used here.** This is DSH's first-class "global panel" mechanism: the sidebar owns the button, the label and the selected state, and the list `id` maps directly to the `main` panel `key`. The shipped **Plugins** (order 0) and **Schedules** (order 10) panels work exactly this way; this plugin slots in between at order 5. `replaceRisk: none` — it cannot be clobbered by an upgrade. |
| `sidebar.footer.action` (next to Settings) + a `shell.overlay` dialog | ⭕ Viable alternative, better suited to a "spotlight" quick-search. Costs you hand-built overlay, focus and Escape handling, and leaves little room for snippets. |
| `sidebar.workspaces` (where the existing search box lives) | ❌ **Not used.** It is a `single` seat occupied wholesale by `ui-workspace`, with `replaceRisk: shadows-shipped-ui` — taking it means replacing the entire shipped session browser and breaking on the next DSH release. |

A **`Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F`** shortcut (registered through `dsh-client-shortcuts`) selects the panel from
anywhere. It is bound on the **desktop profiles only** on purpose: on the Web profiles the shipped
`session.fork` (`dsh-client-ui-workspace`) already owns `KeyF + primary+shift`, and the shortcut
registry validates a definition's defaults across every *declared* profile, throwing
`Conflicting shortcut defaults` from whichever plugin registers second. See
[Compatibility](#compatibility) for what that cost once.

For **searching inside the session you are reading**, the entry point is the `list` seat
`conversation.session.header.utilities` — the right-aligned action row of the conversation header.
It is additive (`replaceRisk: none`, ids `open-in-app` / `schedule-catalog` /
`session-log-download` already sit there), always in reach, and needs no new global chrome. The
find bar and the result dialog share one `shell.overlay` entry — the frame-wide layer documented as
"the additive seat for a frame-wide surface of your own" — so they float above every column without
stealing one.

---

## Install

This package is a standard DSH **bundle** (`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client` in its manifest).
Install it with the plugin manager:

```
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target="<absolute path to this repo>"
```

That writes the package into the profile's `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles` and links it
into the profile's `node_modules`. You do **not** need to hand-edit the profile's `package.json` or
`cordis.patch.yml`.

Disable or remove it again:

```
plugin_manager action=set_bundle    target=dsh-session-search enabled=false
plugin_manager action=remove_bundle target=dsh-session-search
```

### Mounting it manually instead

Add a row to the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` (the `name` may be a bare package specifier, a
path relative to the patch file, or an absolute path):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: session-search
      name: 'dsh-session-search'
```

> **A note on reloading.** The Harness loads plugin rows through Node's ESM loader, which caches
> both the resolved package entry and the module itself for the lifetime of the Host process.
> Re-enabling a row that previously failed re-runs the *cached* module, so a fix on disk is not
> observed until the app restarts — `dsh-hmr` can activate a **new** row, but it cannot swap a
> JavaScript module generation for an already-loaded package. `lib/entry.js` exists to work around
> this during development: it re-imports `lib/host.js` behind an mtime-keyed query, so host-side
> edits take effect on the next activation. In normal use it is simply the entry point.

---

## Usage

### Global search

1. Click the magnifier icon in the sidebar (between *Plugins* and *Schedules*), or press
   `Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F`.
2. Type a query. Matching is **substring**, case-insensitive, and works for CJK (a 2-character
   query matches inside a longer run, which the shipped FTS5 engine cannot do).
3. Narrow the results with the chips — *All* / *My prompts* / *Replies* / *Tool output* — and the
   *Include subagent sessions* toggle (off by default; subagent sessions routinely outnumber your
   own). The **session scope picker** at the top lists only the sessions that actually matched the
   current query, with hit counts (`title (12)`), so scoping to one of them is one click; with no
   query it lists recent sessions.
4. Click any hit to open it **with its context**: the matched record plus four records before and
   after, the match highlighted and untruncated. Use previous/next to move between hits, and
   *Open session* to jump to the session itself.

### Find in the conversation (Ctrl/Cmd+F)

Press `Ctrl/Cmd+F`, or click the magnifier in the conversation header's right-aligned utilities.
A small floating bar appears, searches the transcript, paints **every match** and scrolls the
active one into view:

- `Enter` / `Shift+Enter`, or `‹ ›`, cycle matches; `Esc` closes and clears the highlights.
- The match counter s

plugins.description: A GitHub Desktop-style Git panel for the DSH right sidebar: tick-to-stage, commit, commit and push, discard into a trash, and diff preview.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lite-git

**给 DSH 用的 GitHub Desktop 风格 Git 面板**——装在 DSH **自带的右侧栏**里，和「文件 / 文档 / 聊天」并排。

变更文件列表、勾选提交、Summary + Description、Commit / Commit and Push、一个会随分支状态变化的 Push/Fetch 按钮、舍弃更改进插件自己的回收站、双击看 diff——都在这一栏里。

> English: [README.en.md](./README.en.md)

> **0.7.0 起改名为 `dsh-lite-git`**（原 `dsh-gitbar-lite`）。包的 id、RPC 路由、状态目录都跟着换了，所以升级时要把旧的卸掉：
> `dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> remove dsh-gitbar-lite`，再按下面的「安装」装新的；
> 旧的 `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-gitbar-lite/`（仓库绑定、脚本、回收站）可以整个搬到 `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-lite-git/` 继续用。

## 为什么是「右侧栏的一个 tab」

DSH 的右栏本来就是一个常驻的标签区。Git 面板放这里，意味着它和会话是同一份上下文：**当前会话的工作区就是它看的仓库**，切换会话就跟着切，不用再挑一次目录。

面板很窄（右栏最小 300px，窄视口下会自动全屏），所以它是按窄栏设计的：文件列表单列、路径按「文件名 + 目录」两级显示、提交框只留一个 Summary 输入框加一个可展开的小三角。

## 功能

| 功能 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 变更文件列表 | 修改 / 新增 / 删除 / 重命名 / 未跟踪都能识别，每行带 `+n −n` 行数统计 |
| 勾选 | **勾选就是真的 `git add`**，取消就是 `git restore --staged`。终端里 `git status` 看到的就是同一件事 |
| 半暂存 | 一个文件索引和工作区都有改动时，勾选框显示成「半选」，点一下把它整体重述为勾上或没勾 |
| 全选 | 列表标题左边一个三态框：全选 / 取消全选，部分勾选时显示半选。**冲突文件不参与**，和自动勾选同一条规则 |
| 自动勾选 | **刷新时不看上一次，只看这一次新出现的**：列表重读之后，屏幕上新冒出来的改动自动勾上，已经在列表里的文件保持你留下的样子——所以刷新**不会**把你刚取消勾的文件勾回来。冲突文件、半暂存的文件不参与。**第一次打开**（或提交完）沿用老规则：索引里一个文件都没有才全部勾上；索引非空说明别处已经做过选择，不动 |
| Summary / Description | Summary 常驻一行；最右边一个小三角展开 Description |
| Commit | 只提交勾上的（因为勾选写进了索引） |
| Commit and Push | 提交后立刻推送；**推送失败不会说「提交失败」**——提交已经发生了，面板会明说「已提交 xxx，但推送失败」 |
| 上下文按钮 | 有本地未推送提交时是 **Push**，没有上游时是 **Publish**，否则是 **Fetch** |
| Push 前先 Fetch | 推送前会先 `git fetch --prune`，然后才推。**已经落后就拒绝推**并说明落后几个——git 的 push 从不合并，早晚都是被拒，先知道比推完再被拒有用。fetch 本身失败不阻断推送 |
| 自动 Fetch | 面板可见且仓库有远端时按 GitHub Desktop 的口径自己抓：默认 1 小时，每次到点重新判断，下一次从**上一次完成后**开始排，并加随机抖动防止多个面板同步。节奏是 `autoFetchMs`（`0` 关掉），并且用 `FETCH_HEAD` 的 mtime 判断"是不是刚抓过"——你在终端里抓也算 |
| 面板获得焦点 | **每次重新看向面板**都刷新一遍列表，并跑一遍脚本填 Summary：**打开面板**、切回这个标签、从对话点回面板、切回 DSH 窗口、浏览器标签回来，都算。手写的 Summary 不会被覆盖——只有空着的、或者还留着上次脚本填的那句话时才自动填 |
| 舍弃更改 | 单个文件或「全部舍弃」；动手前先把这次改动的 diff 归档，确认框里可以勾「彻底删除」 |
| 回收站 | 独立 tab。每次舍弃存一份 diff，并记下**是对哪个提交（`abc1234 初始提交`）取的 diff** |
| diff 预览 | 双击文件，或点回收站里的一条，在右栏开一个 diff 标签页——**永远只占一个**，再点就复用 |
| 用别的程序打开 | diff 页右上角一个「打开」按钮，**用上次那个程序**打开这个文件；旁边的小箭头列出所有能选的：系统默认程序、记事本、在文件夹中显示。程序在**宿主那台机器**上启动（所以手机远程看的时候，窗口开在电脑上），面板会给一句「已用 记事本 打开」。想加自己的编辑器就在配置里写 `openWith` |
| 仓库绑定 | 工作区本身是 Git 仓库就自动绑定并记住；不是就让你从工作区里扫出来的仓库里挑，或直接填路径 |

## 前置条件

| 需要什么 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.2` | 右侧栏 tab API 是这一版的行为 |
| Node `>= 22` | 宿主半边用到 `AbortSignal.any` 与 `node:test` |
| **本机有一个 `git`** | 默认从 `PATH` 找；找不到时面板会明确说「本机找不到 git」，不会静默失败。装在别处可以用 `gitPath` 指定 |
| 凭据 | Push 用的是**系统 git 的凭据**（credential helper）。先在终端里成功 push 过一次，插件就跟着能推 |

插件不会自己存任何凭据。宿主半边不读 `$DSH_HOME` 里的密钥，也不写。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-lite-git
```

装完**重启 DSH**。然后在一个会话里打开右侧栏，引导页上会多一张 **「Git 更改」** 卡片，点它就进面板。

<details>
<summary>从本地克隆安装 / 卸载 / 装完打不开怎么办</summary>

**本地目录安装**（改代码时用这个）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/绝对路径/dsh-lite-git
```

**卸载**：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> remove dsh-lite-git
```

**装完 DSH 起不来**：先跑 `node scripts/check-client-bundle.mjs .`。DSH 把
`exports["./client"]` 当**精确文件路径**读，没有扩展名补全也没有目录回退；指向一个不存在的文件会直接
`MissingClientBundleError` **中止整个 Host 启动**，而不是「这个插件不显示」。这个脚本就是复刻那条判定，让你不必靠重启去试。

</details>

## 使用

```
右栏引导页
┌──────────────────────────────────┐
│  ▸ Git 更改                      │  ← 引导卡片，点开面板
│    查看改动、勾选要提交的文件…    │
└──────────────────────────────────┘
        ↓ 点开
┌──────────────────────────────────┐
│ dsh-lite-git  main   ↑1 ↓0    │  ← 仓库名 / 分支 / 领先落后
│              [Push] [↻] [🗄] [⑂]  │  ← 上下文按钮、刷新、回收站、换绑
│ 更改   5 个文件 · 已勾选 2  [全部舍弃] │
│ ☑ M  a.txt                  +3 −1 ↩│  ← 双击 = 看 diff；↩ = 舍弃这个文件
│ ▣ M  src/big.ts            +12 −4 ↩│  ← ▣ = 半暂存
│ ☐ ?  new note.md             +7   ↩│
│ ☐ D  docs/old.md             −31  ↩│
│ ☐ R  moved.txt                    ↩│
│ ┌────────────────────────────┐ ˅ │  ← ˅ 展开 Description
│ │ Summary（必填）             │   │
│ └────────────────────────────┘   │
│ [   Commit   ] [ Commit and Push ]│
└──────────────────────────────────┘
```

- **勾选**：点一下写进索引，再点一下撤出。半选状态点一下会整体勾上，再点整体撤出。
- **双击文件行** → 右栏开 diff 标签页；再双击别的文件，**复用同一个标签页**。
- **舍弃**（行尾 ↩ 或「全部舍弃」）→ 弹确认框：

  ```
  舍弃「a.txt」的更改？
   · a.txt
   ☐ 彻底删除（不存入回收站）
     这次的 diff 会存进插件的回收站，之后还能回看是改了什么。
  [ 取消 ]  [ 舍弃 ]
  ```

  **默认不勾「彻底删除」**：这次改动的 diff 会存进回收站。勾上就什么都不留。这个勾选框会记住你上一次的选择。
- **回收站**（🗄）：按时间列出记录，每条显示「多久之前 · 单个文件/全部更改 · 文件数 · +n −n · 基于 `abc1234 初始提交`」。
  点一条看 diff，点 ↺ 把它恢复回工作区（**恢复出来的文件回到列表时是勾上的**），行尾的 🗑 删掉它，
  右上「清空回收站」一次清掉（只清当前仓库，勾上「显示全部仓库」就清全部）。
- **换绑**（⑂）：解除当前绑定。工作区是仓库会重新自动绑定；不是的话回到选择界面。

### 舍弃到底做了什么

顺序是固定的，不能换：

1. 按当前改动生成 diff（已跟踪的文件走 `git diff HEAD`；**未跟踪的新文件由插件自己合成一份 new-file diff**，
   因为 `git diff HEAD` 看不见它们，而舍弃未跟踪文件就是删掉它——不先合成，回收站里就只剩一条「删了一个文件」的空记录）。
2. 存进回收站（除非勾了「彻底删除」）。
3. 已跟踪的 `git restore --source=HEAD --staged --worktree`；未跟踪的直接删文件，并把因此变空的目录一起清掉。

> **冲突中的文件会被拒绝舍弃**，只给一句提示。在合并中途 `git restore` 到 HEAD 有扰动合并状态的风险，不值得为省一句话去冒。

### 用脚本填 Summary

**脚本就在面板里写**：展开 Description 的小三角，下面有一个「填 Summary 的脚本」按钮，点开是一个编辑框——写进去、保存、运行并填入，全在这里，不用去翻配置文件。**编辑框一开始是空的**，什么都不会预先填进去（占位提示里给了一个例子）；保存、运行、刷新都会给一条短暂提示，不用猜刚才那一下到底按到没有。**每次重新看向面板都会自动跑一次**（**打开面板**、切回这个标签、从对话点回面板、切回 DSH 窗口都算）——把侧边栏开着，去对话里让 agent 干活，回来，Summary 已经填好了；不过**你自己手写过的 Summary 不会被冲掉**，那时想更新就点星星按钮。配了脚本之后，Summary 框旁边还会多一个星星按钮，一点就填。

脚本以**仓库根目录为工作目录**运行，不喂任何 stdin。所以「取 CHANGELOG 最顶上的版本号」就是：

```sh
grep -m1 '^## ' CHANGELOG.md | sed 's/^## //'
```

输出即 Summary。要同时填 Description，就在输出里单独放一行 `---`，**该行之后**的全部内容是 Description：

```sh
echo "1.4.2"
echo "---"
echo "Bumped the patch version."
```

关于 shell：Windows 上优先用 Git 自带的 `sh`（`grep`/`sed`/`awk` 都可用），并把它的 `usr/bin` 补回 `PATH`——否则那些工具会「command not found」。机器上没有 `sh` 才退回 `cmd.exe`，那时脚本要按 cmd 语法写。非 Windows 就是 `sh`。

脚本失败不弹错误横幅，退出码会以一条短暂提示显示；它的 stderr 原样保留，方便你自己判断。


> 脚本是**按仓库**存的（键是仓库路径，文件在 <DSH_HOME>/dsh-lite-git/scripts.json）：A 项目配的脚本不会跑到 B 项目里。一个从没配过脚本的仓库，编辑框是**空的**——不预先填任何脚本，占位提示只给个例子；清空保存之后它也真的空着。

## 配置

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `gitPath` | `""` | 指定 git 可执行文件；空 = 从 `PATH` 找 |
| `stateDir` | `""` | 插件状态目录；空 = `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-lite-git` |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | 单条 git 命令超时。推到慢远端可以调大 |
| `maxDiffBytes` | `524288` | 一份归档 diff 的上限；超出按**行**截断并记下丢了多少行 |
| `maxFileBytes` | `2097152` | 比这大的未跟踪文件只列出来，不读内容、不归档、不出 diff |
| `trashLimit` | `200` | 回收站保留多少条；超出丢弃最旧的连同它的 diff 文件 |
| `scanDepth` | `3` | 「不是仓库时」扫描工作区找仓库的目录深度 |
| `autoFetchMs` | `300000` | 面板自己多久 fetch 一次；`0` = 关掉，只用手动按钮 |
| `summaryScript` | `""` | 填 Summary 的脚本。以仓库根为工作目录运行，输出即 Summary；单独一行 `---` 之后算 Description |
| `openWith` | `[]` | diff 页右上角「用…打开」的下拉里，**额外**多出来的程序。每项 `{ label, command, args }`，`args` 里 `{path}` 换成文件、`{dir}` 换成所在目录，都不写就把路径接在最后（例：`- label: VS Code` / `command: code` / `args: ['{path}']`）。每项已经是**一个参数**，不是 shell 命令行，所以带空格的路径不会被拆开。系统自带的那三个（系统默认程序 / 记事本 / 在文件夹中显示）不用写，一直都在 |

每个字段都是 volatile 的，所以在设置页改了立刻生效、不用重启。

**状态存在哪**：`<DSH_HOME>/dsh-lite-git/`（没有 `DSH_HOME` 就回落 `~/.dsh`）——
`bindings.json`（工作区 → 仓库）、`prefs.json`（那两个勾选偏好）、`trash/index.json` + `trash/<id>.diff`。
**回收站只存那一个 diff，不额外留一份文件副本**：恢复时用 `git apply` 把它重放回去，
那既是面板显示的记录，也是回放所需的全部内容；重放完再把这些路径 `git add` 进索引，
所以恢复出来的文件回到列表时是勾上的。都是先写临时文件再 rename，所以写到一半崩了也不会把文件截断。

## 工作原理

```
lib/shared.js          线协议字面量（浏览器半边手抄一份，自检脚本负责比对）
lib/index.js           插件入口：Config、apply、把路由挂到 connection.fetch
lib/host/git.js        git 执行层：走 ctx.subprocess，解析可执行文件、限流输出、清洗环境
lib/host/parse.js      porcelain v2 / numstat 解析（纯函数）
lib/host/diff.js       diff 合成、按行截断、按文件切分（纯函数）
lib/host/repo.js       仓库操作：status / stage / commit / push / fetch / fileDiff / discard
lib/host/store.js      绑定、偏好、回收站（原子写 + 按文件串行化）
lib/host/workspace.js  会话 → 工作区目录
lib/host/routes.js     单条 /api 路由 + action 分发 + 错误码映射
lib/client.js          浏览器半边：三个 tab 类型 + 面板/回收站/diff，手写、无构建
```

几个值得写下来的决定：

- **一条 `/api` 路由 + `action` 字段**，不是一条路由一个操作。`connection.fetch` 按精确 pathname 匹配，
  而每次调用本来就要带 `sessionId`；分开写只会把十五个路径字面量摊到两种语言里。
- **必须挂在 `connection.fetch` 上，绝不挂 `webServer` 的 exact 路由**：web server 会先匹配 exact 路由，
  而同路径的 exact 路由会遮蔽 `/api` 前缀路由——Host/Origin fence、浏览器 cookie 校验、operator 身份**全在那条前缀路由上**。
  用 exact 就等于开了一个不需要鉴权的 git 接口。测试与自检脚本都专门盯这一条，并且**反过来验证这条断言是有牙齿的**。
- **diff tab 用 `dsh-resource://` 固定地址**，不是 page kind。重新打开同一个资源地址会让宿主**聚焦已开的那个 tab**，
  并把新的 `params` 导航进去；page kind 只在当前 dock pane 内复用，被浮动出去就会多开一个。固定地址本身就是「永远只占一个」。
- **不发 `-m`，用 `-F -` 把提交信息从 stdi

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：Qwen-Image 2.1出图与参考图编辑，支持 ComfyUI / 官方 API。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-image-forge

![dsh-image-forge：肥鱼女仆指着一张画布，画面上是「dsh-image-forge」标题与画板/素材库的功能示意](docs/images/repo-banner.png)

[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-blue)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)

在 DeepSeek Harness 里用 Qwen-Image 出图、改图。

说「画一张 16:9 的夏日饮料海报」，出图；丢一张客厅照片说「改成晚上的」，改图。比例、像素由插件换算，不用你查表。

后端二选一：**你自带的云端 key**，或**你本机装好的 ComfyUI**。插件不自带运行时，不下载权重。

---

## 能不能用

| 你手上有的 | 能做什么 |
|---|---|
| 只有云端 API key | 文生图。**改图不行**，云 API 没有编辑通道 |
| 只有 ComfyUI（+ 三个权重） | 出图 + 改图，全离线 |
| 两者都有 | 出图走 key，改图自动落到 ComfyUI |
| 两者都没有 | 先看 [ComfyUI 部署指引](docs/comfyui-deployment.md) |

---

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Demerier/dsh-image-forge
```

装完重启 DSH。对话里能看到 `qwen_image_generate` / `qwen_image_edit` / `qwen_image_status` 三个工具，设置页左侧出现「Qwen 出图」，第一页就是工作台。

本机改代码时：

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <本仓库绝对路径>
```

> 别用 `npm install` 装它——这是 DSH 插件，脱离宿主跑不起来。
> `pnpm build` 报 `Cannot find package 'ansis'` 时，删掉 `node_modules` 重装（本仓库用 `nodeLinker: hoisted` 绕开这个问题）。

---

## 配置

14 个字段都有默认值，日常只看这 6 个：其余见 [docs/configuration.md](docs/configuration.md)。

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `backend` | `auto` | `auto` / `api` / `comfyui`。**改图只能 `comfyui`** |
| `apiKey` | 空 | 建议留空，改用环境变量，key 就不进 profile 文件 |
| `comfyEndpoint` | 空 | 如 `http://127.0.0.1:8188`。留空自动探测端口；非回环地址会被拒绝 |
| `comfyModelsDir` | 自动探测 | ComfyUI 的 `models` 目录，只影响报错信息里写的路径 |
| `comfyModel` | `base` | `turbo`（8 步，快约 2.7×）或 `base`（25 步）。写实、中文文字、古典构图用 `base` |
| `outputDir` | `~/Pictures/dsh-image-forge` | 图片存哪 |

- Key 依次读 `apiKey` → `QWEN_IMAGE_API_KEY` → `DASHSCOPE_API_KEY` → `OPENAI_API_KEY`。不写盘、不进日志。
- 步数优先级：调用时显式传的 > `comfyuiSteps` > `defaultSteps`。turbo 用自己的 `turboSteps`（默认 8）。
- 设置页三个页签：出图、云端 API、ComfyUI。

---

## 出图

在对话里直接说需求就行。模型会把话改写成契约再调工具，你不用管：

```json
{"rewritten_prompt": "A wide photograph of …", "wh_ratio": "16:9"}
```

`wh_ratio` 七档，对应像素（约 1.5MP，32 对齐）：

| `wh_ratio` | 像素 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|
| `1:1` | 1248×1248 | |
| `4:3` | 1408×1056 | |
| `3:4` | 1056×1408 | |
| `3:2` | 1536×1024 | |
| `2:3` | 1024×1536 | |
| `16:9` | 1664×928 | 32 网格上无法精确，偏差 +0.86% |
| `9:16` | 928×1664 | 偏差 −0.86% |

- 要固定像素就传 `width` / `height`（32 的倍数），优先于 `wh_ratio`。
- 图片存为 `<outputDir>/<prefix>_<W>x<H>_<n>.png`，编号自动跳过已占用的名字，重复出图不会覆盖旧的。

---

## 改图

给了参考图就是改图任务。

```text
qwen_image_edit(prompt = <改图指令>, images = ["D:\\pictures\\room.png"], ratio_follow = "image1")
```

画布怎么定，三选一：

| 你说的话 | 传什么 | 画布 |
|---|---|---|
| 明说了比例或像素 | `wh_ratio`（或 `width`+`height`） | 该比例 |
| 没说，但想跟随某张图 | `ratio_follow: "image1"` | 按该图长宽比取最接近的像素 |
| 什么都没说 | 都不传 | 跟随第一张参考图 |

- 路径必须绝对；只认 PNG / JPEG / WebP。
- `wh_ratio` 和 `ratio_follow` 同时传会直接报错，二选一。
- 改图只走 ComfyUI。`backend: "api"` 会明确报错，不会把参考图丢掉。
- 多张参考图时用 `<image1>` `<image2>` 指明用途，并说清哪张是画布。
- 显存不够就先调小 `width` / `height`。

---

## 工作台

设置页第一个页签。不想每次在对话里贴参数，就在这里点。

- **画幅只有七档**，标的像素就是实际送进 ComfyUI 的像素。
- **传了参考图就是改图**（最多 10 张），留空就是文生图。
- **提示词优化**用当前会话的模型改写，结果写回输入框，你改完再生成。
- **结果是一块画布**：拖空白处平移、滚轮缩放。选中一张点「用作参考」，下一轮就变成改图，新图会从原图拉一条虚线过来，改了哪几轮一眼看清。
- **按画板归档**：顶部切换 / 新建 / 重命名，画布位置自动保存，重开页面回到上次的画板。「素材」页可以跨画板搜索，把图用作参考、定位回画布、或删掉。

ComfyUI 没起来时面板照样打开，顶部会写清查了哪些端口、为什么失败。

> 「优化提示词」需要宿主装了 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`。没有的话只有这个按钮不可用，出图不受影响。

---

## 工具

| 工具 | 用途 | 主要参数 |
|---|---|---|
| `qwen_image_generate` | 出图 | `prompt`、`wh_ratio`、`width`/`height`、`steps`、`seed`、`count`、`transparent`、`backend`、`preset`、`board` |
| `qwen_image_edit` | 改图 | `prompt`、`images`（1–10 张）、`ratio_follow` 或 `wh_ratio`、`board` |
| `qwen_image_status` | 检查环境 | 无 |

不确定为什么跑不通时，先跑 `qwen_image_status`。它会告诉你云 API 通不通、ComfyUI 在不在、三个权重能不能识别、显卡剩多少显存、输出目录能不能写。不产图、不写盘。

`board` 不传时会新建一块画板，把返回的 `board.id` 传回后续调用就能归到同一块。

---

## 提示词怎么写

模型会自动改写，这里只说改写的方向。完整规则见 [T2I 规则](references/t2i_rules.md) 与 [改图规则](references/edit_rules.md)。

| 场景 | 你可以这么说 | 改写方向 |
|---|---|---|
| 海报、页面、多物宽景 | 「画一张夏日饮料海报」 | 一整段英文散文，从背景到顶部到主体再到下方依次描写。**比例不写进正文** |
| 肖像、特写、单品 | 「画我的猫的大头照」 | 同上，顺序是背景 → 姿态 → 头脸 → 身体 → 手持物 → 边缘细节 |
| 单张参考图改图 | 「把这张客厅改成晚上的」 | 只动点名的属性，其余保持。不加 `<image1>` 标签 |
| 多张参考图 | 「把我放进那张客厅照片」 | 必须用 `<image1>` `<image2>` 逐张说明，并指明哪张是画布 |
| 只想问怎么写 | 「这种需求提示词怎么写」 | 只给改写结果，不出图 |

工作台里可切两种风格：「长散文」（约 20 句英文细节描写）和「关键词」（`主体+场景+风格+镜头+氛围+细节修饰`，逗号分隔）。两派都遵守：比例不写进正文、画面里的文字逐字照抄。

---

## 后端

`auto` 的判断只有一步：有 key 走云 API，没有走 ComfyUI。

- **云 API**：一次 HTTP 请求，不占本机显存。没有编辑通道，每张图都要联网。
- **ComfyUI**：本机唯一能改图的路。8 GB 卡（RTX 4070 Laptop）实测，文生图 1312×736 约 2 s/步，1.5MP 的 8 步改图 19–23 s。
- **turbo 不保证生效**：没装 turbo 权重会自动退回 `base`，结果里会有提示。盲测 5 题 base 3 : 2 turbo，单张 27–29 s → 9–11 s。turbo 氛围更强，但材质细节、中文小字、印章、古典构图会输给 base。

部署见 [ComfyUI 部署指引](docs/comfyui-deployment.md)，两条路的详细取舍见 [docs/backends.md](docs/backends.md)。

---

## 可能踩的坑

- **云 API 不能改图**。给了参考图又指定 `backend: "api"` 会报错，不会静默丢图。
- 参考图只认 PNG / JPEG / WebP 的文件头，TIFF、AVIF 会被拒绝并说明原因。
- 没有局部重绘、没有放大。素材页只做检索和整理，不做批量导出或调色。
- 插件不会替你装 ComfyUI、不下权重、不改它的启动参数。
- 显存不够时报的是 ComfyUI 自己的 CUDA OOM，插件不做前置检查。卡上同时跑游戏或 Blender 会明显变慢。
- 图在对话里的显示靠工具结果里的 Markdown 绝对路径。

---

## 许可

插件本体 MIT。**权重和官方提示词原文都不随包分发。**

- Qwen-Image-2.1 权重受 **Qwen RESEARCH LICENSE** 约束，限研究用途，商用需自行向权利方取得授权。插件不下载、不携带。
- ComfyUI 是可选外部依赖（GPL-3.0），插件只通过 HTTP 与你的实例通信。
- `skill.md` 和 `references/*.md` 是本插件自撰的规则，不是官方原文。

> 「Qwen」「千问」是阿里巴巴集团商标。本项目是第三方作品，与阿里巴巴无关联、未获其背书。开源许可不授予商标使用权。详见 [docs/license-and-limits.md](docs/license-and-limits.md)。

ComfyUI 后端与工作流占位符协议（`{{prompt}}` / `{{seed}}` / `{{image}}`）参考并移植自 [dsh-image-gen](https://github.com/shanliuling/dsh-image-gen)（Copyright 2026 shanliuling，Apache-2.0），许可全文见 [THIRD-PARTY](THIRD-PARTY/dsh-image-gen/LICENSE)。

---

## 更多文档

| 文档 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| [docs/comfyui-deployment.md](docs/comfyui-deployment.md) | 本机部署：下载、建实例、放权重、校验、排障 |
| [docs/configuration.md](docs/configuration.md) | 14 个配置字段的默认值和边界 |
| [docs/usage-reference.md](docs/usage-reference.md) | 像素怎么算、表外比例、`board` 用法、`status` 各字段 |
| [docs/backends.md](docs/backends.md) | 两条后端的详细对比 |
| [docs/license-and-limits.md](docs/license-and-limits.md) | 分发和商用前的注意事项 |
| [docs/testing.md](docs/testing.md) | 开发：怎么跑测试 |
| [docs/client-bundle.md](docs/client-bundle.md) | 开发：改客户端和设置页 UI |
| [docs/release-notes-0.2.0.md](docs/release-notes-0.2.0.md) | 0.2.0 改了什么，以及从 0.1.0 升上来要注意什么 |

# dsh-plugin-model-whitelist

**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md)

给 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的模型选择器加一道**白名单**：在「设置 → 模型」里逐个勾选，
没勾的模型就从输入框的模型菜单里消失。

- **默认不隐藏任何模型** —— 空白名单的行为与官方完全一致，装上去看不出区别。
- **随时可恢复** —— 隐藏的模型仍列在设置页里，勾回来即可。
- **不遮蔽官方界面** —— 模型菜单、推理等级、键盘操作、失败提示全部保持官方原样。

---

## 它解决什么问题

模型多了以后，选择器菜单会变得很长：多个 provider、几十个模型、还有地区受限或常年不可用的
条目夹杂其中。每次切换模型都要在一长串列表里翻找。

这个插件让你把不用的模型收起来，只留下常用的那几个。

它**不是**用来禁用或卸载模型的 —— 隐藏只影响选择器菜单的显示，模型本身、provider 配置和
调用链路都不受影响。

## 安装

### 命令行（纯 `dsh web`）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @swyc520/dsh-plugin-model-whitelist
dsh --profile web --dump-config   # 确认插件行已进入配置树
```

安装后重启一次 `dsh web`。

### 桌面端 / DSHEAC AIO

桌面端的 profile 由 Electron 应用独占，命令行 `dsh plugin add` 无法写入。请在应用内的
插件管理器里安装；若手工安装，注意桌面端的 profile 闸门**不允许 `link:` 依赖或目录 junction**，
必须是真实目录。

## 使用

1. 打开 **设置 → 模型**。
2. 滚到页面底部，找到「**模型显示**」面板。
3. 取消勾选不想看到的模型。

面板顶部显示 `显示 N/M`，每个 provider 一张卡片。五个按钮：
**全部显示**、**全部隐藏**、**全部展开**、**全部折叠**、**重新读取**。

### 折叠分组

点 provider 卡片的**标题行**即可折叠 / 展开该组：箭头会转向，标题右侧显示该组的模型数
（有隐藏时改为显示已隐藏数量）。折叠状态会被记住，刷新后保持。

折叠纯粹是**阅读便利**：它不会隐藏任何模型，选择器菜单完全不受影响。provider 多的时候
用「**全部折叠**」一次收起来。

改完立刻生效，无需刷新。

> 如果面板里显示「还没有读到模型清单」，打开一次模型选择器即可 —— 模型目录由官方
> 模型选择插件按需加载，本插件读取的是同一份数据。

## 工作原理

这一节说明插件为什么这样实现，以及它在什么情况下会失效。

### 白名单存在浏览器本地存储里

键名 `dsh-model-whitelist/v1`，按「浏览器 + Web 地址」隔离。它**不写入** `settings.yaml`、
不改动任何 provider 配置，也不上传。清除浏览器数据会一并清掉白名单。

存两类状态：`hidden`（不进选择器的模型）与 `collapsed`（面板里折叠的 provider 卡片）。
两者刻意分开 —— 折叠是阅读便利，绝不能和「隐藏模型」混为一谈。

选择「隐藏集」而不是「显示集」来持久化：新模型（新版本、新接入的 provider）默认可见。
若持久化「显示集」，每个新模型都会被静默隐藏，那读起来像 bug。

### 过滤是「投影」，不是「遮蔽」

dsh 为每个 UI 扩展位（slot）都标注了 `replaceRisk`。官方的模型选择器位于
`conversation.input.model`，标注为 **`shadows-shipped-ui`** —— 注册到那里会**替换**官方控件，
连带它的菜单、推理等级子菜单、键盘处理和失败行一起接管。对一个「显示偏好」来说这是很差的
交换。

官方选择器读取模型目录的链路是公开的：

```
ctx.modelDirectories.catalog.store.getSnapshot()
  -> { value: { groups: [{ id, name, models: [...] }], default, failures },
       status, error }
```

`createSnapshotStore` 返回的是普通对象（`{ getSnapshot, subscribe, update, set }`），
`getSnapshot` 是普通方法。本插件因此**包装这一个方法**，返回过滤后的快照：

- 官方组件照常渲染它**自己**的界面，只是它读到的列表少了被隐藏的模型；
- 真实 store 从不被写入，`subscribe` 仍然报告真实变化，所以目录更新与白名单改动都会触发重渲染；
- 投影是幂等且全函数式的：只复制 `groups` 数组，且仅在确实隐藏了东西时才复制。

插件在注销时恢复原方法。

### 因此它不会拖垮启动

客户端插件若在激活阶段抛异常，宿主会以 `web boot: 1 entry did not activate` 中止启动。
本插件对此做了两件事：

1. 导出 cordis 需要的 `inject` 数组（`['locale', 'slots']`），让宿主等到依赖就绪再调用 `apply`；
2. 每一处可能失败的读取（`require` 官方组件库、取服务、读本地存储、投影快照）都包在
   `try/catch` 内并降级：拿不到官方组件库就退回普通元素，拿不到服务就显示空状态，
   读存储失败就当作空白名单，投影出错就返回未过滤的快照。

最坏情况是「不隐藏任何模型」，而不是打不开应用。

## 兼容性

在 **dsh `0.2.0-rc.2`**（桌面端 @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.0-rc.2，Electron 44，
Node 24.18.1）上实测通过：面板正常显示、勾选后选择器菜单立即少掉对应模型、勾回后恢复。

插件依赖的公开面是 `ctx.modelDirectories.catalog.store` 的快照形状与
`settings.models.footer` 座位。前者是官方模型选择插件对外的服务字段，后者由 dsh 的
slot 契约文档化并标注 `replaceRisk: none`。两者若在未来版本改变形状，插件会退化为
「面板为空」或「不过滤」，不会中断启动。

未在 0.1.x 系列上验证。

## 已知限制

- **白名单只影响选择器菜单的显示**。已选中的模型若被隐藏，它仍会继续工作；
  当前会话正在使用的模型你仍可在设置页里隐藏，不影响正在进行的对话。
- 面板在打开时读取一次目录，并订阅后续变化；若某个 provider 的模型清单是懒加载的，
  需先触发一次加载（打开一次模型选择器）才会出现在面板里。
- 白名单与折叠状态按浏览器与地址隔离。换端口、换浏览器或清空站点数据都会丢。
- 没有「按 provider 整组隐藏」的批量操作（只有全部显示 / 全部隐藏）。**折叠**可以整组收起，
  但它不改变哪些模型可见。
- 折叠功能只做在设置面板里。模型选择器菜单本身由官方组件渲染，往那里加折叠需要遮蔽官方
  界面（`replaceRisk: shadows-shipped-ui`），本插件刻意不这么做。

## 开发

```bash
node scripts/verify-client.mjs
```

该脚本用一个打桩的模块表和小型渲染器载入 `lib/client.js`，然后断言：工厂与导出形态正确、
`inject` 数组存在、座位注册命中 `settings.models.footer`、**投影确实过滤掉了被隐藏的模型**、
**折叠只影响渲染而不影响 hidden 集或选择器**，同时覆盖空/畸形快照、服务缺失、本地存储被拒
等降级路径。

## 许可证

MIT。见 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 与 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

版本变更见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

plugins.readme_text:
# cache-sentinel

English | [日本語](README.ja.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that prevents accidental sends to old sessions whose prompt cache has expired.

If you send a follow-up message to a session where some time has passed since the last response, the entire accumulated conversation history is billed at the regular uncached input rate. `cache-sentinel` monitors the time elapsed since the last response and prevents accidental sends by automatically blocking sends to old sessions or automatically archiving the sessions themselves.

## Overview

For sessions where the prompt cache lifetime has passed, this plugin prevents accidental sends in two ways:

- **Input blocking (`block`)**: Keeps the session open and readable while stopping only sends that call the model. When you want to continue sending, you can allow just the next send using the button above the input box or the `/unlock` command.
- **Auto-archiving (`archive`)**: Automatically archives sessions that have not been updated for a while, hiding them from the sidebar so they cannot be opened.

You can switch at any time from the chat `/sentinel` command to `both` mode, which combines both (input blocking after 60 minutes, archiving after 24 hours), or `off` mode, which temporarily disables the feature.

## Installation

1. Run the following single command.

   ```sh
   dsh plugin --profile web add github:AliceSaikawa/cache-sentinel
   ```

   `web` is an example. Specify the profile name you actually use. cache-sentinel works only in profiles that include the Web app, such as `web` and `desktop` (see [Supported Versions and Environment](#supported-versions-and-environment)).

   This installs the latest `main`. To pin a version, append a tag as `#v<version>` (for example, `github:AliceSaikawa/cache-sentinel#v1.2.3`). Tags up to and including `v0.5.0` do not contain the built `lib/`, so they cannot be installed this way. You can also install by giving the URL of the `cache-sentinel.tgz` attached to a GitHub Release.

2. Restart DSH.

   Plugin code is loaded when DSH starts, so a restart is required after adding it.

   Example when running DSH as a systemd user service:

   ```sh
   systemctl --user restart deepseek-harness
   ```

### Check, Update, and Remove

- **Check installation**:
  ```sh
  dsh plugin --profile web list cache-sentinel --depth 0
  ```
- **Update**: Run the same installation command again to re-add the latest version, and then **be sure to restart DSH** (toggling the plugin off and on before restarting will continue to use the old code loaded in the process).
- **Remove**:
  ```sh
  dsh plugin --profile web remove cache-sentinel
  ```

## Usage

### Modes

| Mode | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `block` (default) | Blocks input once `idleMinutes` (default: 60 minutes) have passed since the last response (viewing is still allowed). `/unlock` allows the next single send |
| `archive` | Automatically archives the session once `idleMinutes` (default: 60 minutes) have passed since the last update (hidden from the sidebar and cannot be opened) |
| `both` | Blocks input `idleMinutes` (default: 60 minutes) after the last response, and automatically archives `archiveAfterMinutes` (default: 1440 minutes = 24 hours) after the last update |
| `off` | Neither blocks input nor archives sessions (`/sentinel` and `/unlock` commands remain available) |

### `/sentinel` Command

You can check the current status and switch modes from the chat input box.

- `/sentinel`: Shows the current effective mode and its source (set via `/sentinel` / set in YAML), thresholds, elapsed minutes since the last response in this session, and `dryRun` status.
- `/sentinel block` | `archive` | `both` | `off`: Switches the effective mode. It is saved to `$DSH_HOME/cache-sentinel/state.json` and preserved across DSH restarts (takes precedence over `mode` in YAML).
- `/sentinel default`: Clears the mode saved via `/sentinel` and reverts to the `mode` setting in YAML.

### `/unlock` Command

- Running `/unlock` in an expired session under input blocking (`block` / `both` mode) allows just the next send once. The permission expires after `unlockTtlMinutes` (default: 10 minutes).
- Once a model response (`step/end`) returns after unlocking, the permission has served its purpose and normal checks resume (since the session is not expired right after a response, you can continue the conversation naturally).
- Running it in a session that has not expired yet or has no model response yet does not record a permission and only displays the current elapsed time or status.

## UI Display

- **Display language**: Text follows your environment. The Host resolves it from `LC_ALL`, `LC_MESSAGES`, `LANG`, and the system locale, in that order; the official Web UI resolves it from the browser language (`navigator.languages`). English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese are supported, and unsupported languages fall back to English. Log output (lines prefixed with `[cache-sentinel]`) stays in Japanese.
- **When a send is blocked (both the official Web UI and M3E)**:
  - The conversation displays "Send blocked (N minutes since the last response, as the cache has likely expired)." and "You can allow the next single send with /unlock.", along with the discarded input text (up to 2000 characters per message), as a command result line.
  - When steps with 0 input messages (such as automatic continuation) are rejected consecutively, notifications are throttled to at most once every 10 minutes per session.
- **Pre-send banner display**:
  - **Official Web UI**: The client plugin (`lib/client.js`) displays a status banner above the input box (`conversation.input.dock`).
    - Expired: "Cache expired (N minutes since the last response). Sending now will be blocked." and the "Allow the next single send (/unlock)" button
    - Unlocked: "Next send allowed (uncached input rates will apply). M min left"
    - If the button cannot run `/unlock`, the reason appears under the warning. Send `/unlock` from the input box instead.
  - **M3E (`dsh-webui-m3e`)**: The conversation line when blocked is displayed, but because M3E does not load client bundles from other plugins, displaying the pre-send banner requires support on the M3E side.
- **Status API**:
  - `GET /api/cache-sentinel.status?sessionId=<id>` (with Connection authentication) returns the session status JSON.

## Configuration

You can change the settings in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. Omitted keys use their default values.

```yaml
- id: cache-sentinel
  config:
    mode: block               # block / archive / both / off (can be overridden with /sentinel)
    idleMinutes: 60           # threshold for input blocking (min); in archive mode, the archive threshold (min)
    archiveAfterMinutes: 1440 # archive threshold in both mode (min)
    unlockTtlMinutes: 10      # how long /unlock stays valid (min)
    checkIntervalSeconds: 60  # archive check interval (sec, 10 or more)
    skipPinned: true          # do not archive pinned sessions
    archiveExisting: false    # also archive sessions that have been idle since before archiving was first enabled
    maxPerCycle: 20           # maximum sessions to archive per cycle
    dryRun: false             # when true, neither block nor archive, only log
    # stateFile: /path/to/state.json # path to persistent state file (default: $DSH_HOME/cache-sentinel/state.json)
```

- Changes to `cordis.patch.yml` take effect without restarting DSH (the plugin is re-applied with the new settings, and in-memory `/unlock` permissions are cleared).
- Specifying unknown keys or values with invalid types or ranges results in an error.

## How It Works

### Input Blocking (`block` / `both` Mode)

- Evaluates before a step starts at the head of the `agent/pre-step` hook (`prepend: true`). Because it runs before automatic compaction (`dsh-compaction-basic`), model calls for automatic compaction do not occur in expired sessions either.
- Blocks steps regardless of where the message came from: user sends, reminders, automatic goal continuation, background job completion notifications, subagent continuation, and next steps a

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-android-emulator-helper

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
[![target: DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%3E%3D0.2.1--rc.2-blue.svg)](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) native port of the official ZCode `android-emulator@0.1.0` plugin: all 23 original MCP tools preserved as native DSH tools, plus a **parameter page on the plugin's own detail page** in the Plugins panel (Plugins → Installed plugins → Android Emulator Helper) that edits the SDK, emulator, system-image, build and output parameters in-app instead of through environment variables.

- Tool and argument names are identical to the original, so workflows written for its `android_emulator` MCP server keep working; the port adds no tool and drops none.
- 17 settings fields in 5 groups, all live-editable; the seven fields the original exposed still fall back to their `ANDROID_PLUGIN_*` variable, then to the built-in default.
- `android_preflight` and the parameter page's **Run diagnostic** button run the same checks — SDK, `adb`, `emulator`, AVDs, JDK, Gradle — and print a fix for each failure.
- Published as `@zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper`; the plugin page shows **Android Emulator Helper** / **Android 模拟器助手** from `locale/` rather than the raw package name, and both descriptions say the plugin is unofficial and not affiliated with Google.

## Quick start

On a machine with an Android SDK, a JDK and DSH installed:

1. **Install the plugin**

   ```bash
   dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper
   ```

   In DSH Desktop, open **Plugins** and add the same package name there. Reload or restart DSH afterwards.

2. **Check the machine** — open **Plugins → Installed plugins → Android Emulator Helper** and press **Run diagnostic**. It runs exactly the checks `android_preflight` runs, and prints a fix for anything missing.

3. **Use it** — ask for what you want ("build and run this project on the emulator", "screenshot the running app"), or call the 23 `android_*` tools directly. Everything the tools need is editable on that page.

## Contents

- [Quick start](#quick-start)
- [Requirements](#requirements)
- [Install](#install)
- [Configuration page](#configuration-page)
- [Screenshots](#screenshots)
- [Tools](#tools)
- [Skill and slash command](#skill-and-slash-command)
- [Differences from the original](#differences-from-the-original)
- [Known limitations](#known-limitations)
- [Releases](#releases)
- [Contributing](#contributing)
- [License](#license)

## Requirements

| Dependency | Notes |
|---|---|
| Android SDK | `sdkPath` on the plugin's configuration page, else `ANDROID_HOME`, `ANDROID_SDK_ROOT`, then the common install paths. |
| Platform tools, emulator and a system image | `adb` and `emulator` come from the SDK; an AVD needs a system image for the API level you target. |
| JDK | `jdkMajor` (`17` by default) selects the JDK a build runs on; the generated project's JVM target is derived from it and clamped to [17, 21]. |
| Gradle | `android_build_app` uses the project's `./gradlew` when it has one and `gradle` from `PATH` otherwise, and can generate the wrapper with that `gradle`. The project `android_create_app` writes ships no wrapper. |
| A device or an AVD | An attached device, or an AVD to boot; `autoStartEmulator` decides whether the tools may boot one themselves. |
| Node.js ≥ 22 | The DSH host runtime. |

`android_preflight` checks every item above and prints a fix for each failure; the plugin page's **Run diagnostic** button runs the same checks.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper
```

**DSH Desktop**: the `desktop` profile belongs to the Electron app — open **Plugins**, add `@zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper` there, and enable the row it creates. After a reload or restart, open **Plugins → Installed plugins → Android Emulator Helper**: the parameter form is on that plugin's detail page, and only appears while the host half actually serves this plugin's settings namespace.

The published tarball contains everything the plugin needs — the host half, the browser bundle, the bundled skill and the `locale/` entries — and nothing is compiled at install time, so no build approval step is involved. `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` are **peer dependencies** provided by the harness, so the plugin pulls in no second copy and has **no runtime dependencies** of its own; DSH's compatibility gate compares the `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer ranges against the running version and refuses to install on a mismatch.

> Mount the package exactly once. `dsh plugin add` records the row in `dsh.profile.bundles`; adding a second row for the same package in the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` registers every tool name twice and fails at the loader.

### Upgrade and uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper@latest   # upgrade
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove @zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper      # uninstall
```

Settings live in the profile, not in the package, so both commands leave them in place. The data directory (by default `$DSH_HOME/android-emulator-helper`, then `~/.dsh/android-emulator-helper`) holds screenshots and build logs; it is yours to delete, and uninstalling does not touch it.

### Version gate

The DSH compatibility range is **`>=0.2.1-rc.2`, a lower bound only**, declared identically in `peerDependencies`, `engines.dsh` and `dsh.compatibility.dsh`: a runtime below it is refused at install time, and no future harness release is excluded. The floor is the release this plugin's Plugins-page configuration was built and verified against.

One node-semver detail survives — a **new tuple's** prerelease such as `0.2.2-alpha.1` is not admitted by npm's and pnpm's default rules, so that install fails until either the range gains a branch for the tuple (`">=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.2.2-0 || >=0.2.2-0"`) or the peer check is skipped:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper \
  --config.strict-peer-dependencies=false
```

Stable releases at or above the floor (`0.2.1`, `0.3.0`, `1.0.0`, …) are unaffected and always admitted.

## Configuration page

The settings namespace equals the profile patch row id equals `android-emulator-helper` (also `dsh.name`). The form registers with the Plugins page's `plugins.bundle.config` slot, keyed by the package name, so it renders inside the plugin's detail page in the Plugins panel instead of in the Settings dialog; it exists only while the host half serves that namespace. It reads and writes through `ctx.configForms`, so staged edits, dirty detection, inline validation, optimistic concurrency (revisions) and "overridden / reset to default" all come from the harness. The detail page draws the plugin's title, icon and description; the form contributes one line saying when an edit takes effect, one card per category — the card outline is what separates them — and saves from a sticky action bar at the bottom that appears only while there is something to act on: a staged edit, a write in flight, or a failure worth retrying.

| Group | Field | Kind | Default | Legacy env fallback |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SDK and toolchain | `sdkPath` | text | empty (auto-detect) | `ANDROID_PLUGIN_SDK_PATH` |
| | `jdkMajor` | text, suggestions from this machine | `17` | `ANDROID_PLUGIN_JDK_MAJOR` |
| | `buildToolsVersion` | text, suggestions | `35.0.0` | `ANDROID_PLUGIN_BUILD_TOOLS_VERSION` |
| Emulator and devices | `defaultAvd` | text, suggestions | `medium_phone` | `ANDROID_PLUGIN_DEFAULT_AVD` |
| | `defaultSerial` | text, suggestions | empty | — |
| | `autoStartEmulator` | switch | on | — |
| | `emulatorArgs` | multiline, one argument per line | empty | — |
| | `bootTimeoutSeconds` | integer | `180` | — |
| API and system image | `apiLevel` | text, sugges

plugins.description: 能检测你重复的需求，检测出来你多烧了多少钱，这个 DeepSeek Harness 插件挂在左下角，当场把白烧的数目算给你。
plugins.readme_text: # 收据 代理又去读那个并不存在的文件。路径一个字没改，上次已经告诉它找不到了，它还是再读了一遍。 左下角那张卡片只回答一件事：这场白烧了多少钱。 平时就一个大字。点一下，金额还是三行：这一步花了多少，整场花了多少，里面有多少是这样空转烧掉的。大字就是第三行。如果这场里真有人在用同一组参数空转，下面多一块「这场在重复什么」，把同一件事收成一句，带上次数和大约多少钱。卡片上写着「按本地价目估算」，因为这是照公开单价算的，不是平台寄来的账单。 ## 装上 已经能打开 `dsh web` 的话，在这个仓库里执行： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add "link:$(pwd)" -- -w ``` 最后那个 `-- -w` 别省。网页这个 profile 自己是一个 pnpm 工作区，省了它，安装会被拒掉。 然后重新开一次网页： ```sh dsh web ``` 左下角会出现「白烧了」。点那块黑卡片就能看见这三行；有重复的时候，下面会把同一件事收成一句。已经聊完的会话，再打开那场，账也会补上。 ## 什么样的重试算白烧 话多不一定贵。贵的是失败之后，用同一组参数再来一次，什么新东西都没得到。目录还是空的，文件还是没有，它再搜一遍、再读一遍。第一次失败算干活。紧接着原样再试，那一次才算白烧。 三条同时成立才记： 1. 还是同一个工具 2. 还是同一组参数。键的先后顺序不一样，也算同一组 3. 上一次已经失败，或者返回是空的，中间你没有再发新的消息 比如：读一个不存在的文件，紧接着用同一条路径再读；搜索什么都没返回，紧接着用同一句话再搜；中间先去干了别的，回头又用同一条路径再读。上面那张图就是第一种，同一条路径连着读，两次都是找不到。 换了路径、上次其实已经成功、或者你又说了一句话之后它才重试，这些都不记。第一次失败本身也不记。还在跑、结果还没回来的那次，先不算。 同一步里如果只有一部分调用是这样，浪费就按这一步的钱、按调用次数分摊。正在跑的那一步会先出现在「这一步」里，等它结束，再决定算不算进那个大字。 ## 图里的钱为什么这么少 这是一场真的会话，模型是 `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash`。同一条不存在的路径被原样重读了几次，卡片记下 4 次盲重试。 页面上大约 19.6 万 token，大约 93% 是缓存命中。所以大字只有 **$0.000402**，整场 **$0.004319**，最后一步 **$0.000153**。缓存读一次很便宜，真正贵的是没进缓存的那些输入。token 数很大的时候，这张卡片上的金额照样可以很小。 ## 单价从哪来 价目抄的是 [DeepSeek 公开定价](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/)，2026-10-15 核对过。默认按闲时算，一天里大部分时间都是闲时。忙时大约是这个的一倍，想按忙时估的话，把插件配置里的 `period` 写成 `peak`。 Flash 闲时，每一百万 token：缓存命中 $0.003，没进缓存 $0.15，输出 $0.60。 Pro 闲时，每一百万 token：缓存命中 $0.022，没进缓存 $0.66，输出 $1.98。 `deepseek-flash`、`deepseek-v4-flash`、`DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` 都按 Flash 算。硅基流动那种 `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash`，看斜杠后面那段名字。价目表里没有的模型会写「未定价」，不会假装是 $0。 官方表上没有单独的「缓存写入」一行，这里按没进缓存的单价估。推理用的 token 通常已经含在输出里，不再加一次。 所以这是一份本地估算。硅基流动或者其他平台真正收你的钱，可能对不上。 ## 就这一张卡片 没有轨迹，没有回放，没有皮肤。它不看你的账号余额，也不改代理平时怎么说话。同一组参数第二次原样重试落下来时，会话里会多一句：「上一次同样的调用已经失败，不要用同一组参数再试。」这句话不拦工具。不想要的话，把插件配置里的 `remind` 写成 `false`。免费模型和绕过额度这件事，它也不做。 MIT。

plugins.description: A Skill and MCP control panel for DSH
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-scope: DSH Skill 与 MCP 管控面板 [![许可证：MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/%E8%AE%B8%E5%8F%AF%E8%AF%81-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![npm package](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/%40dotdance%2Fdsh-skill-scope.svg?label=npm%20package)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@dotdance/dsh-skill-scope) [![npm 下载量](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/%40dotdance%2Fdsh-skill-scope.svg?label=npm%20%E4%B8%8B%E8%BD%BD%E9%87%8F)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@dotdance/dsh-skill-scope) [![DSH Web Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH%20Web-Plugin-0f766e.svg)](https://github.com/dotdance/dsh-skill-scope) [![DSH >= 0.2.0-rc.2](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%3E%3D%200.2.0--rc.2-2563eb.svg)](#安装) ![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19.0%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-3c873a.svg) **全局 + 项目粒度 skill/mcp 一键启停** [English](README.en.md) · **简体中文**
--- ## 安装 ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @dotdance/dsh-skill-scope ``` `--profile web` 换成你自己的 profile 名即可。 ## 它解决什么问题 你在 DSH 里装得越多，Agent 每一轮要读的清单就越长。 - 用户级 Skill 目录里堆了 **N+ Skill**，其中能帮到当前这个任务的只有几个。 - 每个 MCP server 都会把它的**全部工具**塞进模型的工具表，哪怕这一轮一个都用不上。 - 写代码的工程和写文章的工作区，需要的 Skill 和 MCP **根本不是同一套**。 - 你想「这个项目就用这几个能力」，但官方没有给任何开关——Skill 装上就是全局可见。 后果不是"不好看"，而是实打实的成本： | 代价 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | **烧 Token** | Skill 目录与 MCP 工具表每一轮都要重新进上下文，装的越多，每一轮固定开销越大 | | **注意力被稀释** | 候选太多，模型更容易选错工具、漏掉真正相关的那个 | | **上下文不干净** | 无关能力混进提示词，结果更难预测，调试更难 | | **工程之间互相污染** | A 项目的专用能力，在 B 项目里也一直占着位置 | **dsh-skill-scope 就是为这件事做的**：把「模型能调用哪些 Skill 与 MCP」变成一组 看得见、点得动的开关，并按**全局**和**本工作区**两个粒度分别管理。 --- ## 它能做什么 ### 1. 全局面板——一次收掉所有工程都不需要的能力 点左侧栏的「**全局 Skills**」，打开一个原生主界面页面，列出**全局层**的全部 Skill 与 MCP server。 在这里关掉的名字**默认对所有工作区生效**；某个工程确实需要时，可以在本工程里单独把它打开（见下文第 3 条）。 ![两个入口：侧栏的 Global Skills 与输入框右侧的 Workspace Skills](assets/panel-global.png) 上图红圈标出两个入口：左侧栏的 **Global Skills**，和输入框右下角的 **Workspace Skills**。 - 顶部一排是**视图切换**（全部 / 已启用 / 已禁用）——它只筛列表，不改任何开关。 - 搜索框**同时筛 Skill 与 MCP 两段**，输入即过滤。 - 列表按来源分组折叠，长清单也能快速定位。 **官方 Skill 默认不列**：`@deepseek-ai` 官方包自带的 Skill（`cordis-*` 预设、`office-*` 等） 默认不出现在面板上，模型仍可自动调用它们。想看见、想关掉它们时，打开视图条右端的 「**显示官方 Skill**」开关：这些行会回到清单，与普通行一样可以逐项关闭。 这个开关是**单机级**的（存在 `$DSH_HOME/skill-scope/global.json`），全局与本工程两个面板 都展示它、值永远一致；在工作区面板里打开它，效果同样对所有工程生效。 ### 2. 本工程面板——只给这一个项目留要用的能力 在**新会话**的输入框右下角点「**工作区 Skills**」，打开本工程弹层（浮动在当前界面之上）： ![本工程面板](assets/panel-project.png) 图中列表标题写明「只影响 default-workspace」，下半部分按来源分组：本例里 `.agents` 目录贡献 35 项。 - 列表与全局面板**同一份清单**：全局关掉的项也在里面（开关是关的），你可以直接在这里把它打开。 - 与全局设置不同的行带一个红色标记「**与全局不同**」，一眼看出这个工程动过什么。 - 视图条除「全部 / 已启用 / 已禁用」外多一个「**与全局不同**」：点它只剩本工程改过的项（清单长时好用）。 - 改动**只对本工程的新会话生效**，不影响别的项目。 ### 3. 关键规则：全局给默认值，工程可以逐项改 ```text 磁盘上的全部 Skill 与 MCP │ ▼ ┌─────────────────────┐ │ 全局层（默认值） │ 关掉 = 默认任何工程都用不了 └─────────────────────┘ │ 逐项：跟随 / 打开 / 关闭 ▼ ┌─────────────────────┐ │ 工程层（可覆盖） │ 全局关的能打开，全局开的也能关掉 └─────────────────────┘ │ ▼ 这一轮模型真正看得见的集合 ``` 每一项在本工程里有三种状态。界面上只有开关一种动作，因为「跟随全局」用**不记这条**来表达： | 状态 | 含义 | 界面上怎么看出来 | | --- | --- | --- | | 跟随全局 | 本工程对这项没有主张 | 开关位置与全局一致，没有红标 | | 本工程打开 | 全局关着，这个工程要用 | 开关是开的 + 红标「与全局不同」 | | 本工程关闭 | 全局开着，这个工程不要 | 开关是关的 + 红标「与全局不同」 | 想改回「跟随全局」：把开关拨回全局的样子即可，红标消失，这条决定也随之删除。 ### 关掉 ≠ 删掉：手动调用永远还在 关掉一个 Skill 只把它的**模型自动调用**关掉。你仍然可以在会话里手敲 `/名字` 调用它。 ---

plugins.description: Read-only attachment library for DeepSeek Harness: every stored image and file, its size, and which conversations still use it.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-attachment-library · Attachment library

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that adds **Settings → Attachment library**: every image and file attachment stored on this machine, the space it takes, and which conversations still use it (active, archived, moving to the trash, or in the trash).

**Read-only.** Nothing is deleted: the plugin never creates, changes, moves, or deletes an attachment, a session log, a trash file, or a cache entry; "Show in Finder" only selects a file and never opens or runs it. The plugin's only write is the read-only copy "Open in Preview" places in the system temporary directory (outside DSH data), removed when the plugin stops. Its purpose is to check the reference counts before any cleanup is considered.

- DSH 0.2.x (`engines.dsh: >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`, including the 0.2.1 alpha previews)
- Trash statistics work with [`dsh-plugin-session-trash`](https://github.com/ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-session-trash); without it only existing conversations are counted

## Install

**Desktop**: open **Plugins** in the sidebar → **Add plugin**, enter one of the following, click **Install**, then **Enable now** (new plugins start disabled):

- GitHub: `https://github.com/ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-attachment-library`, or a version such as `github:ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-attachment-library#v0.4.1`
- npm: `dsh-plugin-attachment-library`
- An absolute path to a local package, for example `/path/to/dsh-plugin-attachment-library-0.4.1.tgz` (made with `pnpm pack`)

Do not enter the source directory: its `node_modules` holds development copies of DSH packages that conflict with DSH's own.

**Command line** (optional): quit DSH, then run `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-attachment-library`.

**Uninstall**: uninstall "Attachment library" on the **Plugins** page. The plugin stores no data; attachments are not affected.

## What the page shows

- **Totals**: all attachments (count and size); images and files; used by existing conversations, used only by conversations in the trash, and not used by any conversation (count and size each); attachments referenced but missing from the store; the size of the regenerable resize cache.
- **List**: a type icon (an image icon for images, an icon by extension for files), type, file names (every name stored for the same content), size, image dimensions and format, store time, and each referencing conversation with its title and status. An attachment shared by several conversations lists all of them.
- **Open in Preview** (macOS only): an arrow icon button on stored image rows (tooltip "Open in Preview") opens the image in Preview on the Host. Preview gets a read-only copy with the right extension, not DSH's own file (see below). File rows have no such button.
- **Show in Finder**: a folder icon button at the right of each stored row (tooltip "Show in Finder") selects the file in the Host's Finder (Windows Explorer, or the default Linux file manager): a file attachment shows under its real file name, an image as its content-named object file. It appears only when the page talks to the local DSH, the Host has a desktop file manager, and DSH allows desktop handoff; a failure is shown under the row.
- **Rescan**: the refresh icon button at the top right (tooltip "Rescan"); it is disabled while a scan runs, and "Rescanning…" is shown.
- **Filters**: type (all / images / files) and references (all / existing / trash only / unused); **sort** by time or by size (newest or largest first). The list shows 100 rows at a time.
- **Incomplete logs**: session logs that could not be read in full (damaged, cut short) are listed with a note that the "unused" counts may be too high.

## Why Finder shows no preview for images

DSH stores each image under its SHA-256 digest (for example `attachments/v1/objects/3f/3f9a…`) with **no file extension**, read-only (0400). The content is an ordinary normalized JPEG, WebP, PNG, or GIF, not encrypted; macOS decides the file type from the extension, so Finder shows no thumbnail and a double-click does not open it as an image. File attachments differ: each also has a read-only hard link under its real file name, which Finder shows normally.

## Counting rules

| Rule | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Identity | DSH stores attachments once per content digest (SHA-256); images and files are stored separately, so the same bytes stored as an image and as a file are two rows |
| References | Every `{ type: 'image' \| 'file', attachment: { attachmentId } }` in a session log counts: user prompts, tool results, and system messages |
| Conversations | A subagent session's references count for the conversation that started it; a fork is its own conversation (it inherits its parent's prefix, so both are listed) |
| Existing conversations | Every session the session backend lists, read through the official read-only handle; status active, archived, or moving to the trash |
| Trash | Logs inside the trash directory are read directly (raw JSONL or Zstandard frames); the title is the one recorded when the conversation was moved |
| In use / trash only / unused | Any conversation outside the trash (including one waiting to move) makes it "in use"; only trashed conversations make it "trash only"; none makes it "unused" |
| Size | Each image object and file object counts once; file names are hard links and take no extra space; missing attachments add no size |
| Store time | The modification time of the stored object (when this content was first stored) |

## Cache

The first scan reads every session log and can be slow with many logs. After that:

- existing sessions are read again only when the session backend's revision changed;
- trashed sessions are read again only when the log file's device, inode, size, or modification time changed;
- image dimensions are cached by the same file facts.

The cache lives in the DSH process memory only and is never written to disk; the first scan after a DSH restart reads every log again.

## Configuration

Every DSH directory is only read.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `attachmentDirectory` | `<DSH home>/attachments/v1` | Attachment store; set it when `dsh-attachment-local` has its own `dshHome` |
| `trashDirectory` | `<DSH home>/session-trash` | Session trash; keep it equal to `dsh-plugin-session-trash`'s `trashDirectory` |
| `requestCacheDirectory` | `<DSH home>/cache/attachments/request-images` | Regenerable per-model resize cache; only its size is measured |
| `previewDirectory` | system temporary directory | Where the private temporary directory for "Open in Preview" copies is created; the only place the plugin writes |

## How "Show in Finder" works

- It uses DSH's own capability: the Host calls `revealNativePath` from the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command` (`open -R` on macOS, Explorer `/select` on Windows, the containing directory on Linux), the same function behind DSH's built-in reveal actions. Availability uses the same checks (`nativeFileManager()`, `canOpenNativePath()`); the browser also requires `ctx.remote.$host.isLoopback` and follows DSH's `session.canOpenWorkspacePath()` switch.
- The official `session.openWorkspacePath` is not reused directly: it takes an absolute path from the browser and only accepts paths mapped into the workspace filesystem, which the attachment store is not.
- The browser sends only the attachment kind and id (`sha256:` and 64 lowercase hex digits); the authenticated `/api` gateway validates them strictly and rejects any extra field, a path included.
- The Host derives the path from the id: a file is `attachments/v1/files/<prefix>/<digest>/<name>` (the first name in sorted order, or the `file-objects` object when none exists), an image `attachments/v1/objects/<prefix>/<sha256>`. The target must be a plain file inside the attachment store with no symbolic link on the way; anything else is "not found".

## How "Open in Preview" works

- The browser sends only the image id (`sha256:` and 64 lowercase hex digits); the gateway validates it strictly and rejects any extra field, a path included. The Host finds `attachments/v1/objects/<prefix>/<sha256>` and requires a plain file i

plugins.description: Adds sessions without a workspace to DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-noworkspace-session

为 DeepSeek Harness 增加**未分组（无工作区）会话**：点一下就开一个不占用任何项目工作区的会话，输入区仍是 DSH 原生那一个——模型选择、权限、附件、斜杠命令全部照旧。

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/yusunz/dsh-plugin-noworkspace-session)

## 为什么需要它

DSH 的输入区要求会话属于某个工作区；未分组会话在原生判定里是"空白会话"，输入区会被禁用。本插件在创建会话后，**临时**把它挂到与它自己工作目录同名的工作区上，让原生输入区可用；你发出第一条消息后，这个临时工作区被删除，会话落回**未分组**并照常保留、可恢复。

## 两个入口

| 位置 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| hero 行右侧 | 一枚「不在工作区中工作」按钮，与原生工作区选择框同一行；原生选择框保持原生，未被替换 |
| 右侧栏「开始」页 | 一张「非工作区会话」卡片，与「工作区文件 / 新建终端 / 浏览器」并列 |

两处动作一致：新建会话 → 临时挂载 → 原生输入区可用 → 首条消息后回到未分组。

## 工作目录

每次新建会话都会在工作目录下创建 `<YYYY-MM-DD>\<HH-MM-SS>` 子目录并作为该会话的 cwd，因此每个未分组任务互不干扰。

默认位置：`~/Documents/dsh`（可在设置里改）。

- **不留残留**：点了按钮却没发消息就切走，临时分组立刻消失；磁盘上那个空目录会在**下次启动 DSH 时**被回收。目录里只要有文件（代理写过东西）就永远不会被删。
- 会话本身从不被删除。

## 设置

**设置 → 通用设置 → 无项目任务文件夹**：显示当前路径，支持「更改」（宿主原生目录选择框）与「重置」（回落默认 `~/Documents/dsh`）。修改写入当前 profile 的配置并立即生效，之后新建的会话立即使用新位置。

## 安装

在应用内用插件管理器安装，或在命令行：

```bash
# npm
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-noworkspace-session

# GitHub
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:yusunz/dsh-plugin-noworkspace-session

# 本地 tarball
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-plugin-noworkspace-session-0.2.0.tgz
```

安装后**重启 DSH**（宿主半代码只在进程启动时加载），随后**硬刷新页面**（Ctrl+Shift+R）以确保取到新的客户端 bundle。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-plugin-noworkspace-session
```

然后在应用内用插件管理器移除 bundle 并刷新页面。已创建的未分组会话不会被删除。

## 已知限制

- **右侧栏不能承载会话**：DSH 的右侧栏整套注册都绑定「当前会话」，标签页是文件 / 浏览器 / 终端这类面板类型，没有渲染对话面的座位。所以卡片点击后是在**主视图**打开会话，而不是在右栏开一个会话标签页。
- 放弃的空白会话回到未分组后遵循 DSH 原生规则：空白会话在侧栏不可见（有了消息才会作为普通会话显示）。
- 首条消息直接输入即可；附件走原生链路。

## 兼容性

- 目标：DSH 0.2.0 及以上的桌面版与 Web 版。
- 依赖：`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（DSH 自带，随插件声明）。
- 只在 `conversation.input.dock`、`conversation.hero.options`、`settings.general.item`、`sidebar.right.tab.guide.entry` 这类**增量座位**上注册，不替换任何 DSH 原生控件。

## License

MIT

---

## English

Adds **sessions without a workspace** to DeepSeek Harness: one click opens a session that occupies no project workspace while keeping DSH's own composer (model, permissions, attachments, slash commands). The session is temporarily attached to a workspace named after its own directory so the native composer unlocks; after your first message that temporary workspace is removed and the session lands under **Ungrouped**, resumable as usual. Entry points: a button on the hero row and a card on the right sidebar's start page. Each session gets its own `<date>\<time>` working directory; empty ones are reclaimed on the next DSH start, and a directory holding files is never touched. Install with `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-noworkspace-session`, then restart DSH and hard-refresh the page. MIT.

plugins.readme_text: # @deepwhale-cn/dsh-tool-vet [![dshfind 收录](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/feely0208/dsh-tool-vet?lang=zh)](https://dshfind.com/zh/plugins/feely0208/dsh-tool-vet) **装第三方插件之前，先看它会动什么。** **关键词**：工具审查 · 插件审查 · 装之前先查 · 权限 · 能力枚举 · 供应链安全 · postinstall · 恶意依赖 · 可信度 --- ## 先说清楚它是什么、不是什么 **是**：装一个第三方插件/包**之前**，静态审查它**会干什么** —— 执行命令、读敏感路径、往外发数据、装的时候自动跑什么。 **不是**： - ❌ **不是沙箱** —— 不拦截运行，只做静态审查 - ❌ **不是运行时权限审批** —— 那是另一类工具（市场里已经很多） - ❌ **不是漏洞库比对** —— 那是 `dsh-dep-audit` 的活 - ❌ **不下「安全 / 不安全」的结论** —— 只列能力，判断留给你 **一句话分界**：**别人是门卫，这个是体检。** 门卫管进出，体检告诉你这个新来的会动什么。 与 `dsh-dep-audit` 的分界： ``` dep-audit = 查【你自己项目】的【依赖树】 tool-vet = 审查【一个第三方包本身】的【代码能力】 ``` --- ## 它查什么（6 条） | 规则 | 查什么 | 级别 | |---|---|---| | `VET-INSTALL-SCRIPT` | 装了就会自动执行（`preinstall`/`install`/`postinstall`）| 🔴 | | `VET-CRED-PATH` | 代码里出现 `~/.ssh`、`~/.aws`、`~/.npmrc` 等凭据路径 | 🔴 | | `VET-OBFUSCATION` | 拼接执行 / 超长编码串（MITRE ATT&CK T1027）| 🔴 | | `VET-OUTBOUND` | 会往网络上发东西 | 🟡 | | `VET-EXEC` | 会执行外部命令 | 🟡 | | `VET-DEP-SOURCE` | 依赖来自 registry 之外（`git:` / `http:` / `file:`）| 🟡 | **每条都会给出：哪个文件、第几行、那行代码长什么样、依据是什么。** --- ## 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-tool-vet ``` ## 用法 ```bash # 审查一个本地目录 dsh-tool-vet --root /path/to/some-plugin # 看内置演示（一个「看着正常、实际会读私钥并外发」的假插件） dsh-tool-vet --demo # 列出规则与依据 dsh-tool-vet --list-rules # 出 HTML 报告 dsh-tool-vet --root /path/to/some-plugin --html ``` --- ## 一个真实的例子 `--demo` 审查的那个假插件，描述是「给会话加一个快速笔记面板」，看起来人畜无害。 它会： ``` 🔴 装的时候就自动执行 scripts/setup.js 🔴 读 ~/.ssh/id_rsa、~/.aws/credentials、~/.npmrc 🔴 一段 base64 串还原后 new Function() 执行 🟡 catch 网络：往 telemetry.example-collector.net 发 POST 🟡 调 child_process 🟡 依赖从 git 仓库直装，绕过 npm 包名体系 ``` **这六条，装之前就能看见。** --- ## 边界 - **只做静态审查** —— 代码里动态拼出来的路径、从网络拉下来的代码，它看不见 - **不判定意图** —— 「读 `.ssh`」是能力，不是罪证。一个 SSH 工具当然要读 `.ssh`，所以报出来是提示你确认，不是判定它有问题 - **覆盖不到依赖内部** —— 它审查的是这一个包自己的代码，不递归进依赖树（那是 `dep-audit` 的范围） - **判据是「值得警惕的能力」** —— 不是「违规」。所以这里没有法条，依据是官方文档与公开的威胁模型 --- --- plugins.description: Keeps bulk output out of the conversation from both ends: a routing gate refuses flooding calls (curl/wget in any shell, web_fetch/read_page), and output already inside is slimmed after the tool runs — JSON re-encoded losslessly, tables windowed with line numbers, logs folded keeping diagnostics — originals readable byte-for-byte via ctk_retrieve.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-toolkit

> [简体中文](./README.zh.md) | **English** | [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md)

A DeepSeek Harness bundle whose single job is **keeping bulk output out of the conversation**.

It separates *raw bytes* from *conclusions*: commands run in a child process, files are analysed in a sandbox, and long material is filed into a local knowledge base — while the conversation receives only conclusions, excerpts and counts. A routing gate refuses, before execution, the calls that would inevitably flood the transcript.

**No third-party runtime dependencies.** The knowledge base rides on Node's own `node:sqlite` (FTS5 included) and code execution uses interpreters already on the machine, so installing it pulls nothing else.

## What it is for

| Problem | What this does |
|---|---|
| A command prints thousands of lines; you only need a count | `ctk_execute` runs it in a child process and returns the answer |
| A large file needs statistics, not a full read | `ctk_execute_file` keeps its bytes in the sandbox |
| Many commands, one question | `ctk_batch_execute` answers in one call with per-command status |
| A page or spec is read once and never reused | `ctk_index` files it; `ctk_search` pulls excerpts on demand |
| `curl` / `wget` paste whole responses into the conversation | The routing gate refuses them and names the alternative |
| You cannot tell how much was saved | `ctk_stats` reports the ledger; the settings page shows a live occupancy panel |

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `ctk_execute` | Run code in a sandboxed child process (javascript / esm / typescript / shell), return only the answer |
| `ctk_execute_file` | Run code over a file for statistics or extraction; the file text stays in the sandbox |
| `ctk_batch_execute` | Several commands in one call, per-command status, conclusions only |
| `ctk_index` | File text or a file into the local FTS5 knowledge base |
| `ctk_search` | Multi-query retrieval; excerpts are centred on the match |
| `ctk_retrieve` | Read back a slimmed output's stored original, byte-for-byte, from its `[ctk_retrieve id=…]` marker |
| `ctk_fetch_and_index` | Fetch pages → strip markup → file them |
| `ctk_purge` | Delete filed material (requires `confirm: true`) |
| `ctk_stats` | Savings ledger: refusals, sandbox bytes, filed bytes, call counts |
| `ctk_doctor` | Self-check: interpreters really start, scratch dir writable, knowledge round-trip |
| `ctk_context_report` | This conversation's context occupancy and composition |

## Install

From npm (recommended):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-context-toolkit
```

From GitHub:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:chimneyQ/dsh-context-toolkit
```

From a local checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add D:\path\to\dsh-context-toolkit
```

Confirm `dsh-context-toolkit` appears in `dsh.profile.bundles` inside `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/desktop/package.json`.

Remove:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-context-toolkit
```

## Use it well

**Reach for `ctk_*` first** whenever the work is analysis, counting, filtering or summarising — reading that output into the conversation is the exact problem this bundle exists to solve.

```js
// How many .log files, and how big in total?
await ctk_execute({
  language: 'javascript',
  code: `
    const fs = require('fs');
    const dir = process.argv[2];
    let n = 0, bytes = 0;
    for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir)) {
      if (!f.endsWith('.log')) continue;
      n++; bytes += fs.statSync(dir + '/' + f).size;
    }
    console.log(n + ' files, ' + bytes + ' bytes');
  `
});
```

File long material once, then pull sections:

```js
await ctk_index({ path: 'D:/specs/api.md' });          // the full text stays in the store
await ctk_search({ queries: ['rate limit', 'auth'] });  // only the relevant excerpts come back
```

## TLS on a proxy-intercepted network

If every `ctk_fetch_and_index` fails with `UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE`, the machine sits behind a
TLS-inspecting proxy and Node's built-in roots cannot verify what the proxy presents. `caPemPath`
names a PEM to trust instead.

`auto` (the default) points at `<DSH_HOME>/context-mode/ca/windows-roots.pem`. **This package does not
ship that file** — it is a snapshot of the *host's own* root store, so on a fresh machine it simply is
not there and fetching falls back to Node's default roots.

Settings → Context Toolkit shows a row under `caPemPath`:

- a badge saying whether the file exists (and its size), checked with a stat on page load — the bundle
  itself is never read just to render the page;
- a button that writes it from the system root store (`tls.getCACertificates('system')`, ~500
  certificates, ~820 KB) when pressed.

A bundle that already exists is never replaced on a single click: the first press asks, and only the
explicit confirmation overwrites it.

**What this does not do:** it exports the *system* store. If the proxy's root certificate was never
installed into that store — IT pushes it via group policy, for instance — the exported bundle still
will not verify the proxy. Install the root first, then export.

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `routing` | `true` | Master switch for the routing gate |
| `denyCurlWget` | `true` | Block curl / wget outright |
| `bashNudgeMinCommandBytes` | `4096` | Nudge threshold for long commands (0 disables) |
| `maxReadBytesBeforeAsk` | `51200` | Nudge threshold for whole-file reads (0 disables) |
| `nudgeFetchTools` | `true` | Nudge the host fetchers (`web_fetch` / `read_page`) too |
| `trustedReadBasenames` | `package.json` etc. | Filenames exempt from the read nudge |
| `compressNudgeTokens` | `120000` | Occupancy warning threshold (tokens) |
| `searchLimit` | `5` | Excerpts per query in `ctk_search` |
| `snippetChars` | `900` | Character ceiling per excerpt |
| `fetchMaxBytes` | `2000000` | Per-page fetch ceiling |
| `caPemPath` | `auto` | TLS trust store for `ctk_fetch_and_index`: `auto` = `<DSH_HOME>/context-mode/ca/windows-roots.pem`, an absolute PEM path, or empty for Node's default roots. Set it when a TLS-inspecting proxy makes every https fetch fail on the certificate. |
| `storageDir` | empty | Knowledge-base root; empty = `<DSH_HOME>/context-toolkit` |
| `tools.*` | see below | Per-tool switches |

Tool switches: `tools.execute`, `tools.executeFile`, `tools.batchExecute`, `tools.index`, `tools.search`, `tools.fetchAndIndex`, `tools.purge`, `tools.stats`, `tools.contextReport`, `tools.doctor` — all on by default.

## Verify

The offline suites need no DSH runtime:

```bash
node smoke.mjs        # 104 checks: contract, runtime discovery, tools, gate (segment matching, host-aligned path base, script_path and host-fetcher coverage), output slimming with reversible retrieval and retention, CA bundle presence/export, resource disposal, knowledge base, observability, version reporting
```

## Output slimming (after a tool runs)

The gate works at the *door*; slimming handles what is **already inside**. They catch different traffic: the gate can only read a call's *arguments*, while slimming sees the *bytes that actually came back* — from a tool the gate does not know, an entry point it does not cover, or output that was never predictable from the call.

At `tools/post-execute`, the strategy follows the shape:
